title: VITA - Infrastructure Solutions Architect 2 (816230)
description: Architect: Technology, Data Analysis, Communication Skills, Bachelors Degree Start date : 01/04/2027 End Date : 04/30/2027 Submission deadline : 12/02/2026 Client Info : VITA Note: *Hybrid *Web Cam Interview Only Description: Seeking a Solution Architect with a strong technical background and with comfort supporting IT procurement and contract templates management. This contractor will serve as a technical subject-matter expert embedded within VITAs Supply Chain Management team, bridging the gap between complex IT project requirements and enforceable contract language. The contractor will also support complex IT high risk reviews and research and analysis for technology-based contract templates development for fast-paced technologies. Duties will include: Redline Review Support Review vendor-proposed technical specifications and requirements against VITA standards and flag deviations. Build and maintain a structured pipeline for aggregating and tracking recurring issues from redline reviews. Provide written justifications for recommended changes to contract technical and functional requirements. Contract Template Currency and Research Support the review and update of VITAs IT procurement contract requirements and service level agreement templates to reflect emerging technology areas, including artificial intelligence, cloud services, and cybersecurity. Conduct independent research to support high-risk contract reviews, identifying current best practices and emerging risks. Draft proposed updated contract template language as a first pass for legal and policy review. Manage deliverables related to contract template modernization and risk framework development. Coordinate with VITA legal, procurement, and IT teams to advance contract-related initiatives on schedule. Translate complex concepts into clear, concise and accessible language for technical and non-technical audiences. Manage multiple documentation projects and meet established deadlines. Maintain strong version control and documentation review practices. Ensure documentation complies with agency standards, accessibility requirements, and formatting guidelines. Develop a library of technical requirements based on the type of technology

description: Consultant: Technology, Ticketing Systems, Communication, Problem Solving Skills Start date : 01/04/2027 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 12/2/2026 4:00:00 PM Client Info : DOA Note: *Interview Process: Teams with camera on. 2nd and 3rd rounds if necessary. *Onsite or Remote? Candidates MUST be a CURRENT WI resident. NO RELOCATION IS ALLOWED. Description: The District Attorney IT Program (DAIT) is recruiting a Technician II position to provide multi-tier computer, application, security, and network technical support and consultations for customers. The position is primarily remote and the contractor filling this position is required to reside in Wisconsin. Proof of residence shall be provided on or before the first day of commencing the position. Position Summary The Technician II role provides multi-tiered technical support for customer-facing applications, network connectivity, security configurations, and infrastructure in DAITs distributed environment. This role requires frequent interactions with customers and team members and requires technical knowledge, efficient problem-solving skills, and excellent customer service and communications skills. This position requires knowledge of desktop and application support technologies and practices, networking connectivity, knowledge of information security practices, and infrastructure components required to maintain and secure State systems in local DA offices. This position requires successful completion of a fingerprint and criminal background check. Experience: REQUIRED • At least 2 to 4 years of experience in a customer-facing, technology support role. • Experience working with support request ticketing systems, managing ticket updates, completing related documentation, and maintaining customer communications. • Experience resolving tickets on first call and when required, following established escalation practices. • Experience with remote support technology tools (screen sharing, voice, chat, etc.) • Experience providing diagnosis, problem resolution, and support for applications and systems. • Experience establishing and building support workflows based on team and customer requirements. • Experience supporting computers, printers, networks, servers, and equipment in security compliant data centers and offices. • Experience in non-prime shift, on-call technical support as needed. • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work with limited supervision in professional office settings as well as virtually on a team. • The ability to meet and maintain the State of Wisconsins fleet car rental requirements. • Strong written and oral communication skills. • Ability to lift 50lbs STRONGLY DESIRED • Experience working on project-based teams. • Experience with or knowledge of information systems automation, planning, deployment, security, imaging, performance monitoring, and virtualization. • Experience with inventory management and system refresh cycles. • Experience with vendor management and warranty support. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: • Serve on a dedicated support team as a point of contact for customers seeking multi-tier technical assistance over the phone, through email, or through the ticketing system. • Prioritize and resolve customers support requests. • Manage support tickets in a timely manner, documenting all related work and setting status updates. • Develop and modify knowledge base articles related to technical support solutions. • Collaborate with DAIT teams to plan, secure, deploy, and maintain computer hardware. • Monitor and report network and systems connectivity, performance, and security issues to improve reliability and compliance. • Develop use, feature, and support expertise in our ticketing management system. • D

title: Salesforce And ADA Tester/Analyst
description: Analyst: Manual Functional Testing, Integration Testing, Salesforce., Testing Tools UAT Stakeholders Jira Start date : 11/16/2026 End Date : 09/30/2027 Submission deadline : 12/1/2026 Client Info : NCDHHS-PMO Note: * Hybrid * In Person Only Description: DHHS ITD is seeking a STRONG MANUAL software UAT specifically in Salesforce platform and ADA Tester/Analysts to support our DCDEE Early Education Information System Projects. The NC Department of Health and Human Services seeks a contractor resource to assist with the development and implementation of DCDEE Early Education Information System (EEIS) project as a Salesforce Tester. Duties include analyzing business requirements for test ability and completeness using Functional Specification Documents, Business Requirements Documents and Technical Design Documents, analyzing and developing requirements into test conditions, development and execution of scripts to thoroughly test software to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects. This position is responsible for reviewing automated test cases and other testing artifacts to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all test artifacts. description: Administrator: Firewall Administration., VLAN, Network Design, Routing Protocols BGP OSPF Start date : 11/30/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/25/2026 Client Info : VDOT Note: * Onsite * Both Phone and In Person Description: Seeking a Network Administrator with 5+ years of progressive experience. Team is looking for a solid mid-level team member who brings a minimum of 5 years of hands-on networking experience. The best candidate will be someone who is looking for long term professional growth opportunities, possesses a 4 year degree and/or industry certifications. Requires experience, creativity and multi-tasking to independently and collaboratively achieve department service and support objectives for the Transportation Operations Center. Individual is able to work without assistance; is able to manage medium complexity work efforts; has some industry experience; can provide limited leadership to others; collaborates well with others. LEADERSHIP SKILLS/QUALITIES HIGHLY DESIRED. The Network Administrator installs, configures, and supports an organizations local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN), and Internet system or a segment of a network system. Maintain network hardware and software. Monitor network to ensure network availability to all system users and perform necessary maintenance to support network availability. May supervise other network support and client server specialists and plan, coordinate, and implement network security measures. Coordinate the development, implementation, and maintenance of a local area network or wide area network. Maintains the networks physical and logical structures, including network connections. Maintains network support software, analyzes user support statistics, and recommends appropriate measures. Installs, tests, and maintains network hardware and software. Prepares and analyzes statistics on network utilization and availability. Prepares training courses and provides user support and training in the use of available hardware, software, and utilities. Performs tuning and capacity planning activities to enhance the performance of the network resources. Assesses existing network, software, and current solutions and makes recommendations based on product specifications and best cybersecurity practices. Configures equipment and software to meet business needs, trains others on the solution, and documents the solution for ongoing support. Functions as part of a team on larger projects, or individually provides the services on support visits or smaller projects. Provides technical support and assists with the design of Infrastructure solutions. Requires experience in the technical services and support fields as well as experience in network administration (DHCP, DNS, routers, firewall, etc.) - Responds to Tier 1 and 2 network and software support requests. - Communicates effectively with teammates and customers of varying levels of technical expertise. - Responds to all break/fix requests associated with network resources. - Designs extensions of and connections to the campus network. - Assists with configuration and deployment of new/replacement network hardware and communications infrastructure. - Maintains up-to-date project and architecture documentation. - Maintains up-to-date inventory and maintenance records. - Monitors network resources for faults and traffic anomalies. - Resolves connection issues between users and resources. - Maintains detailed change history of network changes. - Supports ITS Field Maintenance with communications implementation and troubleshooting. - Supports team efforts to improve cybersecurity controls and defenses. - Supports team efforts for threat hunting and mitigation. - Manages time and resource constraints.

title: VITA - Program Manager
description: Manager: Program Management, PMP, Enterprise Project Management, Start date : 12/14/2026 End Date : 04/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/30/2026 Client Info : VITA Note: * Hybrid * Both Web Cam and In Person Interview * *Deadline to submit: Mon., 11/30 by 4 pm EST Description: There are 3 Program Mgr roles (same requirements for each) but to avoid major number of duplications I would like your TOP TWO CANDIDATES ONLY. ON SITE: Hybrid 2 days ONSITE Responsible for orchestrating multiple interdependent IT projects and initiatives across Commonwealth agencies, but may lead a single project directly when Commonwealth need requires it. Strategic Program Alignment · Define and maintain a program business case and roadmap that connects the programs constituent projects to Commonwealth and agency strategic objectives, adjusting program scope and sequencing as strategic priorities shift. · Evaluate proposed projects and initiatives for fit within the program, recommending inclusion, deferral, or exclusion based on alignment to program benefits and enterprise priorities. · Partner with PMCOE leadership and agency executives to ensure the programs direction remains aligned with the CIOs strategic priorities and the Commonwealths IT investment portfolio. * Program Life Cycle Management · Lead the program through its full life cycle: definition, benefits delivery, and closure, sequencing and integrating the constituent projects that comprise the program rather than managing any single project in isolation. · Develop and maintain a program plan that integrates the schedules, budgets, resource plans, and dependencies of multiple concurrent projects, identifying and resolving cross-project conflicts before they surface at the project level. · Establish and manage a program-level risk and issue register, distinguishing risks that originate within a single project from risks that arise from inter dependencies across the programs projects. · Coordinate resource allocation and prioritization across the programs constituent projects, resolving competing demands for shared personnel, vendors, or infrastructure. * Benefits Management · Define the programs intended benefits at initiation and maintain a benefits realization plan that tracks how each constituent project contributes to those benefits over time. · Establish benefit metrics and measurement approaches, monitoring realization throughout the program life cycle rather than only at project closeout. · Identify when a constituent projects outputs are no longer expected to contribute to program benefits, and recommend re-scoping, re-sequencing, or termination of that project accordingly. · Lead the transition of program benefits into sustained operations, working with agency stakeholders to confirm that realized benefits are maintained after program closure. * Stakeholder Engagement · Build and sustain productive working relationships with agency executives, IT directors, business owners, vendors, and VITA leadership across all projects within the program, serving as the primary point of accountability for program-level outcomes. · Develop and execute a program-level stakeholder engagement and communication plan, ensuring that agency executives and VITA leadership receive integrated program status rather than a series of disconnected project updates. · Facilitate program steering committee meetings, cross-project working sessions, and executive briefings, preparing agendas, materials, and follow-up action items that reflect the program as a whole. · Navigate organizational com

title: Epidemiologist
description: Consultant: ELR Dashboards, Rhapsody Certification, SAS 6, SQL Analyst Start date : 12/07/2026 End Date : 12/31/2027 Submission deadline : 12/04/2026 Client Info : TN DOH Note: * Hybrid * Location Requirements: Candidate must be a Tennessee state resident. * All new contractors must be Tennessee residents. Contractors relocating to Tennessee must establish residency prior to their start date. Description: The Tennessee Department of Health (TDH) is currently recruiting an Epidemiologist to assist in the coordination of communicable disease informatics related projects as a part of the Surveillance Systems and Informatics (SSI) Program within the Communicable and Environmental Disease and Emergency Preparedness (CEDEP) Division. This position will serve as an ELR Specialist for the SSI Program. The epidemiologist will support REDCap (Research Electronic Data Capture), Electronic Lab Reporting (ELR), and other SSI informatics projects and initiatives. As a member of the SSI Program, this individual will get exposure and experience in the use and development of interoperability standards, like HL7, and will have the opportunity to work on a wide range of informatics projects including system integration. Job duties will include: Complete ELR onboarding using HL7 2.5.1 standards Provide input on and manage various production monitoring tasks including alerts, dashboard development and maintenance, and issue identification. Complete investigation of ELR processing issues independently and identify proposed solutions. Work collaboratively with Rhapsody developers to enhance existing routes or define new routes for ELR processing. Assist with processing of laboratory data submitted via our alternate file format (i.e., flat file). Coordinate routine and ad hoc management of standard interoperability vocabulary within the disease surveillance system. Act as liaison to downstream users of ELR data within TDH and CEDEP. Support other ELR maintenance tasks (e.g parallel validation, LOINC code assignments, and production errors). Desired Qualifications: Work experience with ELR onboarding and/or maintenance at a state or local health department, 1-3 years. Work experience with Rhapsody or working to define specifications for Rhapsody developers, 1-3 years. Experience writing statistical and analytical programming code in SAS,SQL, or R. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated ability to manage projects.

title: Public Health Program Director 1
description: Consultant: Strategic Leadership, Problem Solving Skills, Public Health Experience, Start date: 12/21/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/27/2026 Client Info : TN DOH Note: *Position Location: Hybrid Description: The Tennessee Department of Health (TDH) is seeking a highly motivated, results-driven leader to serve as the Maternal Health Innovation (MHI) Director within the Division of Family Health and Wellness. This position provides leadership and strategic oversight of Tennessees federally funded Maternal Health Innovation program and related statewide initiatives designed to improve maternal health outcomes and reduce maternal mortality and morbidity. The ideal candidate is a proactive, independent leader who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises sound judgment, and consistently moves work forward with minimal supervision. We are looking for someone who can see the big picture while managing the details, identify challenges before they become barriers, and develop practical solutions that produce measurable results. The MHI Director will lead program staff, oversee complex initiatives, manage grants and contracts, and build strong partnerships with internal and external partners. This position requires someone who is comfortable making decisions, setting priorities, holding themselves and others accountable, and communicating effectively with senior leadership. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership and Program Management • Provide independent leadership and oversight of the HRSA-funded Maternal Health Innovation grant and related maternal health initiatives. • Translate strategic priorities into actionable work plans, measurable objectives, and successful program outcomes. • Proactively identify emerging needs, implementation challenges, and opportunities for innovation and improvement. • Manage multiple complex projects simultaneously, establish priorities, and ensure timely completion of deliverables. • Provide leadership with clear, concise updates on accomplishments, challenges, risks, and recommended solutions. Staff Leadership and Accountability • Lead, supervise, coach, and develop program staff to build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team. • Establish clear expectations, delegate effectively, and monitor progress toward individual and program goals. • Address performance concerns and operational challenges proactively and professionally. • Foster an environment that encourages initiative, problem-solving, professional growth, and continuous improvement. Grant, Contract, and Fiscal Oversight • Ensure compliance with federal and state grant requirements, including reporting, performance measures, and approved work plans. • Oversee program budgets, expenditures, contracts, and procurement activities. • Ensure timely and accurate completion of grant deliverables, financial reports, and other required documentation. • Identify potential compliance or fiscal concerns early and implement appropriate corrective actions. Maternal Health Initiatives and Partnerships • Direct statewide maternal health initiatives, including workforce development, maternal mental health, quality improvement, and evidence-based prevention strategies. • Build and maintain effective partnerships with health systems, healthcare providers, community organizations, state agencies, and national partners. • Support implementation of Tennessees Maternal Health Strategic Plan and alignment of funded activities with statewide priorities. • Lead or coordinate maternal health education, outreach, and communication initiatives. • Collaborate with evaluation and data teams to assess program effectiveness, identify gaps, and use findings to guide improvement. Communication and Representation • Represent TDH in state, regional,

title: Application Developer - UTA-JB
description: Developer: Java, Spring Boot, HTML And CSS, REST APIs CICD GitLab AWS Cloud Platform Start date :1/4/2027 End Date :31/12/2031 Submission deadline :11/27/2026. Client Info : Division of Health & Human Services Note: * Remote, with some in-person meetings (20% onsite / 80% offsite); Cannon Building will be the onsite work location * Utah residents only Description: Client is seeking a skilled and passionate Full Stack Java Developer to support the creation, enhancement, and ongoing maintenance of core application systems for the Office of Vital Records and Statistics (OVRS). In this role, the developer will work with a technical team and stakeholders to build robust, scalable, and secure applications that serve the critical public health infrastructure of Utah. Key Responsibilities: Application Development & Maintenance: Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack web applications supporting various OVRS systems. Backend Engineering: Build secure RESTful APIs and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and modern server-side architecture. Frontend Development: Create responsive, scalable, and user-friendly web interfaces using React (or modern JavaScript frameworks), HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Database Management: Design, query, and maintain relational databases (RDBMS), specifically MySQL and SQL-based environments. DevOps & CI/CD: Utilize version control systems (GitLab, GitHub) and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) for automated integration and deployment. Cloud Infrastructure: Maintain and deploy cloud platform solutions across AWS Cloud services. Quality Assurance: Write unit tests and participate in automated testing frameworks (JUnit or similar) to ensure software reliability and high performance. Collaboration & Support: Work with product owners, technical managers, and cross-functional teams to modernize public health software systems. Required Technical Skills: Core Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, React, PHP, HTML, CSS. APIs & Web Services: Expertise in designing and consuming REST APIs. Database Systems: RDBMS proficiency with a strong emphasis on MySQL and SQL scripting. Version Control & CI/CD: GitLab, GitHub, and Jenkins. Testing & Quality: JUnit or equivalent testing frameworks. Development Tools: Proficient with modern IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, or similar. Cloud Platform: AWS Cloud Platform. UX/UI Design: Experience or interest in UX/UI principles to improve end-user interaction. Domain Knowledge: Experience working with public health data, vital records and statistics processes, data sharing, reporting, and integrations.

Support security and authentication tools such as OKTA and Crowd strike. Maintain knowledge of AWS and SharePoint systems to assist users as needed. Collaborate with IT teams to ensure smooth operation of company-wide systems. * Preferred Qualifications: Some experience in a technical support or help desk role. Strong understanding of Windows 11, Active Directory, and Microsoft O365. Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, VPNs, and IP phone systems. Familiarity with security tools (OKTA, Crowd strike) and cloud environments (AWS). Proficiency with ticket tracking systems and remote support tools. Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or similar are highly desirable. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with users of varying technical expertise. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting issues and resolutions. * Work Schedule: The candidate must be local to Atlanta and be able to come to the office every day to work.

Client Services uses technical expertise and understanding of business needs to evaluate assigned IT incident and problem service desk tickets to appropriately prioritize and evaluate business impact. Proactively promotes positive customer relationships and mentors others to ensure client satisfaction and organizational success. Takes ownership of customer problems and works with a sense of urgency to resolve incidents and problems. Communicates status of progress to the customer. Provides updates on work progress to Customer Support Specialists and the Service Desk using call tracking system. Has significant technical knowledge and serves as a resource for other technicians to help solve complex problems. Skilled in different types of computer hardware, software, peripherals and components, networking protocols and communications. Installs and images new computers and loads appropriate software for customers. Deploys new business applications as needed. Installs local and network printers and other peripherals and configuration of same. Responsible for user data and migration of profiles as computers are replaced. Stays abreast of current technology in a changing environment. Identifies emerging trends and issues, researches and makes suggestions for technical solutions to solve current and future problems. Uses extensive knowledge to develop and/or implement information technology solutions to enhance organizational success. Works with Data Center Operations with user file server data storage, network reservations, data restores, various account creations and modifications (AD, email, NCID, CITRIX, etc.). Works with application development teams to identify application issues at the customer level and provide technical detail in order for development teams to accurately identify problems within applications. Works with network infrastructure teams to identify network issues at the customer level and provide significant technical detail to assist in network hardware resolutions. Project Management - Ability to lead projects that require directing the work of others and with some latitude on actions or decisions. Leads team efforts and assesses and integrates the skills and strengths of individuals for project and organizational success. Provides status on project work to management. Develop and maintain appropriate documentation for all responsible areas - This position is responsible for creating and maintaining all documentation of process and procedures for all areas this position is responsible for. This documentation is to be used by team members for operational standards of daily work. This documentation will also be used in accordance with Operational Level Agreements (IT internal) and Service Level Agreements (IT external). All documentation should be reviewed annually. System Security - It is the responsibility of all Technical Services Staff to be aware of DOT and ITS security policies, as well as the security issues directly affecting the systems and technology for which this position is directly involved. This position is responsible for implementing requirements of the IT Security Office and protecting data from unauthorized access, alteration, destruction, or usage in a manner inconsistent with covered IT Security Policies and standards.

title: Senior Generative AI Developer
description: Developer: Cloud Platforms, AWS, Python Development, SQL Experience Start date : 11/16/2026 End Date : 11/15/2027 Submission deadline : 11/25/2026 Client Info : NCDHHS-NCFAST Note: * Hybrid * Both Phone and In Person Description: NC DHHS requires the services of a Senior Generative AI Developer who is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying production-grade Artificial Intelligence solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), fine-tuning techniques, and secure enterprise data systems. The role requires strong technical skills in Python, cloud-native development, data engineering, and the integration of structured and unstructured databases into AI systems. The developer ensures all AI solutions adhere to organizational standards for security, privacy, compliance, and Responsible AI principles. This position collaborates with engineering, security, data, product, and governance teams to advance scalable, ethical, and secure AI adoption across the organization. The key responsibilities for this position will include the following: · Build and deploy LLM-driven features, prompts, and agent workflows. · Customize models using fine-tuning and adapter techniques. · Develop RAG pipelines using vector, SQL, and NoSQL databases. · Manage secure ingestion of enterprise content with proper metadata and PII protection. · Use relational, NoSQL, and vector databases to support AI workloads. · Apply performance tuning, access control, encryption, and compliant data handling. · Implement AI safety controls and secure model access. · Ensure Responsible AI practices include bias, fairness, and privacy reviews. · Build secure, scalable micro services to integrate AI features into applications. · Implement best practices for reliability, error handling, and observe ability. · Maintain CI/CD pipelines for models and AI services. · Monitor performance, cost, and drift. Support documentation and audit readiness.

The Department is modernizing how these solutions are delivered by pairing business analysis with AI-assisted development, so that requirements gathered from customers can be turned into working, fully functional prototypes in days or weeks rather than months. The candidate also supports continued business systems improvements related to the Financial Management Suite of Systems (FM) as they are used to support OIT, OWPB, and OOC. Provides detailed analysis of complex FM architecture and business functions to prepare efficiency opportunities, assisting in process redesign, data integration, data governance, and system modernization as applicable. Duties may include providing support and analyzing the FM financial systems and dependent business processes and assisting in re-engineering in areas impacted by ongoing business transformations. The candidate will direct development teams in the areas of technical direction, future architecture, and standard development practices, participate in budgeting discussions as required, and lead quality improvement activities for the development organization. Description: Scope of Services: Background: The Department has identified Human Resources (HR) business process modernization needs to better serve all business units. The HR Office and Office of Work Program and Budget (OWPB) have jointly prioritized an HR workflow automation platform. HR Automation platform consists of multiple modules such as Position Description, Classification actions, Request for Pay Actions, Onboarding and Offboarding, Authorization to Fill Vacancy and more to support HR office operations. These workflows currently move through multiple systems and communication exchanges contributing to operational inefficiencies including elevated time-to-fill metrics and limited visibility into rate-impact reporting obligations. This initiative will deliver a custom application similar to an existing internal automation platform using ReactJS and .NET Clean Architecture, extending current capabilities. Problem Statement: The selected candidate will be assigned to support requirements gathering and analysis, backlog management and quality assurance for the HR Automation initiative in collaboration with the HR Office and Office of Work Program and Budget. The candidate will serve as the primary liaison between OWPB Systems Support and HR subject-matter experts, translating HR business intent to actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Quality assurance and user acceptance testing will play a vital part of the overall delivery to ensure any discrepancies or gaps that may arise during implementation are quickly and properly addressed. As part of this effort, the candidate will participate in iterative release planning, support stakeholder engagement across HR and OWPB, and produce documentation that supports both the development team and end users. The selected candidate will be given access to existing source documentation and project staff, and will be required to identify functional gaps, develop, and document all activities necessary for successful implementation. Education: Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Systems, or financial related field and 6 years professional work experience. Work experience can substitute on a year for year basis for the degree. Special consideration will be given to candidates with Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification, or similar business analysis and quality assurance certifications. Experience: Candidate must have a minimum of 6 years of experience in business analysis, requirements engineering and quality assurance documentation. This experience must also be in a professional environment, preferably workflow automation, human resources systems, or state government applications. Candidate will be expected to describe multiple past experiences with business analysis tools and methodologies, and how they were deployed for a successful outcome that met customers objectives. Primary Job Duties / Tasks: The submitted candidate must be able to perform the following duties and/or tasks. Duties of the selected candidate will include, but not be limited to: 1. Coordinate the development of project schedules, implementation plans, and documentation for HR automation release

title: Programmer 5 /PR5
description: Consultant: Application Development, Support, COBOL Development, IMS JCL Production Support Start date : 01/01/2027 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/26/2026 Client Info : JFS Note: * Interviews: Teams * Remote * Local candidates preffered Description: Senior Application Support Analyst / Developer Position Overview The Ohio Department of Job & Family Services (ODJFS),Office of Information Services, is seeking an experienced Senior Application Support/ Developer to support the Support Enforcement Tracking System (SETS)modernized platform. The SETS application was originally developed using COBOL,IMS, and JCL on the mainframe and has been modernized to a Microsoft Azure cloud-based architecture utilizing C#, .NET, and SQL Server. While the application now operates on a modern technology platform, many business processes, program structures, transaction flows, batch patterns, and data access methods reflect the original mainframe design. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in COBOL, IMS, and JCL and be capable of applying that knowledge to analyze, troubleshoot, enhance, and support the modernized .NET application. This position requires the ability to bridge legacy and modern technologies, perform detailed application analysis, support production operations, resolve complex system issues, and work collaboratively with technical and business teams supporting critical statewide services. This is not a traditional COBOL developer position. The application has been modernized to C#/.NET and SQL Server in Azure. However,successful candidates must possess strong COBOL, IMS, and JCL expertise because the applications design patterns, business rules, batch processing concepts,and data access methods originate from the legacy mainframe implementation. * Key Responsibilities Modernized SETS Application Support Monitor and support daily batch processing activities and critical business workflows. Analyze and resolve production incidents, application failures, data issues, and system performance concerns. Perform impact analysis and root cause analysis for reported defects and operational issues. Support application releases, deployments, and post-implementation validation activities. Participate in on-call support and after-hours production support activities as required. Analyze and support a modernized SETS application operating in Microsoft Azure using C#, .NET, and SQL Server. Utilize COBOL, IMS, and JCL expertise to understand and support business processes and application logic that originated in the legacy mainframe environment. Interpret legacy program designs, processing flows, batch schedules, and data structures to diagnose production issues and support enhancements. Work with developers, architects, and business analysts to translate legacy processing logic into modern technical solutions. Analyze system interfaces, batch processing workflows, and data movement processes between applications and external partners. * Required Skills & Qualifications 10+ years of application development and support experience. Extensive experience with COBOL development in large-scale enterprise environments. Strong experience with IMS databases and transaction processing. Strong experience with JCL, batch scheduling, and production support. Experience supporting applications that have been migrated or modernized from COBOL/mainframe technologies to .NET, SQL Server or cloud-based platforms. Experience interpreting legacy COBOL programs and translating business logic into modern application environments. Experience with relational databases and SQL development. Experience troubleshooting complex production incidents and performing root cause analysis. <

description: Consultant: Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Problem Solving Skills Start date : 01/01/2027 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline :11/30/2026 Client Info : NCDIT-HIEA Note: *Remote *Webcam Interview Only Description: NC HIEA operates NC HealthConnex, the state-designated health information exchange supporting secure electronic sharing of health data across North Carolina. The unit connects healthcare organizations, improves data quality, and advances statewide interoperability initiatives that enhance care coordination and public health outcomes. The Junior Data Scientist supports operational, analytical, and quality improvement initiatives within NC HIEA. Responsibilities include cleaning, valdating, transforming, and summarizing data; monitoring automated workflows; troubleshooting pipeline issues; merging complex files; and contributing to dashboards, automations, and integrated reporting processes. The position will identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve operational workflows, reduce repetitive tasks through automation, and support continuous process improvement initiatives. The Junior Data Scientist will also support KPI initiatives and report development, including dashboards for executive and operations reporting. This role will support recurring monthly reporting systems, documentation efforts, development of standard operating procedures, and implementation of efficient, scalable business processes. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Data Tools • Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and merging complex datasets • Familiarity with Power BI, Smartsheet, Tableau, and Salesforce reporting tools • Familiarity with basic SQL queries and data extraction techniques • Ability to use data and reporting tools to improve efficiency and automate routine processes Process Improvement & Workflow Optimization • Ability to analyze business processes and identify opportunities for workflow improvements and operational efficiencies • Experience documenting, standardizing, and optimizing manual processes • Ability to develop repeatable, scalable solutions that improve data quality, consistency, and operational performance • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on reducing manual effort and improving process effectiveness Productivity & Project Tools • Basic familiarity with Jira and Asana • Ability to track operational work, reporting requirements, and process improvement initiatives through project management tools Growth Mindset • Curious, proactive, and effective at problem solving • Demonstrates initiative in identifying process inefficiencies and recommending practical solutions Education and Experience Required Education: • Bachelors degree in health informatics, Statistics, Data Science, Public Health, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience: • Experience working with operational and healthcare data in academic projects, internships, or professional roles • Experience cleaning data, merging files, and preparing structured datasets for reporting and analysis • Familiarity with Salesforce for pulling reports, reviewing data fields, or supporting basic operational workflows • Experience documenting processes, procedures, or workflows in SOPs • Basic understanding of SQL for simple querying, filtering, and data extraction • Experience supporting recurring reporting tasks or monthly data cycles • Exposure to dashboard creation using Power BI, Smartsheet, Tableau, or similar reporting tools • Experience identifying opportunities to streamline operational processes and reduce manual effort • Exp

Description: Client is seeking a Senior Gen Technical Consultant to provide expert technical support to enhance, maintain and operate the development environment for an in-house application. The application utilizes Broadcom Gen, including dependent and related software in a large-scale, complex client (Windows) / server (IBM zOS mainframe) technical environment. ENVIRONMENT: N-FOCUS (Nebraska Family Online Client User System) is an in-house integrated system that automates benefit/service delivery and case management for several Nebraska Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) programs. The application is comprised of the following components; batch, online, and web. NFOCUS data is stored in DB2 database. The primary role of the N-FOCUS team today is to maintain and enhance the N FOCUS application. This includes providing users with technical and business support to keep the system current with government policy and industry technology, both of which continue to change at a rapid pace. Business and technical contract and full-time State team members are organized into teams that are involved in application development (Gen, AION, COBOL, Web, Reporting), technical architecture (workstation communications, mainframe communications, print architecture, reporting architecture administration, document imaging administration), database administration, configuration management, project management, business requirements and testing, application and production support, and training. Approximately 30 technical and 30 business team members are assigned to the N-FOCUS team. SKILL REQUIREMENTS: Client prefers a candidate that possesses the skills and experience that span both the GEN client/server development and encyclopedia tools and the zOS GEN Implementation Toolset (IT). The candidate will: work as part of a small team that provides development environment support, configuration management, Gen encyclopedia management, release management and application architecture support provide depth to the small team across a range of N-FOCUS applications architecture and development environment support tasks lead enhancement projects for development work to the GEN platform of the N-FOCUS application create solutions and development of the technical design documentation. Assist with incremental modernization options for the Broadcom GEN portfolio. Required: Significant experience with large-scale, complex GEN application environments. Experience with the GEN Workstation/Toolset and Workstation/Build Tools. At least 3 years software development experience (subsetting and coding) with the Gen toolset in a client/server GUI environment. Experience must be current (within the last year) and must be in support of a large-scale, complex application system with a Microsoft Windows client and a relational database server. Experience with DB2 relational databases, including logical design, understanding of physical design components, and complex SQL statements Experience in debugging CICS Command level application, CUC, and CICS Transaction Gateway Strong verbal and written communication skills, including demonstrated experience in gathering requirements from a diverse audience, both business and technical. Strong organization, planning, problem solving, and decision making skills. Comfortable prioritizing and managing multiple tasks and projects. Preferred: Experience with state Health & Human Services systems requirements and portfolios, particularly in

description: Analyst: Access Controls, Active Directory, Troubleshoot, Access Management Start date :12/14/2026 End Date :06/30/2027 Submission deadline :11/30/26 at 4:00 PM CST Client Info : DHS Note: * Interview Process: Microsoft Teams with video required. One Round Interview. AI usage during the interview is prohibited. Real-Time Screenshots will be required for Interviews. * Candidate MUST be a WI resident, No relocation is allowed. * This role is 100% remote within the state of WI. Candidate will need to be onsite Day 1 12/14 to retrieve equipment. Description: Top 3-4 skills required for the position: Experience with Access Control Management (ACM), and applying ACM best practices in account provisioning, password resets, and other account management processes. Experience with Microsoft Active Directory account provisioning. Experience in troubleshooting Identity and Access Management issues for software. Experience with documenting process or procedures. Nice to have skills: Experience supporting access to Microsoft O365 suite of services. Experience with Microsoft Active Directory account provisioning in a multi-domain or multi-directory environment. Experience using PowerShell to provide account information. Detailed Job Description: This Security Analyst position is part a dynamic and versatile team that concentrates on Access Control Management (ACM), and applying ACM best practices in account provisioning, password resets, and other account management processes in a multi-domain organization. The position will report to the BITS Section Manager or Supervisor overseeing the Access and Identity Management Support team (AIMS), this position will function as an Access and Identity Management Administrator for The Department of Health Services. The AIMS team is positioned within the Customer Services Section (CSS) in the Bureau of Information Technology Services (BITS). The team is responsible for provisioning and de-provisioning account and data permissions for our agencys Customers and Partners needing access to various technology environments and associated data. This position will work with team members, project staff, and other stakeholders to improve and integrate AIMS processes. This position will also assist in the development and updating of documentation. Technologies include, but are not limited to, Active Directory, Entra (Azure) Active Directory, Dynamics 365, ticket tracking systems such as Ivanti Neurons, and use of general office tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. This position requires strong customer service skills, communication, organizational skills, and prioritization skills. A good candidate will have the ability to work with minimal supervision, switch between multiple tasks as needed, ability to work within a team and as an individual, and the ability to generate or update documentation. Rotating 24x7 on call will be required. Selected candidates must provide 3 references with 2 that have supervised the candidate. Special qualifications & years of experience: Required Qualification Experience Active Directory Users and Computer utility 5 years Access Control Management, and applying ACM best practices in account provisioning, 5 years Microsoft Entra (Azure) cloud services 5 years Change management controls within a Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) ticketing system like Ivanti Neurons, ServiceNow, or a Change Management Database (CMDB) system. 5 years Microsoft Office Suite (i.e. Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.) 5 years Business communication principles and techniques 5 years Requested software or tools experience Cayosoft experience provisioning accounts Salesforce user and profile managemen

description: Analyst: User Interface, Testing Background, SQL Server, Visio Bachelors Degree Start date :12/28/2026 End Date :12 Months from projected start date Submission deadline :11/30 at 5:00 PM EST. Client Info : DSS Note: * Interview Process: 1 round, virtual * Work Location: Role is hybrid (3 days onsite per week) - subject to change to fully onsite with little to no notice. * Candidate location: Candidate MUST be a SC resident or willing to relocate to SC prior to starting the role at their own expense. Description: This position primarily serves as a Business Analyst for the child support and new hire portals while also providing Help Desk support when needed to ensure effective end-user assistance and operational continuity. Business Analyst: • Collaborate with Functional Leads, Business Analysts, and Development Teams to translate business requirements into detailed user stories and technical solutions. • Participate in the redesign and enhancement of the South Carolina New Hire (SC New Hire) website, incorporating new features and improving overall user experience. • Analyze business processes and develop workflows and user stories to enhance functionality and usability for employers, administrators, and other stakeholders. • Provide application support to SC New Hire administrative users by troubleshooting issues and facilitating timely resolution. • Perform backend data analysis, identify trends, and conduct root cause analysis to support problem resolution and system improvements. • Review business requirements, component designs, and use cases to ensure quality and maintain end-to-end test script traceability. • Develop, execute, and document test plans, test cases, and other required testing activities to ensure application quality and reliability. • Support testing activities for the PACSS application, including system validation, defect identification, and issue resolution as needed. • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of application enhancements and system upgrades. • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize business processes, workflows, and user experience. • Serve as a secondary resource for Help Desk functions, including incident intake, troubleshooting, customer support, issue documentation, and escalation coordination during periods of increased demand or staff absence. 3. Required Qualifications: • 2+ years of experience evaluating and improving website design, including user experience (UX), user interface (UI), and content structure. • 2+ years of experience testing back-end batch processes and able to verify/handle the output data files. • 2+ years of experience using SQL to query and analyze data. • 2+ years of experience with SQL Server • 3+ years of experience with Visio or similar workflow tools • 2+ years of experience with SharePoint • Completed Bachelors degree 4. Desired Qualifications & Education: • Experience with a state new hire application or employer management system. • Experience with Microsoft Team Foundation Server (TFS) • Experience with Azure DevOps • Experience with Child Support Systems Soft Skills: • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills with patience and a customer-friendly approach. • Ability to identify, interpret, and communicate business-process training to appropriate audiences. • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and verbal and written communication with customers, project staff, and stakeholders.

title: UGA IT Project Manager
description: Manager: IT Project Manager, Communication, Analytical Skills, Smartsheet Start date : 01/04/2027 End Date : 12/29/2028 Submission deadline : 11/23/2026 Client Info : UGA Note: *Remote *Either Web Cam or In Person Description: The University System of Georgia (USG) Unified ERP Program is a multi-year program to replace the current institutional legacy systems for human capital management and financials improving the experience for students, faculty, and staff; streamlining core business processes; and unifying technology into a single, Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. This position is one of four limited term positions which there will be an active recruitment process. This program will require University of Georgia (UGA) to develop strategies and plans regarding system integrations, data cleansing and conversion, historical data plans, reporting requirements, and technically focused tasks. As such, there is a need to have a dedicated project manager focused specifically on these technical areas and ensure UGA is positioned to successfully manage the technical transitions. Position Summary This role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of a major ERP transformation. This position plays a critical role in the implementation and optimization of a large-scale ERP system, with a strong emphasis on project delivery. This position will provide support to the UGA Unified Team Project Director, Change Management Lead, Program Manager, and Project Facilitators for Finance, Human Resources, Service Delivery, and Change Management. Job responsibilities and percentage of time may evolve based on project needs. The IT Project Manager will lead and coordinate planning, execution, and delivery of UGA enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence initiatives. This role engages with cross-functional teams responsible for data architecture, ETL development, data integration, reporting, analytics, and cloud-based data platforms. complex technical workstreams, including system integrations, data cleansing and conversion, historical data plans, reporting requirements, and related technical deliverables. By applying rigorous project management practices and a deep understanding of enterprise systems, this role ensures the successful planning, execution, and delivery of ERP-related technical initiatives. Working closely with IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, the position supports the comprehensive technical strategy of enterprise data and systems. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a technically complex environment and is motivated by delivering reliable, scalable solutions that enable enterprise-wide operations and decision-making. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities •Strong understanding of project management principles and methodologies •Excellent facilitation skills along with written and verbal communication skills •Ability to develop planning materials and facilitate cross-functional technical sessions •Strong organizational and analytical skills •Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs •Strong ability to influence without direct authority and build relationships across diverse stakeholder groups •Knowledge of Workday, Smartsheet, and/or PeopleSoft Duties/Responsibilities 1. Project Management (60%) Apply formal project management principles and practices during the planning, implementation, monitoring and completion of projects •Create detailed project plans for completion of tasks that consider schedules, dependencies, institutional priorities, and resource limitations and conflicts •Coordinate efforts of project teams to facilitate cooperation and prevent delays •Develop and maintain standard project management documentation, such as project charters, project plans, timeline visuals, risk registers, issues

title: Application Developer - SLDS Data Engineer
description: Developer: CDE’S Privacy And Governance Programs, CI/CD, GIT, Workflow ETL ELT Start date : 01/04/2027 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/24/2026 Client Info : CO OIT Note: *Location Requirements: Candidate must be local or willing to commute or relocate, Candidate must be within 100 miles. *Work Arrangement: Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates). Information Security Training Description: The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line-of-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists. In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS / COdata) an OIT Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The OIT Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge-transfer progression (shadowing, co-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer. Scope of Responsibilities: Data Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model. Transformation & Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect. Record Linkage & Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross-agency reconciliations. Production Pipeline Operations & Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects. Data Quality & Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes). Performance Optimization & Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake. Quality Assurance, Code Review & Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs. Activities Performed: A. Ingestion & Pipeline Development (OIT-Led Feeds) CDHE Courses Data Ingestion: Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements. Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner. Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion. Postsecondary SES & Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional): Ingest and validate d

title: UGA Database Architect
description: Architect: Data Warehouse, Data Lake Configuration, Analytics, Data Platform Integration Data Governanc Start date : 1/4/2027 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/23/2026 Client Info : UGA Note: * Remote * Either Web Cam or In Person Description: The University System of Georgia (USG) Unified ERP Program is replacing legacy systems for human capital management, financials, and student information with a unified Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. The transition requires University of Georgia (UGA) to sustain operational and analytical reporting while establishing a future-state data warehouse and integration foundation. The Data Warehouse Architect will provide dedicated expertise for this work, reducing reporting disruption and supporting reliable access to institutional data during and after implementation. Position Summary The Data Warehouse Architect will establish the future-state reporting and analytics architecture for UGAs transition to Workday. The role will define how Workday reporting, the institutional data warehouse, data lake services, legacy data, and downstream analytics fit together. Working with information technology and project stakeholders, the Architect will set design standards and document a practical roadmap that supports report redevelopment, reliable data access, and long-term institutional use. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities · Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data warehousing, and modern data lake patterns · Knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata, privacy, and access control principles · Ability to evaluate integration and data consumption approaches for reliability, scalability, and maintainability · Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and communication skills · Ability to work across technical teams, reporting teams, vendors, and campus stakeholders · Ability to balance immediate transition needs with sustainable future-state design Duties/Responsibilities Architecture and Strategy (40%) · Develop the Workday reporting and data warehouse architecture strategy, including data flows, integration patterns, and data consumption approaches. · Define the target-state data warehouse design and the role of data lake services in supporting reporting and analytics. · Create architecture documentation, design standards, and a phased technical roadmap for implementation. Data Governance and Legacy Data Planning (30%) · Recommend data governance standards covering ownership, definitions, quality, metadata, access, and appropriate use. · Develop an approach for retaining and accessing legacy data needed for historical, operational, and analytical reporting. · Assess architectural options and document assumptions, dependencies, risks, and decisions for project leadership. Technical Design and Implementation Guidance (20%) · Guide integration and warehouse design decisions and review technical solutions for alignment with the approved architecture. · Partner with the Feed Engineer and report development team to ensure data structures and feeds support prioritized reporting needs. · Advise on data quality validation, testing, deployment, and production support approaches. Stakeholder Collaboration and Knowledge Transfer (10%) · Facilitate architecture discussions with business and technical stakeholders and communicate design recommendations clearly. · Maintain architecture records and transfer knowledge to staff responsible for ongoing operations. Physical Demands Work is primarily performed in an office setting, involving extended periods of sitting and computer use. The position may require occasional in-person meetings with project and campus stakeholders. Impact and Influence <br

title: IT Sourcing Consultant 2
description: Consultant: IT Sourcing Consultant, CMS, MES Certification, MMIS APD Bachelors Degree Start date : 12/14/2026 End Date : 04/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/25/2026 10:00:00 AM Client Info : DHHS Note: *Interview Process: 1 round virtual. *-Hybrid Work Schedule: Mondays and Tuesday are REQUIRED in-office days and cannot be altered. There is NO remote only option. *-Local candidates vs non-local: Open to candidates local to the Lansing, Michigan area (within 150 miles) Description: IT Sourcing Consultant 2 - Position requires a proven ability to lead development and execution of complex sourcing strategies for assigned projects and consulting with customers to solve IT business problems. Conducts meaningful market research and works with business owners to develop sourcing scope, timelines and deliverables. Ability to gather and analyze information on vendor capabilities, pricing approaches, implementation models, and performance across multiple states to support alternative evaluations Has responsibility for proactively managing customer expectations for project deliverables through effective and timely communications to various levels of senior management. Familiarity with Medicaid Enterprise Systems, MMIS platforms, major vendors, modernization efforts, and current market trends is critical to producing realistic comparisons. Ability to gather and analyze information on vendor capabilities, pricing approaches, implementation models, and performance across multiple states to support alternative evaluations. The request specifically seeks information from other states and industry benchmarks. Conduct post-project lessons learned reviews with the customers to promote knowledge transfer and customer satisfaction. Must convert research, cost data, and market findings into clear recommendations, decision matrices, risk assessments, and executive-level briefing materials suitable for MDHHS, DTMB & CMS review. Required Education: -Bachelors Degree Required skills -10+ years of IT Sourcing Consulting experience - Experience and familiarity with CMSs Analysis of Alternatives template and MMIS RFP Cost Benefit Analysis. -Medicaid Enterprise Systems (MES/MMIS) consulting experience and CMS Advanced Planning Document (APD) support experience. -Medicaid consulting expertise to assist in gathering industry information and providing a total cost of ownership and Cost Benefit Analysis for RFP alternatives identified as well as corresponding data for other Medicaid States MMIS operational and RFP investments. Deliverables to include but not limited to: a) Total Cost of Ownership and Cost Benefit Analysis evaluation comparison for each of MIs proposed MMIS Alternatives and b) a matrix of Medicaid State Operational and RFP investments with current MMIS vendor comparison. As part of a larger Medicaid System IT RFP Project for the Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) known as CHAMPS, the State is federally required by CMS to do an Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) and a cost benefit analysis (CBA) to determine RFP approaches/alternatives (i.e... full replacement, partial replacement, Maintenance and Operations takeover, etc.). The AoA must include an evaluation of potential timelines, costs, business impacts, market research etc. Business and Technical project team members have already completed the majority of the AoA work, however the total cost of ownership/cost benefits of each alternative and corresponding other Medicaid State MMIS investment information and national trends is a key component that is not able to be attained within MI team members knowledge set or existing market research. The project team is looking to engage Medicaid consulting expertise to assist in gathering industry information and providing MI with a total cost of ownership and cost

title: Security Analyst/Technical Support Analyst 3
description: Analyst: Healthcare IT, Strong Analytical And Conceptual Skills, Problem Solving Skills, TroubleShooting Skills IT Team Complianc Start date : 11/30/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/23/2026 Client Info : VDH Note: * Hybrid * In Person Only Description: The Virginia Department of Health (VDH) enterprise level EHR Security Analyst will be responsible for supporting the security, access, and user provisioning requirements of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) environment along with providing support tier 1 to the EHR end users on related areas. This position provides technical and functional support for EHR security configuration, user access, security roles, authentication, auditing, and access-related troubleshooting. The Security Analyst works with clinical, operational, information technology, privacy, compliance, and application support teams to ensure users have appropriate access to EHR applications based on their job responsibilities and organizational policies. The EHR Security Support Analyst provides technical and functional security support for the Cerner Electronic Health Record environment. This role is responsible for maintaining appropriate user access, supporting security configuration, monitoring access-related activities, troubleshooting security issues, and assisting with the implementation and sustainment of EHR security controls. The EHR security Support Analyst is responsible for managing and help define user access policies, security policies and role-based permissions within the EHR. This role will work closely with the EHR Application team, ISO Team and HIPAA compliance officer among others to ensure that the application is compliance with HIPAA standards, organizational security policies and best practices. Key Responsibilities · Map and maintaining EHR positions definitions, which includes, Millenium Positions, Preferences and OHPAC Security groups with VDH Positions. · Reviews and processes EHR access requests in accordance with established policies, procedures, organizational standards, and role-based access requirements. · Creates, modifies, and terminates user access based on approved requests and established processes. Monitor and enforce appropriate use of EHR Access Control Positions and Policies, ensuring that users have the correct level of access based on their roles and their job functions. Work with EHR Security Officer, IT Technical team, Support Team and EHR Core team to help define and automate user provisioning and off boarding procedures. Monitor and conduct internal security audits of the EHR application to identify and mitigate risks and/or vulnerabilities detected. Work with EHR Security Officer to develop and maintain security policies, procedure and guidelines related to the Application. Work with EHR Security Officer and ISO Office and EHR Core team to define and complete security documentation and downtime procedures according with VDH Security guidelines. Work with EHR Security Officer to respond and investigate security incidents related to EHR Application ensuring timely resolution and proper reporting to stakeholders. Collaborate with the EHR implementation and optimization teams to ensure that security measures are integrated into the deployment of new features, updates, and third-party applications. Stay informed about emerging security threats, technologies, and best practices related to EHR systems. Recommend improvements and optimizations to the EHR security environment based on industry trends and emerging threats. Monitor user behavior by using tools like P2Sentinel to determine trends and possible incidents. Work with EHR Security Officer and EHR Core team to assist on internal and external audits. Participate in Cerner/OHPAC upgrades, security patches and system maintenance

description:
===============================================================
POSITION & CLIENT OVERVIEW
===============================================================
• Position Title: Senior Project Manager
• Client / Agency: Direct Client

• Target Start Date: 01/01/2027
• Target End Date: 11/30/2029

===============================================================
PROJECT SUMMARY & OBJECTIVE
===============================================================
State of Connecticut, Criminal Justice Information System (CJIS-CT) Governing Board: CJIS-CT Senior Project Manager (Renewal)

Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection, CJIS-CT Governing Board, 55 Farmington Avenue, 11th Floor, Hartford, CT 06105. On-site and remote support.

===============================================================
KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
===============================================================
• Project/System Overview

The Connecticut Information Sharing System (CISS) provides an integrated solution for sharing criminal justice information (CJI) among Connecticut criminal justice agencies, in full compliance with state and federal CJIS Security Policies.
• Scope of Work

The CJIS-CT Sr.
• Project Manager provides operational coordination, leadership, and technical understanding for project management functions of CISS; ensures the project schedule and budget set by the CJIS-CT Board and CISS Executive Director are implemented; and aligns stakeholder and user requirements with the direction of the CISS Program Manager and Executive Director.
• The role collaborates with all State of Connecticut criminal justice agency stakeholders to analyze, document, and disseminate requirements, and requires experience in both project management and software application development.
• Specific Services Required

Oversee coordination and delivery of all project management activities and deliverables

Assist the CISS delivery team with System Development Methodology (SDM) compliance

Create, execute, and revise project work plans; identify resources and assign responsibilities

Ensure deliverables are complete and accurate before release to the user community

Oversee system and user test plans and coordinate user acceptance testing

Keep project documents complete, current, and stored appropriately; enforce project standards

Develop risk mitigation strategies; report on project health, budget, schedule, and team performance

Maintain the project notebook/website and present project status to the Executive Director or Program Manager

Provide input to the biennial budget and the quadrennial CJIS-CT Strategic Business and Technology Plan

Develop and maintain a Project Communication Plan; motivate the team and remove obstacles

Design technical workflows from business requirements; resolve design ambiguities; coordinate design reviews

Work with CJIS-CT stakeholders and vendors to document technical requirements; document CISS Information Exchange XML schemas

Document SOPs for CISS, Racial Profiling, dashboards, and operational documents; establish relationships between organizations

Perform other duties as assigned by the Executive Director or Program Manager

Additional Services Required

Training: project manager for agency role training under CJIS-CT Security Policies

Onboarding: commence CISS onboarding for the Metropolitan Transportation Authority and Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

PMO Support: project charters, use-case templates, implementation plans, RACI, onboarding/approval workflows, SOPs, audit/reconciliation procedures, resource estimates, risk/issue escalations, and cross-agency decision records

Clean Slate: additional Senior PM for the Clean Slate initiative, including readiness for individual police departments

Division of Public Defender Services: Senior PM for the Public Defender CISS Workf

===============================================================
REQUIRED TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES
===============================================================
• SOA
• Data Modeling
• UML
• Microsoft Project

===============================================================
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & DOMAIN SKILLS
===============================================================
• XML
• Risk Management

description: Expert: Apache Hive, SQL Database, Cloudera Management, Linux Administration Start date :12/14/2026 End Date :12/31/2027 Submission deadline :11/25/2026 Client Info : NeDHHS Note: * Position Location: Remote Description: We are seeking a Senior Scala Developer with 7+ years of hands-on Scala application development experience to develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance an enterprise Medicaid encounter-processing application. The application ingests, validates, transforms, and processes healthcare encounter data and related reference information using Scala and Apache Spark for data processing, Drools for business rules, and Apache Hive and HDFS for data access and storage. The successful candidate will actively write and debug production code, implement business-rule changes, resolve processing defects, and improve application reliability and performance. Key Responsibilities: • Design, write, debug, test, refactor, and enhance Scala/Spark application code for encounter processing and related data flows. • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Drools business rules and their integration with Scala processing logic. • Build and maintain data access, ingestion, and transformation logic using Hive tables, HiveQL/SQL, and HDFS-based files. • Investigate failed processing jobs, incorrect outputs, data discrepancies, and performance bottlenecks; implement and validate code-level fixes. • Analyze source-to-target mappings, input files, intermediate datasets, and downstream dependencies to support end-to-end processing. • Participate directly in code reviews, unit and integration testing, builds, Git-based version control, deployments, and production defect resolution. • Document code changes, rule behavior, test results, and troubleshooting procedures; coordinate with platform teams when issues involve infrastructure. Required Skills & Experience: • Minimum 7 years of hands-on Scala application development experience, with recent, demonstrable contributions to production code. • Strong ability to independently develop, maintain, debug, and optimize Scala applications; this is an active coding position. • Practical experience building and troubleshooting Apache Spark batch-processing applications. • Experience developing or maintaining Drools rules (including DRL and integration with application logic). • Working knowledge of Apache Hive, HiveQL/SQL, table structures, partitions, and data validation. • Hands-on experience reading, writing, and troubleshooting files and data paths in HDFS. • Ability to trace and resolve issues across application code, rules, SQL, and input/output datasets. • Experience with Linux command-line tools, Git, and production application support. Highly Desirable & Preferred Qualifications: • HIGHLY DESIRABLE: Direct hands-on experience developing or maintaining Medicaid encounter-processing applications, including encounter validation, transformations, business rules, and submission workflows. Familiarity with managed care encounter data, healthcare claims, and data-quality requirements is a significant advantage. • Familiarity with Cloudera CDP or a comparable Hadoop-based environment for application execution, logs, and troubleshooting; cluster administration expertise is not required. • Exposure to job orchestration tools (such as Rundeck), YARN, AWS EC2/S3, or IBM DataStage. • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD practices, and application performance optimization.
