title: ABC - Cybersecurity Engineer 4
description: Engineer: Incident Response Software, -, -, Start date : 1/4/2027 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 11/24/2026 *Deadline to submit: Tuesday, 11/24 by 4 pm EST Client Info : ABC Note: * Hybrid * Web Cam Interview Only * DAYS ON SITE: 3 days/week Description: * ABOUT THE ROLE ABC is looking for an Expert Cybersecurity Engineer (12+ yrs) who can develop cyber defense solutions, perform network security analysis and preliminary incident response, and support IAM, vulnerability, patch, and monitoring operations and strategic initiatives. The Cybersecurity Engineer will work as a senior member of Virginia ABCs In formation Security Operations team, splitting time between day-to-day security operations and longer-term security improvement work. A typical day starts with reviewing security alerts and events from overnight in the SIEM and endpoint security tools. The engineer triages anything that needs attention, investigates suspicious activity, and conducts preliminary incident response when needed, including gathering evidence, recommending containment, and escalating according to established procedures. They review threat intelligence and security advisories to find new threats relevant to the agencys environment. Through the rest of the day, the engineer works on reducing the teams operational backlog. This includes analyzing vulnerability scan results, prioritizing findings by risk and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, and verifying that fixes are complete. They support patch and configuration management by reviewing compliance, helping resolve failed deployments, and working through exceptions for systems that cant be patched right away. On the identity side, they review access and privileged account activity and support access governance tasks. The engineer also contributes to strategic security initiatives. This includes designing and implementing security controls and improvements, tuning and building detection rules, improving log coverage, and helping mature security processes. They perform in-depth network and system security analysis to find weaknesses and recommend fixes. All work follows the agencys change management process. The engineer writes and maintains technical documentation, including procedures, run books, and configuration standards, and works with IT infrastructure, endpoint, and application teams to put security changes in place. They work independently, manage several priorities at once, provide guidance to team members, and report progress to the Assistant Director of Information Security Operations. * Position Summary Virginia ABCs Information Security Operations team is seeking an expert-level Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen the agencys cyber defense posture. The engineer will design, implement, and support security solutions across the enterprise, perform in-depth security analysis, and help the team carry out operational security work and strategic initiatives. The position calls for a highly skilled professional who can work independently in a complex, highly secure government environment and contribute across multiple security disciplines. * Key Responsibilities • Design, implement, and maintain advanced cyber defense solutions and security changes across the enterprise infrastructure, making sure systems are built to specification and deployed successfully. • Safeguard the enterprise infrastructure against unauthorized intrusion and data exfiltration. • Design, maintain, and operate security controls within highly complex, highly secure network and communications environments. • Perform in-depth network and system security analysis to find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and threats to the organizations security posture. <br

CommonHelp is a public-facing application used by Virginia residents to apply for, renew, and report changes for public-benefit programs. This position requires a highly skilled senior developer who can work independently, analyze complex business and technical requirements, and develop secure, scalable, and maintainable Java-based solutions. Review business requirements, functional designs, and screen mockups to identify technical impacts, dependencies, gaps, and risks. Translate approved business requirements into detailed technical designs and reliable software solutions. Integrate CommonHelp with internal and external systems using secure and supportable integration methods. Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code that complies with established development and security standards. Create and execute unit tests and support system, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, and user-acceptance testing. Perform other technical duties necessary to support CommonHelp and related agency initiatives. Required Qualifications Extensive professional experience designing and developing enterprise-level Java applications. Advanced experience with Java and object-oriented programming concepts. Candidates could be asked to provide proof of residency. Description: The Wisconsin Elections Commission is charged under Wisconsin Statutes to administer and enforce Wisconsins elections laws. A core mission of the Commission is to ensure ongoing and quality education, training, outreach, technical assistance, and advice to municipal clerks, county clerks, and local election inspectors (poll workers) that conduct elections as well as to ensure adherence to, and compliance with Wisconsin election laws and required procedures. Another core function of the Commission is to provide current and accurate information to the public as well as various governmental and other organizations about the States electoral processes, voting statistics, and trends. Under the supervision of the IT Project Manager and IT Director, this position functions as part of the Information Technology team and is a resource for other developers and elections specialists. This position will develop a high-level working knowledge of federal and state election laws, administrative rules and business processes to effectively interpret and apply these requirements to our statewide voter registration database web application. Under general supervision, the .NET Web Developer will serve as the main UI developer for the redesign and redevelopment of the WisVote system, ensuring it remains secure, reliable, and accessible for Wisconsins election officials. This role focuses on building and enhancing web applications using .NET and C#, maintaining compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, and delivering a smooth, user-friendly experience for users across the state. The developer will help with technical planning and coordination efforts with the WEC technology team, participating in the development, testing, and implementation focusing mainly on the front-end development of WisVote using tools such as ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL Server, and Git/Azure DevOps to create a modern, efficient, and sustainable system that supports Wisconsins election administration now and in the future. This position requires compliance with the agencys timekeeping system to ensure that tasks performed qualify under federal funding guidelines or that work representing State initiatives is tracked contemporaneously and is properly accounted for using State funds. Position Description: .NET Web Developer II Duties and Responsibilities Serve as a member of the agencys information technology team and ensure quality and consistency of the software architecture across the system. 1. Develop and maintain a high-level working knowledge of all elections laws governing responsibilities of state and local election officials and voters, as it relates to information technology systems. 2. Serve as primary developer over the front-end development for the modernization project of the statewide voter registration system and election management web application. title: Business Analyst
description: Analyst: Cloud Based Systems, SQL - Microsoft, Excel, Pivot Table Data Analysis Start date: 12/1/2026 End Date : At least 2 Years from projected start date Submission deadline: 11/23/2026 3:00:00 PM Client Info : MSDOC Note: *100% onsite required. Description: We are seeking two (2) experienced Business Analysts with strong skills in translating business requirements into data, reporting, automation, and cloud-based modernization solutions. The ideal candidates will have experience gathering and validating business requirements, analyzing existing application workflows, documenting business rules, supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and collaborating with business users and technical teams to deliver effective system modernization solutions. These analysts will play a critical role in the migration of the legacy Offender Management System to a new cloud-based platform. Responsibilities will include reviewing existing business rules, policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), reports, user stories, requirements verification documents, and Oracle SQL/PL/SQL code to ensure that existing functionality and business logic are accurately represented in the new system. The role requires a thorough understanding of legacy application functionality, the ability to translate complex business processes into clear functional requirements, and close collaboration with internal stakeholders and a third-party vendor. They will support the redesign of core application functionality, including modules such as records, classification and sentence computation, to ensure accurate operation within the updated system. Selected candidates must be available to work on-site under a contractual agreement for a minimum commitment of two (2) years. Key Responsibilities • Review and document existing application architecture, data models, workflows, and stored procedures. • Analyze legacy application functionality and identify the underlying business rules and dependencies • Review Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and views to understand existing application logic and support migration to the cloud environment. • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and potential improvements in existing business processes and application functionality. • Review existing Crystal Reports and document report logic, calculations, data sources, and business rules to support migration to a modern reporting platform compatible with AWS. • Analyze and document core logic modules such as sentence computation, offender records, offender programs, alerts, movement, classification, offender disciplinary, offender grievances, Community Corrections accounting and supervision. • Work with technical teams to validate source-to-target data mappings and ensure data accuracy and completeness • Translate existing system functionality into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation. • Ensure that critical business rules and functionality from the legacy system are accurately represented in the redesigned application • Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). • Validate migrated functionality against the legacy system and assist in identifying and documenting defects. • Participate in requirements walkthroughs, design reviews, and modernization discussions. Required Technical Skills • Experience in performing detailed analysis and preparing documentation that translates and supports business rules from the legacy system to the new cloud-based system. • Experience reviewing technical documentation, business rules, workflows, reports, and SQL code. • Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to read and understand queries, joins, data relationships, and stored procedure logic. • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, inc

title: VITA - Portfolio Data Analyst
description: Analyst: Power BI, Excel, SQL - Microsoft, C Level IT Leadership Start date: 12/07/2026 End Date : 04/30/2027 Submission deadline: 11/20/2026 Client Info : VITA Note: *Hybrid *Both Web Cam and In Person Interview Description: The Portfolio Data Analyst is a role within the PMCOE, created to elevate the Commonwealths IT portfolio intelligence from compliance reporting to strategic decision support. This position sits at the intersection of business analysis, data analytics, and enterprise portfolio management, translating investment data, agency strategic plans, and Planview portfolio records into actionable insights for VITA leadership and Commonwealth agency executives. This role operates as part of the Customer Experience FUSE function: it receives information already gathered and consolidated through VITAs Demand function, primarily agency Strategic Partner engagement and ITSP intake, and synthesizes that information, together with Planview, governance, and financial data, into portfolio-level knowledge. The Portfolio Business Analyst does not independently conduct agency-level demand sensing; that work belongs to the Demand function under the Director of Customer Relationships. The value this role adds is downstream: pattern recognition, cross-agency synthesis, and decision-ready analysis built on top of information the Demand function has already collected. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and requirements-gathering skills, hands-on Power BI experience, and a curiosity about how data can drive better public-sector investment decisions. Experience applying AI-assisted analysis tools to accelerate insight generation is a strong differentiator for this role. This isa high-visibility position with direct impact on how Virginias $1B+ annual IT investment portfolio is understood, governed, and optimized. description: Developer: Excel, Python, Data Manipulation, Data Analysis Start date: 10/05/2026 End Date : 12/31/2026 Submission deadline: 09/28/2026 Client Info: CT DPH Note: *Hybrid *Candidate Must Be Local *Occasionally, work may be performed onsite at 410 Capitol Avenue, Hartford; otherwise, the work will be remote (as determined by the Point of Contact). *All work shall occur between the hours of 8:00 am and 5:00 pm on official workdays in the State of Connecticut or as otherwise approved by the Point of Contact. Description: The Connecticut Department of Public Health (CT-DPH) aims to predict, prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats faster and more efficiently than ever before. Under this initiative, CT-DPH is committed to achieving this vision by developing and deploying approaches that move the public health community from siloed and brittle public health data systems to connected, resilient, adaptable, and sustainable response-ready systems capable of meeting today and tomorrows health challenges. (Data Modernization Initiative (DMI) Program Overview Various sections and programs currently track and manage critical information through disparate Excel files and Word documents. This manual, unstructured approach creates compliance risks, missed deadlines, and limited data visibility. Transitioning from a paper-based workflow to an automated Microsoft Power BI ecosystem through a Data Submissions and CGMS Portal has been a comprehensive, modernized, and successful strategy. The core program goals focus on eliminating manual data entry, enforcing data governance, and providing stakeholders with real-time decision-support capabilities and data analytics. Workstream Overview – (CGMS) Contracts, Grants, Management System The (CGMS) Contracting process manages the full lifecycle of contract development and execution, progressing through the following key stages. The current environment combines manual and system-assisted processes that support the full lifecycle of grants, contracting, financial reporting, and payment/refund activities. The process begins with the Contractor Information Intake process and moves through the below steps/phases, ending with the routing, approval, and execution phase. · Contractor Information Intake: Program initiates the process by providing contractor details and required supporting documentation. · Electronic Department Agreement Request (EDAR) Checklist Preparation: Program compiles and validates all required documentation, approvals, and data elements necessary for contract routing. · Electronic Department Agreement Request (EDAR) Submission: The formal contract request is submitted through the EDAR system, including fiscal data, contract type, and supporting materials for CMS review. · Legal Review & Contract Language: Contract language is reviewed and revised collaboratively by Legal, Program, and CMS. · Contract Development & Initiation: CMS prepares the appropriate contract template and ensures readiness for execution. · Routing, Approval & Execution: The Contract Specialist manages approvals, signatures, and final contract execution and distribution. About the Role: We are seeking (1) skilled Power BI Analyst. The Power BI Analyst will work with the Information Technology (IT) development team, in collaboration with Business Analysts, Quality Assurance Testers, Trainers, and the Production Support Information Technology team. The Power BI Analyst will design, build, and manage data models, interactive dashboards, and reports in Power BI to turn raw data into clear business insights and analyses that support leadership in evaluating key performance metrics, modeling behaviors, and data. Core Responsibilities: Data Preparation: Clean, transform, and shape raw datasets using Power Query and SQL. Data Modeling: Build stable

title: DMAS - System Analyst/QA Manager
description: Analyst: SIT, UAT, Test Scenarios, Mainframe Analysis Data Analysis Logic A Start date: 10/19/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline: 9/30/2026 Client Info: DMAS Note: *Hybrid *Web Cam Interview Only Description: This position is for a Systems Analyst/QA Manager for the HR1 Medicaid project will lead all Quality Assurance activities, ensuring deliverables meet state Medicaid requirements while coordinating closely with multiple state agencies, business teams, and external vendors. This role manages the full testing lifecycle, including designing the overall test strategy, planning, execution, reporting, detailed test data preparation, and overseeing End-to-End (E2E) testing. The SA/QA Manager will coordinate testing efforts with business teams to obtain user scenarios and test cases, organize meetings, support UAT, ensure proper test coverage and traceability, and perform test readiness reviews. Additional responsibilities include maintaining defect management processes, validating data integrity across systems, ensuring consistent QA documentation and standards, and conducting post-test assessments to confirm resolution of issues. The role also identifies risks early, partners with the PMO office for project oversight, and ensures strong communication across agencies, vendors, and project leadership throughout the HR1 implementation. Responsible for all System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and End2End Testing (E2E) for the MMIS and MES modules as well as the testing of configured Commercial off the Shelf (COTS) applications, and the conversion and integration of data from other systems in Medicaid Enterprise Systems (MES Modules and COTS products). Significant experience in managing the defect triage calls with multiple vendors and tracking the defects to closure in a timely fashion is required. Expected to have the ability to understand the requirements and design of the project and able to develop test cases, test data and verify the software changes and to problem solve issues that are escalated and serve as liaison between the developer and the Business User. Responsible for communicating and reporting to a variety of stakeholders about the results and progress of all UAT Testing including Test Summary and Execution metrics. Escalating and tracking UAT defects through the resolution. Mainframes Experience is required Track and maintain historical UAT Testing information. Able to meet deadlines with a high level of integrity, professionalism, customer service and motivation. Significant experience in managing UAT, defect triage calls and Co-ordination involving multiple systems/Vendors/Teams is required. Experience with Teradata queries is Preferred.

title: Application Data Developer Expert
description: Expert: Cloudera Management, Data Processing, Drools, Scala Start date :08/03/2026 End Date :06/30/2027 Submission deadline :10/06/2026 Client Info :NeDHHS Note: * Position Location: Remote Description: Senior Data Engineer – Encounter Processing & Data Platform The Senior Data Engineer will serve as the primary technical owner responsible for the ongoing maintenance, enhancement, operational support, and reliability of Nebraskas enterprise data processing framework supporting Medicaid Encounter Processing and enterprise data ingestion. This mission-critical platform processes provider, member, reference, and encounter data used by downstream Medicaid systems and reporting. The application framework is developed using Scala, Apache Spark, Hive, and Drools and operates on the Cloudera Data Platform (CDP). Following the States migration from an Apache open-source Hadoop environment to Cloudera Data Platform, this position will assume primary responsibility for maintaining the production code base, implementing business and regulatory changes, supporting production operations, resolving application defects, and performing routine operational administration of the data processing environment. This position serves as the single primary technical owner of the application framework and is expected to maintain sufficient expertise across the complete technology stack—including Scala, Apache Spark, Hive, Drools, and the Cloudera Data Platform—to ensure the ongoing reliability, maintainability, and operational continuity of this mission-critical system. Primary Ownership · Own the Scala/Spark application framework supporting Medicaid Encounter Processing. · Own the Drools business rule implementation and ongoing rule maintenance. · Own enterprise data ingestion processes for master data and source system files. · Own Spark and Hive batch processing workflows. · Own production issue investigation and application defect resolution. · Own production releases, version management, and deployment coordination. · Own application performance tuning and optimization. · Own technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge transfer. · Provide basic operational administration and monitoring of the Cloudera Data Platform while coordinating with infrastructure and cloud operations teams. description: Team Lead: ETL, BI Tools, Cloud Developer, Architect Presentation Skills Start date : 9/28/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline : 9/28/2026 Client Info : IT Infrastructure Services Consulting Note: * Remote * Either Web Cam or In Person Interview Description: The VISION – CWIS FACS Conversion Initiative requires the extraction of data from the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) BigQuery environment and the delivery of that data into enterprise SQL data warehouses. This effort is critical to ensuring continuity and modernization for all applications that currently depend on FACS. This role is responsible for ensuring that transactional and analytical data models include required data elements and meet quality, reliability, and performance expectations. The Lead ETL Developer will mentor and guide a team of ETL developers, establishing best practices and consistent development patterns throughout the project lifecycle. * Responsibilities Lead development of ETL and data ingestion processes supporting the migration from GCP BigQuery to SQL-based data warehouse environments. Architect and implement pipelines using modern ETL tools and cloud-native data processing frameworks. Train and mentor a team of 4+ ETL developers on best practices, coding standards, and data model design. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to validate data requirements and ensure alignment with reporting and analytical needs. Develop robust testing strategies to ensure data integrity, completeness, and accuracy throughout the migration process. Optimize pipelines for scalability, performance, and maintainability. Validate transactional and analytical data models to ensure they contain the necessary elements for downstream applications and BI solutions. Prepare and deliver clear communication, presentations, and technical documentation suitable for both technical and non-technical audiences. * Required Skills and Experience Minimum 7 years of hands-on ETL development experience. Expertise with modern ETL and reporting/BI tools. Strong understanding of enterprise data models and best practices in ETL pipeline design. This effort is critical to ensuring continuity and modernization for all applications that currently depend on FACS. The resource will also work closely with the .NET development team to support application deployment, integration, configuration, CI/CD processes, infrastructure as code, and environment management, while ensuring that the solution can be effectively supported by internal staff after transition. description: Consultant: not found, Asset Management, Data Collection, Start date :12/1/2026 End Date :02/26/2027 Submission deadline :10/16/2026 Client Info : TN DOT Note: * Candidate must be within 50 miles * This is a hybrid position. Three days in the office & two days work from home Description: The Temporary Employee will provide short-term operational and administrative support to the Asset Management Divisions Fleet/Facilities Asset Section. Work will focus on maintaining daily continuity for fleet and facility-related activities, including communication, tracking, documentation, data updates, and coordination with internal TDOT teams, Regional staff, vendors, and other stakeholders. Primary duties may include supporting motor pool and Agile Fleet-related activities, maintaining and updating fleet order or asset tracking tools, organizing records and documentation, assisting with asset inventory and tagging information, supporting surplus and delivery tracking, and helping monitor follow-up items related to fleet acquisition, warranties, invoices, and operational requests. The position will also assist with preparing or updating standard operating procedures, communication materials, status updates, and other records needed to support consistent program operations. Because of the limited three-month timeframe, the Temporary Employee should be able to quickly learn existing processes, manage assigned tasks with minimal oversight, and provide dependable support to help maintain continuity of Fleet/Facilities services. Qualifications: · Associates or bachelors degree in business, administration, or other related field. 3 years of demonstrated competency experience in maintenance, fleet/facility operations, or a related technical discipline. OR · Education equivalent to graduation from high school · 5 years of demonstrated competency in maintenance or related technical discipline. AND · Ability to communicate clearly, respond to inquiries promptly, and provide organized customer service to internal and external stakeholders. · Experience maintaining accurate records, documentation, audit information, or compliance-related files. · Experience coordinating with internal teams, regional staff, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders. · Experience supporting fleet, facility, maintenance, asset management, or related technical operations. title: Senior Full-Stack .NET Modernization Developer
description: Developer: ASP.NET, MVC, T SQL, Agile GitHub Start date :10/26/2026 End Date :06/30/2027 Submission deadline :9/28/2026 Client Info : DECAL-IT Note: *Hybrid *Either Web Cam or In Person Description: Clint is core licensing platform is a mission-critical application that supports child care licensing, provider management, and program eligibility across the State of Georgia. We are in the middle of a major modernization effort, moving from a legacy ASP.NET architecture to .NET 8+, modern APIs, Azure cloud services, and a React-based user experience. This is not a maintenance or production support role. This position is for a senior engineer who wants to lead modernization efforts, solve complex technical problems, and help shape the future architecture of a statewide platform. You will play a key role in technical design decisions, application architecture, cloud integration, and delivery. Our team is intentionally lean. That means ownership matters. You will be expected to take a solution from concept to production, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and operational support. Success in this role requires initiative, accountability, and the ability to work independently. If youre looking for a highly structured environment where work is narrowly defined and tasks are handed to you step-by-step, this is probably not the right fit. If you enjoy building, leading, and owning outcomes, youll thrive here. . *Work Location • Must be physically located in Georgia • Hybrid: Tuesday–Thursday on-site at DECAL headquarters, Atlanta (subject to manager discretion) • Mandatory in-person: All Hands, Enterprise Applications meetings, DECAL All Staff, and designated on-site milestones *What You Will Do Application Modernization (Core of this Role) • Champion the modernization of DECALs mission-critical licensing and eligibility applications, transitioning legacy solutions to modern .NET and Azure-based architectures. • Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable application solutions that reduce technical debt and improve long-term supportability. • Build and evolve API-first integrations and services that enable future platform capabilities. • Develop cloud-native solutions using Azure App Services, Azure Functions, and related Azure technologies. • Own the SQL Server platform, including data architecture, performance tuning, data migration, and platform modernization. • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to automate testing, deployment, and release management. • Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, automation, documentation, and adherence to modern development practices. Frontend & Integration • Build and maintain React-based UI components as part of the modernization roadmap • Demonstrate a strong understanding of web application rendering patterns, including client side rendering (CSR), server-side rendering (SSR), component-based architectures, and modern frontend frameworks. • Integrate third-party services and internal APIs; document every integration cleanly • Implement and maintain reporting using SSRS and Power BI • Participate in AI integration initiatives — Azure Agentic AI services, Copilot tooling, and chatbot integrations where applicable Quality, Documentation & Support • Write code that your teammates can read and maintain six months from now • Provide production support and own root-cause analysis when things break • Maintain application documentation, deployment runbooks, and user-facing guides • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and sprint ceremonies Required Qualifications

description: Analyst: IT Systems, Data Mapping, SDLC, Agile ALM TFS VSTS Jira RTC Start date: 10/19/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline: 9/25/2026 Client Info: DOM-DoIT - IT Project Services Consulting Note: *Either Web Cam or In Person Interview *Onsite Description: The Iowa Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) is focused on modernizing its Medicaid and Integrated Eligibility Systems to enable faster policy and program changes, improve continuity of operations, and reduce brittle point-to-point dependencies. Currently, data passes through multiple legacy systems with several weak links, leading to data reconciliation failures, downstream impacts, and manual workarounds. To address these challenges, the Customer would like to engage with Google Cloud Professional Services (PSO) to establish a governed enterprise integration and data foundation. This initial phase will focus on establishing a Cloud Foundation for a FedRAMP Moderate environment, providing a data integration platform, an application modernization strategy, performing a mainframe assessment, providing a product backlog, and defining program governance. Ultimately, this effort aims to configure a modern Google Cloud application platform, allowing for incremental modernization while designing infrastructure aligned with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) baseline requirements. Responsibilities of business analyst role include but are not limited to: • Creating, presenting and maintaining user stories, acceptance criteria, demo expectations and design documents in DHS defined systems. • Creating/documenting, tracing, maintaining, prioritizing, and assessing changes to business processes and the associated requirements • Working closely with key decision makers, systems owners and end users in support of core processes and critical business objectives • Conducting research to obtain data, analyzing problems to advise and recommend solutions • Querying and analyzing data to determine solutions, such as installation of alternate methods and procedures, changes in processing methods and practices, or redesign of products or services • Advising client or department heads on alternate methods of solving needs or problems, and recommending specific solutions • Working within an agile methodology framework with a focus on delivering value and adjusting rapidly to produce the most effective outcome • Working closely with all IT organizations and driving projects to successful completion A successful candidate for this role is expected to possess the following skills and experience: • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact with a diverse group of team members, including executives, managers, IT professionals, and subject matter experts • Experience in process mapping, group facilitation, data gathering and analysis, and phases of project life cycle (requirements gathering, design, development, deployment, training, and measuring effectiveness.) • Experience delivering software as part of an agile delivery team • Strong ability to work effectively within time constraints, changing priorities, and independently • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Visio • Experience with requirement gathering software such as Azure DevOps, TFS, JIRA, or RTC. • Analyze business strategy and user needs, document specifications, and translate business objectives into proper system requirement specifications • Guide business customers through business case development for new applications/functionality, including cost / benefit analysis and risk / impact analysis • Understanding of how to deliver value through realizations of benefits, Description: The Tennessee Department of Healths Division of Family Health and Wellness (FHW) is seeking a contract Adolescent Health Program Coordinator to provide statewide leadership for adolescent health initiatives that improve the health and well-being of Tennessees youth. Under general supervision, this position leads the planning, implementation, coordination, and evaluation of adolescent health programs through collaboration with state and local partners, schools, healthcare providers, youth-serving organizations, and adolescents. The Adolescent Health Program Coordinator serves as the subject-matter expert for adolescent health and positive youth development, ensuring that youth perspectives inform public health strategies and programs. This position leads the development and implementation of Tennessees Adolescent Health Strategic Plan, provides leadership for statewide initiatives, develops partnerships, manages grants and projects, provides technical assistance, and supports data-informed decision-making to improve adolescent health outcomes across Tennessee. Key Responsibilities: • Lead the development, implementation, and evaluation of Tennessees Adolescent Health Strategic Plan, ensuring alignment with state and federal priorities and advancing adolescents across Tennessee. • Develop, implement, manage, and evaluate adolescent health programs and initiatives. • Lead coordination of the Sources of Strength suicide prevention program in Tennessee by collaborating with implementing schools, community organizations, and local and national trainers to ensure the program is implemented with fidelity. • Lead the statewide implementation of Screenagers: Under the Influence, including project planning, coordination, partner engagement, implementation, evaluation, technical assistance, and reporting to TDH leadership and funding agencies. • Lead the support of Tennessee Generations (TNGen) by facilitating meetings, developing youth leadership opportunities, maintaining communication with members, coordinating youth-led initiatives, and supporting federal reporting requirements. • Coordinate adolescent engagement strategies, including advisory groups, focus groups, and other opportunities that ensure youth education, pregnancy prevention, dating violence prevention, nutrition, physical activity, and other factors that influence adolescent health and well-being. • Provide technical assistance, consultation, and training to internal and external partners on adolescent health best practices. • Monitor program performance, evaluate outcomes, analyze data, and use findings to support continuous title: Attorney
description: Consultant: Microsoft Word, Written And Verbal Communication Skills, -, Start date :10/12/2026 End Date :09/30/2030 Submission deadline :9/15/2026 Client Info :TN DOH Note: Position Location: Hybrid Description: We are seeking an attorney to serve as a Contractor Associate General Counsel to assist the Departments effort to strengthen Tennessees rural healthcare infrastructure by supporting the effective regulation of healthcare professionals serving residents throughout the states 89 rural counties. This position reports to a Deputy General Counsel. The primary role of this position is the handling of disciplinary cases against healthcare licensees practicing in rural Tennessee counties, which includes working with Department investigators and licensing board consultants during the investigative and review process, negotiating resolution with licensees who have violated their respective practice acts, and trying cases before licensing boards. As assigned, job responsibilities may also include advising on special projects and conducting bill analysis related to the delivery of rural healthcare in Tennessee. Position requires weekly in-office time. This is a contract position not eligible for state employee benefits, and the successful candidate should obtain their own professional liability insurance. Key Responsibilities: - Represent the department in administrative law cases before various health-related boards. - Review complaints and investigations involving healthcare licensees practicing in any of Tennessees 89 rural counties. - Provide legal support for department investigators and licensing board consultants. - For those cases for which formal discipline is warranted, handle all aspects of litigation, including discovery, motion practice, and trials. - Ability to competently manage a robust case load at various phases of litigation. - Assist with legislative projects as assigned, including bill analysis. Minimum Qualifications: The ideal candidate should have litigation experience that includes trials, the ability to manage and prioritize a large volume of work, excellent verbal and written communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to collaborate and work in a team environment. Education: JD, admitted to TN Bar with a license in good standing required. At least 1 year of relevant legal experience preferred. Items to include with application: Please include with application a writing sample of not more than 10 pages along with the applicants TN Bar license number.

• Maintaining proper hygiene and cleanliness in food preparation areas, including regular cleaning of kitchen equipment, countertops, stove, refrigerator, and garbage cans.

• Ensuring the welfare, health, and safety of all children during mealtimes, including maintaining an accessible file for children with food allergies.
• Supporting other staff by occasionally cleaning toys, relieving staff for breaks, and maintaining overall kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
• Completing First Aid and Infant CPR training as scheduled.
• Maintaining clear communication with the supervisor and parents regarding any food-related issues or concerns.
• Certifications:

===============================================================
• ISS is responsible for
• Identifying and continuously assessing risk
• Developing, institutionalizing, and improving strategies to mitigate risk
• Limiting the potential effects of information security events
• The selection, assessment, authorization, and monitoring of security controls while contributing to the overall information security plan.
• The Information Security Section (ISS) is functionally organized into Security Awareness and Governance, Compliance, Architecture, and Portfolio Management.
• Cross-team collaboration is essential to our success.
• The DHS Liaison serves the Division of Medicaid Services and is the champion for security initiatives integrating information security into program operations.

• A federally recognized (ANSI) information security certification must be obtained within 6 months of the start date and maintained for this position.

1.
• Integrate security into program operations
• Partner with organizational leaders to incorporate information security best-practices into technical and operational development.

• Provide options to mitigate risk considering business impact.

title: Cybersecurity Network Support
skills: Hands on experience with Cisco ISE.
description:
Position Summary

Client is seeking an experienced Network Specialist with strong skills in network support with an emphasis in cybersecurity. The ideal candidate will have 7 or more year experience supporting an enterprise-level network similar in size and scope of client The role requires a thorough understanding of complex networks and demonstrated experience in troubleshooting and maintaining network and communication user devices of moderate to high complexity. This role will focus on the hardware and software aspects of network operations across multiple platforms of LAN and WAN configurations, monitor use, capacity and performance of network systems, and make recommendations for changes. In collaboration with other senior-level network staff, this role will conducts high level network performance tuning and establishes statewide integration and continuity of connectivity.

Required Technical Skills:

• 7+ years of hands on experience configuring, monitoring, troubleshooting, and deploying Cisco IOS/IOS-XE devices.
• 5+ years of hands on experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting 802.11 Wireless network infrastructure.
• 5+ years of hands on experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting Firewalls. Hands on experience implementing Network Security protocols including TACACS, RADIUS, and 802.1x.
• Hands on experience with Windows Server administration of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, NPS/RADIUS.
• Hands on experience with VMware vSphere 7/8 and Veeam Backup administration.
• Ability to read and interpret Syslog, SNMP, and other observability and telemetry information from network devices.
• Ability to coordinate with remote technicians for troubleshooting and information gathering and verification.
• Ability to perform root cause analysis of network issues.
Preferred Additional Qualifications:

• Hands on experience with Meraki Wireless access points.
• Hands on experience with Meraki, Palo Alto, and Fortinet firewalls.
• Hands on experience with Cisco ISE.
• Understanding of general cyber security and able to understand CVE notices.
• Basic understanding of open source software and platforms such as Linux, Ansible, and Git.
• Hands on experience with Amazon AWS cloud services.

title: Grants Data and Analytics Specialist
description:
• Resource supports strategic decision-making through the analysis of public health, grant management, financial, operational, and performance data.
• This position is responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise dashboards, reports, and analytical products, including Dashboard and the Grants Transparency Dashboard. The position leverages enterprise data systems, including Euna Grants and other agency data sources, to provide actionable insights into grant expenditures, funding allocations, performance outcomes, and program effectiveness. The incumbent serves as a liaison between business and technical stakeholders, helping to identify reporting needs, document requirements, ensure data integrity, and support data-driven decision-making, transparency initiatives, program evaluation, and financial stewardship across the agency.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

•  Develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise dashboards and reports, including the Dashboard and Grants Transparency Dashboard.
•  Analyze grant expenditures, obligations, allocations, reimbursements, funding trends, and performance data to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improved resource utilization.
•  Support reporting, data management, and analytical functions associated with the Euna Grants platform and related grants management systems.
•  Provide financial, operational, and programmatic analyses to support forecasting of grant expenditures, funding availability, and strategic resource planning.
•  Create data products and performance metrics that support grant operations, agency initiatives, program evaluation, and leadership decision-making.
•  Gather, document, validate, and prioritize business requirements from grants management, finance, program areas, and executive leadership to support reporting and analytical solutions.
•  Collaborate with stakeholders to identify data needs, improve reporting processes, and develop meaningful performance measures and outcome indicators.
•  Facilitate discussions and working sessions with internal and external stakeholders to support data collection, reporting standards, and continuous improvement efforts.
•  Coordinate with Data Operations and IT teams to ensure reporting solutions align with enterprise data architecture, governance standards, and data warehouse capabilities.
•  Ensure financial, programmatic, and operational data integrity through data validation, quality assurance, and adherence to established governance practices.
•  Prepare executive briefings, dashboards, visualizations, reports, and presentations for agency leadership regarding grant performance, spending trends, program outcomes, and strategic initiatives.
•  Support audits, financial evaluations, monitoring reviews, compliance assessments, and responses to information requests from state and federal partners.
•  Monitor compliance with federal and state grant requirements and support grant transparency and accountability initiatives.
•  Review and validate reporting outputs and analytical deliverables to ensure alignment with documented requirements and business objectives.
• Develop project timelines, risk assessments, process documentation, and impact analyses for grants and data initiatives.
•  Collaborate with program directors, grants administration staff, finance teams, vendors, and external partners to improve business processes and strengthen data-informed decision-making.
•  Conduct research and environmental scans to identify best practices in grants management, public health analytics, transparency reporting, and performance measurement.
•  Support agency leadership in evaluating program effectiveness and identifying opportunities for operational efficiency and improved outcomes.
•  Participate in professional development opportunities related to grants management, data analytics, financial forecasting, business intelligence, and performance measurement.
•  Perform other duties as assigned in support of Grants Management and agency strategic priorities.

Difficulty of Work:

• Work involves analyzing complex public health, grant management, financial, operational, and performance datasets to assess spending, program effectiveness, compliance, and outcomes across agency initiatives.
• Requires independent judgement, critical thinking, and the ability to work through ambiguity an devolving requirements.
• Must balance technical constraints, operational realities, regulatory considerations, and diverse stakeholder needs.

Responsibility:

• The incumbent works closely with Grants Management, the Director of Data Products, and other agency staff, while independently completing project tasks with minimal guidance. Senior staff review work products for quality, accuracy, efficiency, and achievement of project goals. The incumbent keeps the supervisor apprised of work on a regular basis.
• The incumbent is responsible for the quality, accuracy, and completeness of business and functional requirements, reporting outputs, dashboards, and analytical products supporting grants management, transparency, program evaluation, and financial stewardship. The position supports successful adoption by stakeholders through clear requirements, guidance, and technical assistance.
• Position is expected to comply with all policies and procedures set forth.

Personal Work Relationships:

• This staff member works both independently and collaboratively with internal leadership, data and analytics teams, IT, legal, and finance staff.
• Regular interaction with external partners, vendors, and other government or community stakeholders.
Skills Required:
• Bachelor’s Degree with course work in analytics, statistics, computer science, informatics, and/or mathematics and 2+ years of experience	Required
• Or a Master’s Degree with course work in analytics, statistics, computer science, informatics, and/or mathematics	Required
• Directly applicable experience in data analysis, informatics, or grants/operations management.	Required	3	Years
• Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting requirements for complex, multi-stakeholder systems or programs	Required	3	Years
• Experience working cross-collaboratively with internal divisions or external partners.	Required	3	Years
• Familiarity with public health program implementation and evaluation methodologies.	Required
• Familiarity with how to conduct scientific research literature reviews.	Required
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with both technical and non-technical audiences.	Required
• Experience with analytical tools, as well as visualization tools such as Tableau	Required	3	Years
• Proficiency with common productivity and project management tools (e.g., M365, project management, collaboration tools).	Required	3	Years
• Resourceful self-starter and highly motivated team player	Required
• Able to perform well in a fast-paced environment	Required
• Effective communicator and someone who enjoys getting to understand nuances of a problem	Required

title: Technical Specialist- Mid Level
description:
• The Client is seeking a Technical Specialist to support the Preconstruction business processes as a solution designer.
• The contractor will design SharePoint and web-based solutions to support Preconstruction business processes that are valuable to Transportation Life Cycle. This role includes translating design requirements into clearly defined and manageable user stories and consulting with clients to prototype, refine, test, and debug applications. The candidate will ensure work items are prioritized, tracked, and delivered to the clients on time with high quality and excellent, usable documentation. They must provide Quality Control for program and project deliverables and mentor and provide guidance to team members.
• The ideal candidate has 8+ years of relevant experience and proven expertise as a Business Analyst/Solution Designer working with custom SharePoint solutions, Power Platform workflows, and enterprise-level content management. Success requires advanced skills in business process re-engineering, requirements translation, Software Development Life Cycle/Agile methodology, quality assurance, and system integration, along with the ability to independently lead the design, support, and continuous improvement of mission-critical tools and to provide direction and mentorship to junior-level technical staff with minimal supervision. Familiarity with Preconstruction and Transportation Life Cycle business processes is critical to perform at this level.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design SharePoint and web-based solutions to support Preconstruction business processes that are valuable to Transportation Life Cycle  
• Translate design requirements into clearly defined and manageable user stories for the Development Team  
• Ensure work items are prioritized, tracked, and delivered to the clients on time with high quality and excellent, usable documentation  
• Consult with clients to prototype, refine, test, and debug applications and processes to meet business needs  
• Provide Quality Control for program and project deliverables  
• Mentor and provide guidance to team members

title: Modernization Data Conversion Analyst
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced, hands-on Data Conversion Analyst / Data Migration Lead to own the end-to-end data conversion workstream for modernization of its Customer Account Information  application. It is a roughly 25-year-old system central to the Bureau of Consumer Services (BCS), supporting approximately 186,000 informal consumer complaints annually and related utility complaint-resolution activities. The modernization is planned as a multi-year, phased effort led by MIS in partnership with BCS.
• This position will lead the assessment of legacy data, design the target logical and physical data models in collaboration with solution architects, define the conversion strategy and architecture, build and execute extraction, profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, loading, and reconciliation processes and lead migration testing, cutover, and post-conversion validation. The analyst will be accountable for conversion completeness, accuracy, traceability, security, and operational readiness, working closely with the Product/Project Manager, Business Analyst, application developers, database/infrastructure teams, BCS subject-matter experts. Selected candidates must have deep understanding of relational data models, how to enforce referential data integrity, and how to improve data quality.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the data conversion strategy, architecture, scope, work plan, estimates, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and acceptance criteria across phased modernization releases.
• Inventory and analyze legacy databases, files, interfaces, historical records, data relationships, business rules, and downstream/upstream data dependencies; identify gaps and quality issues.
• Design and maintain source-to-target mappings, canonical definitions, data dictionaries, logical/physical target data models, entity relationships, keys, reference data, and data retention/archival recommendations with the architecture team.
• Define which data must be migrated, transformed, remediated, archived, or retained for access, considering complaint histories, case status, customer/utility information, documents and audit trails as applicable and confirmed through discovery.
• Design, develop, optimize, and execute repeatable ETL/ELT processes, conversion programs, SQL scripts, staging structures, validation controls, and automated reconciliation reports.
• Lead data profiling, cleansing, de-duplication, standardization, exception handling, and remediation; coordinate business-owned decisions on ambiguous or poor-quality source data.
• Define and execute iterative trial conversions, unit/system/integration testing, data-quality testing, user acceptance support, performance testing, and end-to-end reconciliation with measurable pass/fail thresholds.
• Plan and execute phased migrations and production cutovers, including sequencing, freezes, checkpoints, rollback/contingency plans, operational handoffs, and post-go-live monitoring and issue resolution.
• Protect confidential customer information through access controls, secure data handling, encryption, auditability, and compliance with applicable security, privacy, records, and retention requirements.
• Coordinate with the Product Manager and Business Analyst to align migration priorities with business processes, requirements, release schedules, and BCS validation/sign-off; report status and risks to MIS leadership.
• Produce and maintain conversion architecture/design documents, mappings, scripts, test evidence, reconciliation results, defect/exception logs, runbooks, decision logs, and knowledge-transfer materials.

• Strong hands-on experience with source-to-target mapping, data profiling and cleansing, ETL/ELT design and development, complex transformations, an	Required
• Experience planning repeated migration rehearsals, resolving conversion defects, managing data quality exceptions, and supporting high-stakes product	Required

• Experience creating detailed technical documentation and managing conversion activities, risks, and dependencies in an Agile or hybrid delivery env	Required
• Strong understanding of secure handling of sensitive data, role-based access, data integrity, auditability, and applicable privacy/retention control	Required

title: Modernization Business Analyst
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced Sr. Business Analyst to work on requirements gathering, business process analysis, solution design, data conversion validation, and testing activities for the modernization of the application. The application is critically important for resolving complaints from the public with utility companies. A multi-year modernization effort is about to begin that will involve the planning and delivery of this mission-critical initiative.
• This role will be responsible for working closely with business unit subject matter experts to document existing functionality, identify opportunities for process improvement, and ensure critical business capabilities are successfully transitioned from the legacy application to the modernized solution. The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and the technical delivery team.
• This is not a documentation-only Business Analyst role. The ideal candidate will possess a strong combination of business analysis and technical aptitude, including experience supporting application modernization, data conversion initiatives, business process redesign, integration analysis, and testing efforts. The individual will work closely with the Product Manager, Product Owner, Data Modeler, Data Conversion Analyst, architects, developers, and business stakeholders to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into system functionality.
• The successful candidate will be expected to analyze business processes, review data requirements, participate in conversion and integration discussions, validate testing results, and make recommendations that improve business efficiency while ensuring continuity of critical operations. The individual must be capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional project team and possess strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

•  Document the existing requirements, workflows, business rules, reports, integrations, and functionality of the application and verify all critical capabilities are accounted for.
•  Prioritize requirements and establish traceability to business, legislative, regulatory, and policy requirements where applicable.
•  Work with business units and subject matter experts to identify opportunities for process improvements, workflow simplification, and modernization.
•  Propose new features and capabilities that deliver measurable business value and improve operational efficiency.
•  Work directly with the Product Manager and Product Owner in translating business requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and functional specifications.
•  Develop current-state and future-state business process models and assist in defining modernization requirements.
•  Partner with the Product Manager, architects, developers, and technical teams to analyze solution approaches and ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented correctly.
•  Assist in analyzing technical approaches, including platform capabilities, architecture options, integrations, reporting requirements, and workflow impacts.
•  Participate in data conversion activities including data mapping reviews, business rule validation, data quality assessments, conversion testing, reconciliation, and business sign-off.
•  Work with the Data Modeler and Data Conversion Analyst to validate source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and data migration requirements.
•  Support analysis and documentation of APIs, interfaces, integrations, and data exchanges.
•  Utilize SQL and database concepts to assist in validating data conversion results, reconciliation activities, and testing outcomes.
•  Develop test scenarios, test scripts, and business validation procedures to ensure requirements have been correctly implemented.
•  Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, business validation, and stakeholder sign-off activities.
•  Execute and support functional, integration, regression, conversion, and end-to-end business process testing efforts.
•  Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and requirements clarification.
•  Support change management, user adoption, training, and organizational readiness activities related to the modernized solution.
•  Ensure the product aligns with the client standards for security, accessibility (WCAG), data privacy, records retention, and compliance.
•  Help identify project risks, dependencies, assumptions, and impediments, and recommend mitigation strategies.
•  Provide regular status updates, recommendations, and business analysis deliverables to project leadership and business sponsors.

Skills Required:

• Experience as a Business Analyst, of which at least three years are in a Senior Business Analyst role.	Required	7	Years
• Demonstrated experience analyzing legacy applications or supporting enterprise application modernization and digital transformation initiatives.	Required	5	Years
• Strong experience gathering requirements and translating them into clearly understood user stories, functional requirements, business rules, and accept	Required	5	Years
• Experience documenting business processes, workflow diagrams, use cases, and functional specifications.	Required
• Experience supporting data migration, data conversion, or system replacement projects.	Required
• Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data relationships, data mapping, and SQL sufficient to support data validation and testing active	Required
• Experience reviewing and validating source-to-target mappings, conversion logic, reconciliation reports, and data quality results.	Required
• Experience documenting and validating system integrations, APIs, interfaces, and data exchange requirements.	Required
• Strong experience developing test cases, test scenarios, and business validation procedures for large-scale projects.	Required
• Experience leading and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT).	Required
• Experience supporting Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar).	Required
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.	Required
• Strong organizational, analytical, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing demands.	Required
• Ability to facilitate discussions between business and technical stakeholders and drive resolution of complex issues.	Required
• Experience supporting enterprise application modernization initiatives involving legacy system replacement and modernization.	Highly desired
• Experience with process improvement and business process reengineering.	Highly desired
• Experience participating in data conversion projects involving data mapping, data quality assessments, reconciliation, and conversion testing.	Highly desired
• Working knowledge of SQL for data validation, testing, and reconciliation activities.	Highly desired
• Experience reviewing logical data models, entity relationship diagrams (ERDs), and data mapping documentation.	Highly desired
• Familiarity with Microsoft technology platforms, Azure, modern application architectures, APIs, and cloud migration initiatives.	Highly desired
• Experience documenting and validating API-based integrations, web services, and enterprise interfaces.	Highly desired
• Experience supporting phased implementations, parallel operations, cutover planning, and production readiness activities.	Highly desired
• Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) and public-sector compliance requirements.	Highly desired
• Previous experience working with agencies or similar public-sector organizations.	Highly desired
• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience	Highly desired

title: Network Administrator 4
description:
• Seeking a Network Administrator with 5+ years of progressive experience.  
• Team is looking for a solid mid-level team member who brings a minimum of 5 years of hands-on networking experience. The best candidate will be someone who is looking for long term professional growth opportunities, possesses a 4 year degree and/or industry certifications. Requires experience, creativity and multi-tasking to independently and collaboratively achieve department service and support objectives for the Transportation Operations Center. Individual is able to work without assistance; is able to manage medium complexity work efforts; has some industry experience; can provide limited leadership to others; collaborates well with others.

LEADERSHIP SKILLS/QUALITIES HIGHLY DESIRED. 

• The Network Administrator installs, configures, and supports an organization's local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN), and Internet system or a segment of a network system. Maintain network hardware and software. Monitor network to ensure network availability to all system users and perform necessary maintenance to support network availability. May supervise other network support and client server specialists and plan, coordinate, and implement network security measures. Coordinate the development, implementation, and maintenance of a local area network or wide area network. Maintains the network's physical and logical structures, including network connections. Maintains network support software, analyzes user support statistics, and recommends appropriate measures. Installs, tests, and maintains network hardware and software. Prepares and analyzes statistics on network utilization and availability. Prepares training courses and provides user support and training in the use of available hardware, software, and utilities. Performs tuning and capacity planning activities to enhance the performance of the network resources.
• Assesses existing network, software, and current solutions and makes recommendations based on product specifications and best cybersecurity practices. Configures equipment and software to meet business needs, trains others on the solution, and documents the solution for ongoing support. Functions as part of a team on larger projects, or individually provides the services on support visits or smaller projects. Provides technical support and assists with the design of Infrastructure solutions. Requires experience in the technical services and support fields as well as experience in network administration (DHCP, DNS, routers, firewall, etc.)
•  Responds to Tier 1 and 2 network and software support requests.
•  Communicates effectively with teammates and customers of varying levels of technical expertise.
•  Responds to all break/fix requests associated with network resources.
•  Designs extensions of and connections to the campus network.
•  Assists withconfiguration and deployment of new/replacement network hardware and communications infrastructure.
•  Maintains up-to-date project and architecture documentation.
•  Maintains up-to-date inventory and maintenance records.
•  Monitors network resources for faults and traffic anomalies.
•  Resolves connection issues between users and resources.
•  Maintains detailed change history of network changes.
•  Supports ITS Field Maintenance with communications' implementation and troubleshooting.
•  Supports team efforts to improve cybersecurity controls and defenses.
•  Supports team efforts for threat hunting and mitigation.
•  Manages time and resource constraints

• General Information Technology	Required	10	Years
• Cisco Routing and Switching	Required	5	Years
• VLAN Management	Required	5	Years
• Network Design	Required	2	Years
• Subnetting	Required	5	Years
• Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, etc)	Required	3	Years
• Network Security	Highly desired	2	Years
• DNS/DHCP	Nice to have	2	Years
• Network Monitoring	Nice to have	2	Years
• Network Cable Management	Nice to have	2	Years
• Cisco FMC/Firepower	Nice to have	2	Years

• Integration Troubleshooting	Required	2	Years

description:
• The Candidate will be responsible for guiding the design, development, integration, modernization, and operational improvement of secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective Artificial Intelligence solutions.

Job Duties

• The Client is excited to offer a competitive opportunity to serve as AI Forward Deployed Engineer, supporting enterprise Al engineering and Al enablement.
• The Forward Deployed Engineer will serve as a hands-on technical resource responsible for guiding the design, development, integration, modemization, and operational improvement of secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective Artificial Intelligence (Al} solutions. 
• The position will focus development, enhancement, and operational improvement of enterprise A] applications, including production chatbots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, and intelligent automation workflows. 
• Develop and enhance practices for resource tagging, cost allocation, utilization monitoring, budget visibility, model consumption, API usage, and cost optimization. 
• Participate in Commonwealth agency Al discovery sessions, requirements validation, technical workshops, and design sprints to evaluate business challenges and translate requirements into practical Al solutions. 
• Collaborate with sdution architects to assess technical feasibility, develop solution designs, and define nonfunctional requirements (NFRs).Design, develop, and evaluate agentic Al workflows, incuding Al agents, multi-step automation, and secure enterprise integrations. 
• Assess the suitability Of agent-based solutions compared With traditional automation, considering security, human oversight, reliability, scalability, and operational costs. 
• Stay current With emerging Altechnologies and industry practices. Evaluate new Al tools and services againstVITA and Commonwealth agency business problems through focused, time-boxedproofs Of concept (POCs)with defined objectives, measurable success criteria, cost estimates, and documented outcomes. 
• Recommend adoption, further evaluation, or discontinuation based on business value, technical feasibility, security, and potential to reduce time to market..

Minimum Qualifications

• Considerable experience designing, developing, integrating, and supporting Al initiatives.
• Considerable experience developing applications using Python, REST ARS, and cloud-based integration technologies.
• Experience designing or implementing Al and Generative Al solutions, including large language models (LI-MS), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),conversational Al, or comparable Al application architectures.

• Experience evaluating technical requirements and contributing to Al solution design

• Experience evaluating emerging technologies, conducting technical proofs ofconcept, and translating business requirements into practical engineeringrecommendations.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts, document solutions, and collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.

Additional Considerations

• Experience developing or integrating A solutions using Microsoft Azure services,Azure OpenAl, Azure Functions, or comparable technologies.
• Experience with agentic Al workflows, A agents, tod orchestration, multi-step automation, or agent-based application architectures.
• Familiarity with modem data platforms and architectures, including Databricks, DeltaLake, Medallion Architecture, and enterprise Lakehouse concepts.Experience with vector databases, semantic search, embedding models, Al

  • The Client is seeking an Expert Specialist resource for an engagement to work with the Client Services Team. Client Services uses technical expertise and understanding of business needs to evaluate assigned IT incident and problem service desk tickets to appropriately prioritize and evaluate business impact.
  • Proactively promotes positive customer relationships and mentors others to ensure client satisfaction and organizational success. Takes ownership of customer problems and works with a sense of urgency to resolve incidents and problems. Communicates status of progress to the customer.
  • Provides updates on work progress to Customer Support Specialists and the Service Desk using call tracking system. Has significant technical knowledge and serves as a resource for other technicians to help solve complex problems. Skilled in different types of computer hardware, software, peripherals and components, networking protocols and communications. Installs and images new computers and loads appropriate software for customers. Deploys new business applications as needed. Installs local and network printers and other peripherals and configuration of same. Responsible for user data and migration of profiles as computers are replaced.
  • Stays abreast of current technology in a changing environment. Identifies emerging trends and issues, researches and makes suggestions for technical solutions to solve current and future problems. Uses extensive knowledge to develop and/or implement information technology solutions to enhance organizational success.
  • Works with Data Center Operations with user file server data storage, network reservations, data restores, various account creations and modifications (AD, email, NCID, CITRIX, etc.). Works with application development teams to identify application issues at the customer level and provide technical detail in order for development teams to accurately identify problems within applications. Works with network infrastructure teams to identify network issues at the customer level and provide significant technical detail to assist in network hardware resolutions.

Project Management -

  • Ability to lead projects that require directing the work of others and with some latitude on actions or decisions. Leads team efforts and assesses and integrates the skills and strengths of individuals for project and organizational success. Provides status on project work to management.

Develop and maintain appropriate documentation for all responsible areas -

  • This position is responsible for creating and maintaining all documentation of process and procedures for all areas this position is responsible for. This documentation is to be used by team members for operational standards of daily work. This documentation will also be used in accordance with Operational Level Agreements (IT internal) and Service Level Agreements (IT external). All documentation should be reviewed annually.

System Security

  • It is the responsibility of all Technical Services Staff to be aware of security policies, as well as the security issues directly affecting the systems and technology for which this position is directly involved. This position is responsible for implementing requirements of the IT Security Office and protecting data from unauthorized access, alteration, destruction, or usage in a manner inconsistent with covered IT Security Policies and standards.
Skills Required:

  • Skilled in different types of computer hardware, software, peripherals and components, networking protocols and communications. Required 7 Years
  • Installing and imaging new computers and loading of appropriate software for customers. Required 7 Years
  • Installing local and network printers and other peripherals and configuration of same. Required 7 Years
  • Migrating data and user profiles. Required 7 Years
  • Documenting process and procedures related to technical field support activities. Required 7 Years
  • Demonstrates knowledge and a working experience with ServiceNow call tracking system. Required 7 Years

title: Helpdesk Analyst
description:
• The Client seeking a Help Desk Analyst. The ideal candidate will excel in troubleshooting Windows 11, Active Directory, Microsoft O365, laptop equipment and other essential technologies while delivering top-notch customer service.
• Respond to and resolve technical support tickets related to Windows 11, Active Directory, Microsoft O365, network connectivity, VPN, and RDP.
• Assist users with password resets, PST file management, and Exchange Admin tasks.
• Provide hands-on and remote support for hardware, software, and IP phone systems (e.g., Microsoft Teams).
• Use ticket tracking systems to document, prioritize, and track user issues effectively.
• Troubleshoot advanced issues using tools like PowerShell for scripting and problem resolution.
• Support security and authentication tools such as OKTA and Crowdstrike.
• Maintain knowledge of AWS and SharePoint systems to assist users as needed.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to end-users via phone, email, and face-to-face interactions.
• Collaborate with IT teams to ensure smooth operation of company-wide systems.
• Some experience in a technical support or help desk role.
• Strong understanding of Windows 11, Active Directory, and Microsoft O365.
• Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, VPNs, and IP phone systems.
• Familiarity with security tools (OKTA, Crowdstrike) and cloud environments (AWS).
• Proficiency with ticket tracking systems and remote support tools.
• Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or similar are highly desirable.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with users of varying technical expertise.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting issues and resolutions.
