rawDescription:
Data Collection Admin Staff: The data collection staff will assist the Department in its statutory responsibilities related to sex and violent offender registration.

Administrative Assistant (Part-Time, 22.5 Hours per Week)
Indiana Sex and Violent Offender Registry
The Indiana Sex and Violent Offender Registry is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to provide administrative and customer service support for registry operations. This position serves as a key point of contact for the public, criminal justice partners, and agency staff while helping ensure accurate records management and efficient office operations.
Primary Responsibilities
Answer incoming telephone calls, provide general information, and route callers to the appropriate staff member.
Document calls and inquiries in a tracking system to maintain accurate records.
Receive, sort, log, and distribute incoming mail, including general correspondence, legal documents, administrative appeals, and other official communications.
Document incoming mail in a tracking system to ensure proper recordkeeping and case tracking.
Maintain and update agency contact lists and other administrative records.
Generate reports and compile statistical information using agency data systems.
Monitor and respond to a shared email inbox, ensuring inquiries are addressed or routed appropriately.
Schedule meetings and coordinate calendars for registry staff.
Track deadlines for administrative appeals and other time-sensitive correspondence.
Assist with public records requests by gathering, organizing, and preparing responsive documents.
Perform quality assurance reviews of tracking-system entries to ensure completeness and accuracy.
Scan, index, and electronically file records and correspondence.
Assist with data-cleanup projects and verification of registry-related information.
Coordinate certified mailings and maintain mailing logs.
Update website content or prepare information for publication, as assigned.
Maintain electronic and paper filing systems in accordance with records retention requirements.
Prepare correspondence, forms, and other administrative documents.
Provide customer service support to stakeholders, offenders, law enforcement agencies, courts, attorneys, and members of the public.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
Ability to accurately enter and manage data in multiple systems.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
Experience with administrative support, records management, or customer service.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently.

title: VP Sales – Growth Markets (West & North India, SAARC & ASEAN)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

We build software products that empower people to make the world their home, giving them the freedom to live and work from anywhere. Our solutions foster better work-life harmony, inclusivity, and diversity. By enabling organizations to establish secure, agile, and cost-efficient work-from-anywhere infrastructures, we help create a happier, more productive workforce while enhancing security and reducing operational costs.

It is a fast-growing cybersecurity and enterprise IT infrastructure product company from India, on a mission to become a $100 million revenue company and a unicorn within the next four years. But our ambition isn’t just about valuation or headlines—it’s about creating a success story that inspires and empowers the next generation of deep-tech entrepreneurs in India. Through journey, we aim to pave the way for more world-class product companies to emerge from India and make a global impact.

Out Digital Workspace suite includes Zero Trust-based Application Access Gateway, EUC Virtualization via VDI, and comprehensive Identity & Access Management solutions like MFA and SSO. The suite is designed to protect against network-based threats and unauthorized access, crucial in today's remote working environment. Headquartered in Pune, It has become a significant player in the EUC domain, providing a one-stop solution for organizations to deploy work-from-anywhere solutions swiftly and securely. It continues to innovate in digital workspace solutions, focusing on security, user experience, and organizational efficiency.

Mission

Drive and scale company' revenue across West & North India, SAARC, and ASEAN by establishing a high-performance sales engine, deepening customer relationships, and expanding channel partnerships.

Functional Skills Required

Mandatory:

• 20+ years of industry experience in IT sales, with a strong focus on Cybersecurity and IT Infrastructure products.
• Proven track record of driving multi-million-dollar software revenue.
• Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles and complex deal structuring.
• Strong C-level engagement skills.
• Mumbai-based and willing to travel extensively across the region.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE (Good-to-Have)

• Experience in selling VDI, ZTNA, or IAM solutions.
• Strong background in managing regional teams and scaling sales organizations.
• Expertise in working with a channel-driven sales model.
Soft Skills Required

• An entrepreneurial mindset with a results-driven approach.
• Highly proactive and hands-on leader, capable of driving execution.
• Passion for building and scaling high-growth sales organizations.
• Strong communication skills (verbal and written both)
• Proactive
• Self-motivated
• Logical bent of mind (Analytical)
• Team player & quick learner
• Flexible/adaptable
• Multi-Tasking
• Excellent team player
• Self-motivated individual who works well independently and enthusiastically
Role and Responsibilities:

Revenue Growth:

Achieve and exceed an annual software invoicing target of $8M+ within the first 12 months.

Ensure a sustainable 40%+ YoY growth across all regions.

Market Expansion & Customer Acquisition:

• Secure at least 10 new enterprise customers per quarter.
• Expand footprint within the BFSI, and Large Enterprise segments.
• Channel & Partner Ecosystem Growth:
• Onboard and activate at least five high-impact channel partners in key markets.
• Drive 70%+ of revenue through the partner network.
• Sales Team Leadership & Development:
• Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing regional sales team.
• Implement a structured sales methodology with clear KPIs and execution plans.
Strategic Account Management:

• Establish deep relationships with CIOs, CISOs, and decision-makers in the target industries.
• Increase  share-of-wallet within existing key accounts by 2X in 12 months.

title: Project Lead Implementation
description:
Key Responsibilities:

• Own end-to-end implementation of multiple IT development and enhancement projects, from planning through deployment.
• Oversee Scrum Masters, drive accountability and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
• Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and delivery commitments.
• Ensure project plans, status reports, trackers and documentation are accurate and up to date.
• Coordinate with technical leads, business stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
• Drive project governance, issue resolution, follow-ups and closure of action items.
• Provide consolidated implementation status, proactively highlighting risks, delays and decisions requiring leadership attention.
Required Skills & Experience:

• 8–12 years of IT experience, with at least 4–5 years managing multiple concurrent projects or delivery teams.
• Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum and IT project delivery practices.
• Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence and project reporting tools.
• Experience managing Scrum Masters and coordinating multiple delivery teams.
• Strong stakeholder management, communication and problem-solving skills.
• Experience working with US-based clients and distributed teams.
• Self-driven, assertive, detail-oriented and capable of independently driving execution.
Key Expectation: Someone who takes complete ownership of implementation activities, gets work done through teams, anticipates challenges and ensures leadership has clear visibility without having to chase routine updates.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
• The agency needs the service of a senior level Full Stack Developer. The candidate will serve in the capacity of a Developer participating in various SDLC processes including requirements verification, design and development, testing, maintenance, and support activities per the direction of agency management. The specific focus of this candidate will be the to be part of the team which supports existing custom Salesforce applications as well as to participates in the SDLC process of the new KIND system and work with the System Integrator to ensure the transfer of knowledge and on-going maintenance of the solution for a given module. The candidate must have a minimum of 5 years of Salesforce development. Must know foundational OOP in apex.

Specific Services Required:

• In the role of the Salesforce Developer, the following services are required:
• Must be very organized, pro-active and self-directed.
• Must be self-starter and driven. Must Drive the work from requirements to implementation.
• Must have very strong abstract thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Must have very good verbal and written communication skills.
• Design and development Salesforce APEX, Lightning pages, Visual Force Pages
• Full stack. Salesforce, OOP, CRUD, Design patterns, Configuration SOQL
• Must have advanced knowledge of Salesforce development (OOP, Design Patterns)
• Bd  Provide analysis/requirements to integrate applications.
• Work on all phases of SDLC and create/maintain required technical documentation.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Refer to the contracts for IT Professional Services Agreement (22PSX0163) for experience and skill requirements for the job classification Solution Architect to fill the role.  In addition, the agency requires:
• For this position, the candidate shares experience and judgment with team to plan and accomplish goals, mentors less experienced staff, a wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. In addition, the agency requires:
• An experience professional with 10 or more years of prior experience demonstrating the following knowledge and skills:
• Salesforce (min: 5 years) Must be able to code APEX OOP and know design patterns.
• .NET OOP and SOA
• JavaScript Frameworks preferred
• SQL
• End-to-End Web Development

title: Programmer 5 /PR5
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Support/ Developer to support the Support Enforcement Tracking System (SETS)modernized platform. The SETS application was originally developed using COBOL,IMS, and JCL on the mainframe and has been modernized to a Microsoft Azure cloud-based architecture utilizing C#, .NET, and SQL Server.
• While the application now operates on a modern technology platform, many business processes, program structures, transaction flows, batch patterns, and data access methods reflect the original mainframe design. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in COBOL, IMS, and JCL and be capable of applying that knowledge to analyze, troubleshoot, enhance, and support the modernized .NET application.
• This position requires the ability to bridge legacy and modern technologies, perform detailed application analysis, support production operations, resolve complex system issues, and work collaboratively with technical and business teams supporting critical statewide services.
• This is not a traditional COBOL developer position. The application has been modernized to C#/.NET and SQL Server in Azure. However, successful candidates must possess strong COBOL, IMS, and JCL expertise because the application's design patterns, business rules, batch processing concepts, and data access methods originate from the legacy mainframe implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Modernized SETS Application Support

• Monitor and support daily batch processing activities and critical business workflows.
• Analyze and resolve production incidents, application failures, data issues, and system performance concerns.
• Perform impact analysis and root cause analysis for reported defects and operational issues.
• Support application releases, deployments, and post-implementation validation activities.
• Participate in on-call support and after-hours production support activities as required.
• Analyze and support a modernized SETS application operating in Microsoft Azure using C#, .NET, and SQL Server.
• Utilize COBOL, IMS, and JCL expertise to understand and support business processes and application logic that originated in the legacy mainframe environment.
• Interpret legacy program designs, processing flows, batch schedules, and data structures to diagnose production issues and support enhancements.
• Work with developers, architects, and business analysts to translate legacy processing logic into modern technical solutions.
• Analyze system interfaces, batch processing workflows, and data movement processes between applications and external partners.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 10+ years of application development and support experience.
• Extensive experience with COBOL development in large-scale enterprise environments.
• Strong experience with IMS databases and transaction processing.
• Strong experience with JCL, batch scheduling, and production support.
• Experience supporting applications that have been migrated or modernized from COBOL/mainframe technologies to .NET, SQL Server or cloud-based platforms.
• Experience interpreting legacy COBOL programs and translating business logic into modern application environments.
• Experience with relational databases and SQL development.
• Experience troubleshooting complex production incidents and performing root cause analysis.
• Strong understanding of batch processing, file-based integrations, data conversion methodologies, and application interfaces.
• Experience supporting mission-critical systems with high availability requirements.
• Excellent analytical and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting applications hosted in Microsoft Azure.
• Experience with C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, or .NET 8 development.
• Experience with SQL Server database development and support.
• Experience supporting modernized legacy applications.
• Experience with automated testing and DevOps practices.
• Experience with application monitoring and performance analysis tools.
• Experience working within government, human services, healthcare, or eligibility systems.
• Experience with modernization tools and automated code conversion initiatives.
Ideal Candidate
• The successful candidate will possess a unique combination of legacy and modern application expertise. The individual must be comfortable analyzing COBOL and IMS-based business processes while supporting a cloud-hosted C#/.NET application running in Azure.
• Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, an ability to understand complex child support and case management workflows, and the capability to bridge traditional mainframe concepts with modern application architecture.

title: Business Analyst 2(BA2)
description:
• The Client is seeking a mid-level Business Analyst to lead requirements gathering, analyze business processes, and support solution delivery. 
• Must have strong analytical skills, experience with Azure DevOps or similar tools, and excellent communication abilities. 
• Agile experience and SQL knowledge preferred.

Responsibilities

Requirements Analysis & Documentation

• Lead requirements elicitation sessions with business stakeholders and technical teams.
• Analyze and document business processes, workflows, and system interactions.
• Develop detailed business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
• Ensure requirements are clear, complete, and traceable throughout the project lifecycle.

Solution Design & Validation

• Collaborate with architects and developers to ensure solutions align with business needs.
• Support testing activities by creating test cases, validating functionality, and coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT).
• Identify gaps, risks, and dependencies; propose mitigation strategies.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Act as a primary point of contact for business units during project execution.
• Facilitate workshops, demos, and status meetings to ensure alignment and transparency.
• Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

Process Improvement & Mentorship

• Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
• Mentor junior Business Analysts and share best practices.
• Contribute to standards and templates for documentation and requirements management.
Skills Required:

• Experience as a Business Analyst or similar role	Required	5	Years
• Strong understanding of business process modeling, requirements elicitation techniques, and documentation standards.	Required
• Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Office, Visio, and requirements management platforms (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira).	Required
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.	Required
• Experience in Agile/Scrum environments; familiarity with writing user stories and acceptance criteria.	Required
• Knowledge of SQL for data analysis and validation.	Required
• Exposure to Azure DevOps for backlog management and traceability.	Required

title: Data Scientist- Junior
description:
The Client operates HealthConnex, the designated health information exchange supporting secure electronic sharing of health data across North Carolina. The unit connects healthcare organizations, improves data quality, and advances interoperability initiatives that enhance care coordination and public health outcomes.
The Junior Data Scientist supports operational, analytical, and quality improvement initiatives within the Client. Responsibilities include cleaning, valdating, transforming, and summarizing data; monitoring automated workflows; troubleshooting pipeline issues; merging complex files; and contributing to dashboards, automations, and integrated reporting processes. The position will identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve operational workflows, reduce repetitive tasks through automation, and support continuous process improvement initiatives. The Junior Data Scientist will also support KPI initiatives and report development, including dashboards for executive and operations reporting. This role will support recurring monthly reporting systems, documentation efforts, development of standard operating procedures, and implementation of efficient, scalable business processes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Data Tools

• Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and merging complex datasets

• Familiarity with Power BI, Smartsheet, Tableau, and Salesforce reporting tools

• Familiarity with basic SQL queries and data extraction techniques

• Ability to use data and reporting tools to improve efficiency and automate routine processes

Process Improvement & Workflow Optimization

• Ability to analyze business processes and identify opportunities for workflow improvements and operational efficiencies

• Experience documenting, standardizing, and optimizing manual processes

• Ability to develop repeatable, scalable solutions that improve data quality, consistency, and operational performance

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on reducing manual effort and improving process effectiveness

Productivity & Project Tools

• Basic familiarity with Jira and Asana

• Ability to track operational work, reporting requirements, and process improvement initiatives through project management tools

Growth Mindset

• Curious, proactive, and effective at problem solving

• Demonstrates initiative in identifying process inefficiencies and recommending practical solutions

Education and Experience Required

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, Statistics, Data Science, Public Health, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience:

• Experience working with operational and healthcare data in academic projects, internships, or professional roles

• Experience cleaning data, merging files, and preparing structured datasets for reporting and analysis

• Familiarity with Salesforce for pulling reports, reviewing data fields, or supporting basic operational workflows

• Experience documenting processes, procedures, or workflows in SOPs

• Basic understanding of SQL for simple querying, filtering, and data extraction

• Experience supporting recurring reporting tasks or monthly data cycles

• Exposure to dashboard creation using Power BI, Smartsheet, Tableau, or similar reporting tools

• Experience identifying opportunities to streamline operational processes and reduce manual effort

• Experience supporting workflow automation, process standardization, or continuous improvement initiatives

• Experience developing or improving recurring reporting processes and operational workflows

title: IT Inventory Associate
description:
• Assist ITIM personnel in daily management of IT inventory intake, delivery, moves and upgrades of all tagged IT equipment including desktops, laptops, printers, tablets, phones, A/V equipment, networking equipment, and other IT related equipment.
• This person will only be required to work on the Kennesaw Campus. They will be alternating work locations on the campus, based on need of support and mission requirements (10% travel). The chosen candidate will also have the "convenience" of traveling between work locations and utilizing campus transportation at no charge. As required by law, if they are driving on campus to work with a POV, they will be required to have a valid driver's license, current vehicle registration, and valid car insurance.

Job duties & Responsibilities:

1. Updates service request and task progress in appropriate system(s)

2. Receive and evaluate new and returned IT equipment, assign asset tags as required, and ensure all equipment is updated in the IT inventory and asset database(s)

3. Maintain accurate inventory records of all IT (to include computers, A/V equipment, networking equipment, etc.) inventory and assets received, stored, deployed, and retired

4. Responsible for affixing RFID tags to equipment for inventory and tracking purposes

5. Perform location maintenance to ensure that consumables and assets are not co-mingled, and are the proper location in within the Asset Management System of record

6. Assist Team with the organization and maintenance of the IT storerooms or warehouses

7. Accurately pulls stock and/or new items to fill parts list for upcoming installations and projects

8. Processes IT inventory surplus by following proper USG and procedures and accurately updating the IT inventory database

9. Maintains a neat and orderly working environment and files various IT inventory documents in accordance with ITOP processes

Required Experience:

• Two (2) years of related experience in warehousing, material storage, inventory processing, and asset management

ABILITIES:

• Able to act as a customer advocate to continuously improve process responsiveness and customer service; Able to anticipate problems and proactively develop appropriate solutions; Able to appropriately assess and communicate risks, benefits, and alternatives; Able to handle multiple tasks at one time meeting assigned deadlines; Able to interface appropriately and professionally with students, faculty, staff, and grant sponsors

SKILLS:

• Self-starter with strong interpersonal, initiative, teamwork, problem solving, organization, communication (verbal and written), time management, and relationship building, along with an ability to translate between technical and functional teams; Proficient with computer applications and programs
• associated with the position (i.e. Microsoft Office suite); Strong attention to detail and follow up skills; Strong customer service skills and phone and e-mail etiquette.

title: Program Manager
description:
• Define and maintain a program business case and roadmap that connects the program's constituent projects to the Client and agency strategic objectives, adjusting program scope and sequencing as strategic priorities shift.
• Evaluate proposed projects and initiatives for fit within the program, recommending inclusion, deferral, or exclusion based on alignment to program benefits and enterprise priorities.
• Partner with PMCOE leadership and agency executives to ensure the program's direction remains aligned with the CIO's strategic priorities and the  IT investment portfolio.
Program Life Cycle Management

• Lead the program through its full life cycle: definition, benefits delivery, and closure, sequencing and integrating the constituent projects that comprise the program rather than managing any single project in isolation.
• Develop and maintain a program plan that integrates the schedules, budgets, resource plans, and dependencies of multiple concurrent projects, identifying and resolving cross-project conflicts before they surface at the project level.
• Establish and manage a program-level risk and issue register, distinguishing risks that originate within a single project from risks that arise from interdependencies across the program's projects.
• Coordinate resource allocation and prioritization across the program's constituent projects, resolving competing demands for shared personnel, vendors, or infrastructure.
Benefits Management

• Define the program's intended benefits at initiation and maintain a benefits realization plan that tracks how each constituent project contributes to those benefits over time.
• Establish benefit metrics and measurement approaches, monitoring realization throughout the program life cycle rather than only at project closeout.
• Identify when a constituent project's outputs are no longer expected to contribute to program benefits, and recommend re-scoping, re-sequencing, or termination of that project accordingly.
• Lead the transition of program benefits into sustained operations, working with agency stakeholders to confirm that realized benefits are maintained after program closure.
Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and sustain productive working relationships with agency executives, IT directors, business owners, vendors, and VITA leadership across all projects within the program, serving as the primary point of accountability for program-level outcomes.
• Develop and execute a program-level stakeholder engagement and communication plan, ensuring that agency executives and VITA leadership receive integrated program status rather than a series of disconnected project updates.
• Facilitate program steering committee meetings, cross-project working sessions, and executive briefings, preparing agendas, materials, and follow-up action items that reflect the program as a whole.
• Navigate organizational complexity and political dynamics across multiple agencies with professionalism, diplomacy, and a solutions-oriented approach.
Program Governance

• Establish and operate program-level governance structures, including a steering committee and defined decision rights, distinct from the governance of any single constituent project.
• Ensure the program and its constituent projects comply with IT governance requirements and PMD/ITIM gate expectations, escalating unresolved governance concerns through appropriate PMCOE and VITA channels.
• Prepare and maintain program-level artifacts required for governance submissions, including program charters, integrated risk registers, benefits realization reports, and executive status reporting.
• Contribute to PMCOE knowledge management by documenting program-level lessons learned, cross-project coordination practices, and process improvements that benefit future program engagements.
• Participate in PMCOE portfolio reviews, contributing program-level data and status that inform cross-agency portfolio reporting and executive briefings.
• Single-Project Leadership (As Assigned)
• Step in as the direct project manager on a high-risk, high-visibility, or otherwise critical project when PMCOE leadership determines that program-level experience is warranted at the individual project level.
• Apply the same rigor to an individually led project, scope, schedule, budget, and risk management, while maintaining visibility into how that project's outcomes affect the broader program, if applicable.
Required Qualifications

• PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, active and in good standing, is required.
• 7 or more years of progressive IT program and project management experience, including demonstrated experience managing programs comprising multiple, interdependent projects rather than single-project delivery alone.
• Demonstrated experience in benefits management: defining, tracking, and reporting on program benefits across a multi-year program life cycle.
• Knowledge of program management standards and frameworks, including PMI's Standard for Program Management, and their distinction from project-level frameworks such as the PMBOK Guide.
• Knowledge of cross-project resource, schedule, and dependency management, including techniques for resolving conflicts between concurrent projects competing for shared resources.
• Knowledge of program governance structures, including steering committee design and program-level decision rights distinct from project-level governance.
• Skill in producing integrated, executive-ready, program status reporting that synthesizes multiple projects into a coherent program-level narrative.
• Skill in facilitating governance and steering sessions with senior stakeholders across multiple agencies or business units.
• Ability to manage competing priorities, ambiguous requirements, and organizational complexity across a multi-project program in a fast-paced, multi-agency government environment.
• Ability to build trust and credibility with senior agency stakeholders, navigating political dynamics with professionalism and diplomacy.
• Ability to lead a single project directly and effectively when assigned, while maintaining primary orientation toward program-level responsibilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to adapt message and format to audience.
Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Analysis, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Public Administration, or a closely related field; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
• Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification in addition to PMP.
• Experience working within or in direct support of  agencies, particularly in an IT program or portfolio delivery capacity.
• Familiarity with IT governance frameworks, including VITA's PMD/ITIM framework and the IT Strategic Planning (ITSP) process.
• Experience with Planview Portfolios or a comparable enterprise PPM platform for program and cross-project scheduling, resource management, and status reporting.
• SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe for Government, or comparable program-level Agile scaling certification.
• Experience managing programs that involve multiple third-party vendor contracts, including oversight of vendor deliverables, SLA compliance, and contract change management across concurrent projects.
• Experience leading program-level recovery or stabilization efforts spanning multiple at-risk or troubled projects.
• Experience preparing governance documentation such as program charters, benefits realization reports, and stage gate review packages.

title: IT Consultant 1/ITC1
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced WebSphere and System Integration Technology Consultant to serve as a senior technical advisor and enterprise consultants for application platform services, cloud technologies, and system integration solutions. 
• The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience with WebSphere Application Server, enterprise integration platforms, container technologies, and cloud infrastructure while providing strategic guidance to IT leadership and project teams on technology direction, modernization initiatives, and enterprise architecture.

Total Years of Relevant Experience

Required Experience (Minimum 12 Years Total)

• 8+ years providing expert administration and consulting for application server platform such as WebSphere Application Server environments
• 2+ years advising and supporting cloud technologies including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.
• 3+ years of MuleSoft administration and integration platform consulting.
• 4+ years of Red Hat OpenShift administration and container platform management.
• 5+ years managing application security technologies and security best practices.
• 5+ years supporting government agencies or large public-sector organizations.
• 5+ years providing senior-level technical consultation and strategic recommendations to IT management.
• 5+ years evaluating and advising on emerging technologies, modernization strategies, and enterprise solutions.

Preferred Education

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent technical experience.

Role Description

• Participate in on-call support rotations as required.
Technology Consulting & Strategic Advisory
• Serve as a trusted advisor to IT leadership on enterprise application platform strategy, cloud adoption, modernization initiatives, and infrastructure solutions.
• Provide technical consultation and recommendations for cloud, container, middleware, security, and integration technologies.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and develop implementation strategies to support business and technology objectives.
• Lead architectural discussions and technology reviews for enterprise-wide initiatives.
• Advise project teams on platform selection, deployment models, integration patterns, and operational best practices.
• Conduct technology assessments, risk analyses, root cause investigations, and improvement recommendations.
• Champion automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technical Knowledge

• Extensive expertise with WebSphere, RabbitMQ, MuleSoft, Unix/Linux administration, networking, and enterprise integration technologies.
• Strong understanding of network architecture, application connectivity, and hybrid cloud environments.
• Advanced knowledge of high availability, scalability, resiliency, and disaster recovery strategies.
• Expertise in Single Sign-On (SSO), load balancing, firewall management, IP subnet configuration, and enterprise security controls.
• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms including Splunk and Dynatrace.
• Knowledge of CI/CD technologies including Ansible, Jenkins, Nexus, Maven, and Bitbucket.
• Understanding of storage technologies, application security frameworks, and API security practices.
• Expertise with web services, data integration techniques, and API transformation technologies including JSON and SOAP.

Enterprise Platform Administration & Integration

• Lead WebSphere upgrades, patching, security remediation, and platform lifecycle management.
• Administer and support RabbitMQ, MuleSoft, and other enterprise integration platforms.
• Manage OpenShift and container platforms, including security, governance, automation, and operations.
• Monitor platform performance and availability and lead troubleshooting and resolution efforts.
• Partner with development teams to design, implement, and maintain highly available production environments.
• Install, configure, and optimize OpenShift and Azure Kubernetes Service in on-premises and cloud environments, as well as WebSphere on AIX and Linux.
• Support Apache, IBM HTTP Server, IIS, and SSL security implementations.

Cloud, Containerization & Modernization

• Provide expert guidance on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud services and deployment models.
• Design and support application hosting strategies across both on-premises and cloud environments.
• Recommend infrastructure and platform solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards.
• Lead cloud migration, modernization, and platform transformation initiatives.
• Provide subject matter expertise in containers, microservices, Kubernetes, and OpenShift technologies.
• Develop strategies for modernization, automation, and orchestration of enterprise application, container platforms on both on-prem and cloud.
• This role requires a seasoned technology consultant and enterprise platform expert who can combine deep technical expertise with strategic advisory capabilities to help drive modernization, strengthen enterprise architecture, and guide the adoption of cloud-native and container-based solutions across the organization.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Purpose of the Position:

This position serves as the Administrative Assistant supporting Audiology and Educational Evaluation service planning and delivery within the Center for Deaf and Hard of Hearing Education at the Indiana Department of Health (IDOH).

The Administrative Assistant provides administrative support for all onsite services, including welcoming and assisting families and professional visitors, scheduling appointments, processing referrals, managing record requests, and overseeing the daily operations of the Family Services Hub. This position collaborates closely with Center Educational Audiologists and the Center Assessment Team to ensure families receive timely, accurate, and effective communication regarding services and appointments.

The position is responsible for coordinating the collection, maintenance, and distribution of records in accordance with parent or guardian consent and established Center procedures. Additionally, the Administrative Assistant maintains child files related to onsite service delivery and ensures records are complete, accurate, and accessible as needed.

The primary goal of this position is to provide exceptional administrative support that enables families, collaborating professionals, and Center staff to successfully navigate onsite services and appointments while ensuring a positive and well-coordinated experience.

Essential Duties:

• Process, track, and coordinate audiology and educational evaluation referrals.
• Schedule and coordinate appointments with families and collaborating professionals.
• Monitor upcoming appointments by sending and documenting confirmations, reminders, and other communications via text, email, and phone; collaborate with the Assessment Team PERL to address family and professional needs.
• Distribute evaluation and audiology reports in a timely manner via mail, email, or fax in accordance with Center procedures and family preferences.
• Accurately document all communications, activities, and actions related to children and families within the STAR database.
• Provide administrative and logistical support to audiology and assessment staff before, during, and after appointments to ensure families and visiting professionals receive exceptional customer service and support.
• Gather, organize, and prepare child information from multiple sources, including school districts, physicians, audiologists, and families, to develop comprehensive child profiles.
• Maintain and manage child and student records in both paper and electronic formats, ensuring confidentiality and compliance with applicable policies and procedures.
• Coordinate spoken language and sign language interpreter services for onsite appointments in accordance with Center procedures.
• Manage deliveries received through the Family Services Hub, including processing hearing aid and equipment invoices, packing slips, and related documentation.
• Serve as the primary point of contact at the Family Services Hub entrance by welcoming scheduled and unscheduled visitors, notifying staff of arrivals, and assisting visitors in navigating the facility.
• Monitor and maintain the Family Services Hub lobby and consultation room to ensure spaces remain clean, organized, welcoming, and ready for appointments.
• Monitor designated IDOH audiology and assessment inboxes and calendars to support timely communication and service coordination.
• Distribute family satisfaction surveys following onsite services and collect responses according to established procedures.
• Support compliance with Center policies, procedures, confidentiality requirements, and records management practices.
• Foster positive relationships with families, community partners, and Center staff through professional, responsive, and customer-focused communication.

Job Requirements:

• Three (3) years of experience in healthcare or education office managing visitors, scheduling and paperwork with knowledge of privacy and records-management requirements through HIPAA/FERPA

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Demonstrated ability to maintain a positive, professional, and supportive demeanor when interacting with families, visitors, partners, and staff.
• Ability to establish priorities, manage competing demands, meet deadlines, and effectively coordinate multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• Knowledge of, or the ability to learn, State of Indiana systems and applications utilized in the performance of position duties, including PeopleSoft and other agency-specific systems.
• Thorough understanding of the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), including requirements for maintaining confidentiality and protecting child and family information.
• Working knowledge of office policies, procedures, programs, and services, with the ability to apply them appropriately to a variety of situations.
• Ability to identify potential barriers to service delivery, anticipate challenges, and implement effective solutions in a timely manner.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with families, educators, healthcare providers, and agency staff.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams, for communication, scheduling, record management, and administrative support functions.
• Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation while ensuring attention to detail and compliance with established procedures.
• Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain electronic and physical filing systems.
• Ability to provide exceptional customer service and create a welcoming, family-centered environment for visitors and stakeholders.
• Ability to work collaboratively and effectively with diverse families, community partners, and multidisciplinary teams.
• Ability to learn and utilize database systems, electronic records systems, and other technology platforms necessary to support program operations.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently while exercising initiative, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.

Supervisory Responsibilities/Direct Reports:

• This position does not provide direct supervision for staff members/contractors.

Difficulty of Work:

• Work is administrative in nature and demands the ability to prioritize and juggle competing activities. The ability to efficiently and effectively complete tasks is required. Must desire to work as a member of an active, busy team that focuses on effecting positive outcomes with children and families. Must have an excellent mental attitude and have high regard for others as well as self.

Responsibility:

• Incumbent works independently under the supervision of the Center’s Assessment and Audiology Team Lead. Decisions and major recommendations are reviewed for compliance with agency policy and attainment of goals.
• Personal Work Relationships:
• The employee works closely with a variety of stakeholders, primarily families of children who are deaf or hard of hearing, and may include health care providers, educational personnel, and other professionals. The employee is expected to maintain positive rapport with these individuals as well as other internal and external partners.

Physical Effort:

• The employee must be physically able to type on a computer, to manage an office area, to communicate via telephone, and to sit and/or stand at a workstation for a 7.5-hour workday.

Working Conditions:

• Work is performed in an indoor office setting at a reception desk managing an entry and lobby area.
Required / Desired Amountof Experience

• Experience in a healthcare or education front office, handling visitors, scheduling, and paperwork. - Required 3 Years
• Thorough understanding of both HIPAA and FERPA, including confidentiality and protecting child and family information. - Required 3 Years
• Prior experience with medical record management, both paper and electronic formats, with attention to detail and complaince. - Required 3 Years
• Prior experience booking appointments, sending reminders, confirmations, etc. by tax, email and phone - Required 3 Years
• Experience with Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams, plus monitoring shared inboxes and calendars. - Required 3 Years
• Experience with deaf and hard of hearing families - Highly desired
• Experience with the STAR database for documentation. - Nice to have
• Experience with People Soft. - Nice to have

title: Senior Application Systems Analyst and Designer
description:

title: Application Support/Technical Support Analyst 3
description:
Short Description:

The Oracle Health Patient Accounting (OHPAC) Application Support Specialist provides Tier1 support to end users of Oracle Health Patient Accounting and related Patient Accounting areas. This position provides technical and functional expertise to troubleshoot application issues, support user and system configuration, monitor key OHPAC functions, and assist with maintaining stable and effective patient accounting operations. The specialist serves as a first point of contact for end users, resolving issues when possible and escalating complex problems to appropriate Tier 2, technical, implementation, or vendor support teams.

Complete Description:

• The Oracle Health Patient Accounting (OHPAC) Application Support Specialist provides Tier 1, first-call-resolution support to end users utilizing Oracle Health Patient Accounting and related patient accounting areas.
• This role plays avital role in supporting the successful implementation and sustainment phases of the VDH Electronic Health Record initiative and help ensures deployed EHR capabilities remain stable, fully operational, and effectively adopted by end-users through post-cutover health checks, issue tracking, and sustainment readiness planning.
• Provides Tier 1 clinical support to meet and exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and follow ITIL processes.
• Triages end user issues and determines if the issue can be resolved at Tier 1 or if it needs to be escalated to Tier 2.
• Must understand VDH and  Local Health Department EHR policies, procedures, and workflows and Oracle Health-specific procedures to resolve issues.
• Acquires and maintains a general and clinical knowledge of client and related software applications.
• Attends professional development training as instructed.
• Maintains necessary technology skills to perform common client specific First Call Resolution (FCR) tasks, with training, including password resets, Citrix troubleshooting, common desktop troubleshooting, etc.
• Conduct pre- and post-go-live system health checks to verify operational readiness and functionality of the deployed Electronic Health Record (EHR) solution at each VDH facility
• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and system usage metrics to identify early warning signs of functional or technical degradation
• Participate and help sustain readiness checklists and site health status dashboards for EHR leadership and Go-Live command center operations
• Contribute to lessons learned, issue trend analysis, and process improvements for future site deployments and system rollouts
• Post-Go-Live Health Check Reports that assess system performance and user adoption following deployment
• Sustainment Readiness Checklists to evaluate preparedness for ongoing operations and support
• Knowledge Transfer Documentation to ensure continuity of operations and effective handoff to support teams
• Issue Resolution Logs and Trend Analyses to track, resolve, and analyze recurring challenges
• Exhibits a basic understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance (e.g., HIPAA). Skilled in the application of policies and procedures. Foundational Communication - Simple messages communicated orally. May write brief messages and keep simple records. May explain and offer guidance on routine procedures.
• Monitors specific OHPAC functions and operational indicators to identify potential application or workflow issues, including areas such as user configuration, work queues, processing functions, interfaces, printing, document management, and other patient accounting-related activities, as applicable.
Knowledge and Skills

• Foundational knowledge of Oracle Health Patient Accounting (OHPAC) and patient accounting/revenue-cycle workflows.
• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve routine OHPAC application issues and accurately escalate issues outside the scope of Tier 1 support.
• Ability to understand and follow established application support procedures, organizational policies, and standard operating procedures.
• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with end users, application teams, technical teams, leadership, and vendors.
• Ability to document incidents, troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and escalations accurately and consistently.
• Ability to recognize patterns in incidents and identify recurring application or workflow issues.
• Working knowledge of common end-user technologies, including desktop applications, Citrix environments, printing, user access, and related support functions.
• Understanding of healthcare privacy, security, and compliance requirements, including HIPAA.
• Demonstrates strong customer service skills and the ability to provide clear guidance to users with varying levels of technical expertise.
• Demonstrates the ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritize issues based on business impact, and work effectively in a time-sensitive environment.
• Foundational communication skills: communicates routine information clearly in person, by telephone, electronically, or through support documentation; provides guidance on standard procedures; and maintains accurate records of support activities.

title: Application Developer
description:
The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line-of-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists.

In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS / COdata) an OIT Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor.  The OIT Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge-transfer progression (shadowing, co-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer.

Scope of Responsibilities

• Data Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model.
• Transformation & Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect.
• Record Linkage & Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross-agency reconciliations.
• Production Pipeline Operations & Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects.
• Data Quality & Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes).
• Performance Optimization & Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake.
• Quality Assurance, Code Review & Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs.

Activities Performed

A. Ingestion & Pipeline Development (OIT-Led Feeds)

CDHE Courses Data Ingestion:

• Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements.
• Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner.
• Pair with 3 party implementation team  during ETL construction, validation, and promotion.

Postsecondary SES & Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional):

• Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources.
• Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible-use governance requirements.

PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional):

• Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE.
• Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles.

B. Knowledge Transfer & Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027)

Shadowing & Co-running (Jan–Feb 2027):

• Shadow 3rd party implementation partner engineers on day-to-day operations of existing data feeds (e.g., NSC, K-3, CDEC, and Phase 1 feeds).
• Co-run live feed cycles, handle data loading, execute record matching, and troubleshoot exceptions alongside 3rd party implementation partner.

Readiness Gate Execution (Target: March 2027):

• Run two consecutive feed cycles completely unaided to achieve formal operational hand-over sign-off.

Full Production Operations (March 2027 Onward):

• Execute recurring feed schedules, rebuild downstream objects, reconcile row counts against source files, and triage failed jobs.
• Address ad-hoc data inquiries and export requests from OIT leadership and partner agencies.

C. Data Stabilization & Analytics Layer Upkeep

• Stabilization Backlog Support: Resolve identified data reliability defects, run variations, and de-duplication issues transitioned from the Phase 1 stabilization backlog.
• Analytics Layer Hardening & Maintenance (April 2027 Onward):

title: IT Project Manager
description:
• Under limited supervision, manages projects through the full life cycle from project definition and approval through implementation and evaluation of all project deliverables. Provides guidance to the project team. May also serve in a lead role.
• The client Unified ERP Program is a multi-year program to replace the current institutional legacy systems for human capital management and financials improving the experience for students, faculty, and staff; streamlining core business processes; and unifying technology into a single, Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. This position is one of four limited term positions which there will be an active recruitment process. This program will require client to develop strategies and plans regarding system integrations, data cleansing and conversion, historical data plans, reporting requirements, and technically focused tasks.  As such, there is a need to have a dedicated project manager focused specifically on these technical areas and ensure client is positioned to successfully manage the technical transitions.

Position Summary
• This role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of a major ERP transformation. This position plays a critical role in the implementation and  optimization of a large-scale ERP system, with a strong emphasis on project delivery. This position will provide support to the client Unified Team Project Director, Change Management Lead, Program Manager, and Project Facilitators for Finance, Human Resources, Service Delivery, and Change Management. Job responsibilities and percentage of time may evolve based on project needs. 
• The IT Project Manager will lead and coordinate planning, execution, and delivery of client enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence initiatives. This role engages with cross-functional teams responsible for data architecture, ETL development, data integration, reporting, analytics, and cloud-based data platforms. complex technical workstreams, including system integrations, data cleansing and conversion, historical data plans, reporting requirements, and related technical deliverables. By applying rigorous project management practices and a deep understanding of enterprise systems, this role ensures the successful planning, execution, and delivery of ERP-related technical initiatives. Working closely with IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, the position supports the comprehensive technical strategy of enterprise data and systems. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a technically complex environment and is motivated by delivering reliable, scalable solutions that enable enterprise-wide operations and decision-making.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Strong understanding of project management principles and methodologies
• Excellent facilitation skills along with written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to develop planning materials and facilitate cross-functional technical sessions
• Strong organizational and analytical skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs
• Strong ability to influence without direct authority and build relationships across diverse stakeholder groups
• Knowledge of Workday, Smartsheet, and/or PeopleSoft

Duties/Responsibilities
1. Project Management (60%)
• Apply formal project management principles and practices during the planning, implementation, monitoring and completion of projects
• Create detailed project plans for completion of tasks that consider schedules, dependencies, institutional priorities, and resource limitations and conflicts
• Coordinate efforts of project teams to facilitate cooperation and prevent delays
• Develop and maintain standard project management documentation, such as project charters, project plans, timeline visuals, risk registers, issues logs, meeting agendas and summaries, and project status reports
• Proactively oversee project execution by following up on the completion of tasks, reporting potential delays to management, and coordinating problem resolution efforts in the event of technical difficulties
• Lead or attend regular meetings to update leadership, staff, clients, and the client community on the progress of projects
• Utilize standard status reporting templates and tools such as scorecards, dashboards, and other visuals to represent project progress
• Coordinate technical projects that require knowledge of application development, systems integration, and the software development lifecycle. 
• Manage application development and system integration projects, including phases such as software design, coding, testing, and deployment.
• Utilize best practices for continuous improvement and industry standards software development methodologies such as DevOps.
• Assist project teams in software evaluation, procurement, and vendor management processes to carry out technical projects.
• Develop and maintain various systems analysis documentation to capture data flow, system architecture, specifications, and quality assurance information.

2. Stakeholder Coordination (30%)
• Serve as a liaison between functional and technical teams as well as campus stakeholders
• Facilitate collaboration and ensure alignment across groups
• Develop and facilitate formal presentations to project stakeholders when needed
• Clearly and professionally communicate objectives, progress, risks, and issues to project Stakeholders
• Convey project team questions, updates, or concerns to leadership in a timely manner
• Respond to inquiries about project details from leadership and project team members in a timely manner

3. Change Management & Communications (10%)
• Coordinate with change management team on change management strategies and plans
• Coordinate with change management team on communication plans for stakeholders
• Ensure consistent and clear messaging across the organization
• Support stakeholder engagement and readiness activities
• Coordinate communications between functional and technical teams

Impact and Influence
• This position interacts with stakeholders across all levels of the organization, including leadership, project teams, and end users. The role has significant influence on project success through effective technical planning and coordination.

About the Project
• The Unified Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Program intends to replace the current institutional legacy systems for human capital management, financials, and student information, improving the experience for students, faculty, and staff; streamlining core business processes; and unifying technology into a single, Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. client Project Website.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., Business, Information Systems, Organizational Development) or equivalent and 2 years of professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications
• 2+ years of experience in project management, technical implementations or related roles supporting or leading ERP implementations or other large-scale system transformations
• CAPM/PMP preferred. CAPM or PMP required within 6 months of employment date.
• 2+ years of experience working in higher education, public sector, or similarly complex organizational environments
• 2 + years experience working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders 
• 2+ years of experience coordinating cross-functional teams in fast-paced, evolving environments
• 2+ years of experience with Project Management Tools for project tracking.

title: Database Architect
description:
• Supervises the coordination of design and security for computer databases to store, track, and maintain a large volume of critical business information.
• The client Unified ERP Program is replacing legacy systems for human capital management, financials, and student information with a unified Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. The transition requires client to sustain operational and analytical reporting while establishing a future-client data warehouse and integration foundation. The Data Warehouse Architect will provide dedicated expertise for this work, reducing reporting disruption and supporting reliable access to institutional data during and after implementation.

Position Summary
• The Data Warehouse Architect will establish the future-client reporting and analytics architecture for client’s transition to Workday. The role will define how Workday reporting, the institutional data warehouse, data lake services, legacy data, and downstream analytics fit together. Working with information technology and project stakeholders, the Architect will set design standards and document a practical roadmap that supports report redevelopment, reliable data access, and long-term institutional use.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data warehousing, and modern data lake patterns
• Knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata, privacy, and access control principles
• Ability to evaluate integration and data consumption approaches for reliability, scalability, and maintainability
• Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and communication skills
• Ability to work across technical teams, reporting teams, vendors, and campus stakeholders
• Ability to balance immediate transition needs with sustainable future-client design

Duties/Responsibilities
Architecture and Strategy (40%)
Develop the Workday reporting and data warehouse architecture strategy, including data flows, integration patterns, and data consumption approaches.
Define the target-client data warehouse design and the role of data lake services in supporting reporting and analytics.
Create architecture documentation, design standards, and a phased technical roadmap for implementation.

Data Governance and Legacy Data Planning (30%)
• Recommend data governance standards covering ownership, definitions, quality, metadata, access, and appropriate use.
• Develop an approach for retaining and accessing legacy data needed for historical, operational, and analytical reporting.
• Assess architectural options and document assumptions, dependencies, risks, and decisions for project leadership.

Technical Design and Implementation Guidance (20%)
• Guide integration and warehouse design decisions and review technical solutions for alignment with the approved architecture.
• Partner with the Feed Engineer and report development team to ensure data structures and feeds support prioritized reporting needs.
• Advise on data quality validation, testing, deployment, and production support approaches.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Knowledge Transfer (10%)
• Facilitate architecture discussions with business and technical stakeholders and communicate design recommendations clearly.
• Maintain architecture records and transfer knowledge to staff responsible for ongoing operations.

Physical Demands
• Work is primarily performed in an office setting, involving extended periods of sitting and computer use. The position may require occasional in-person meetings with project and campus stakeholders.

Impact and Influence
• The position will influence technical decisions across reporting, data integration, and analytics workstreams. It will work closely with project leadership, IT staff, business data owners, vendors, and report developers to establish a coherent architecture and guide implementation choices.

About the Project
• The Unified Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Program intends to replace client’s legacy systems for human capital management and financials, improve the experience for students, faculty, and staff, streamline core business processes, and unify technology in a single SaaS solution.

Required Skills:
• Experience designing enterprise data warehouse, data lake, or analytics architectures	Required	5	Years
• Experience with cloud data platforms, data integration patterns, and enterprise reporting environments	Required	5	Year
• Experience establishing data governance, metadata, security, and data access practices	Required	5	Years

• Experience with Workday data and reporting, higher education, or large public-sector environments	Required	5	Years
• Ability to translate business reporting needs into scalable technical architecture and roadmaps	Required	5	Years

title: Security Analyst/Technical Support Analyst 3
skills: Three plus years of IT experience.
description:
The Client enterprise level EHR Security Analyst will be responsible for supporting the security, access, and user provisioning requirements of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) environment along with providing support tier 1 to the EHR end users on related areas.

This position provides technical and functional support for EHR security configuration, user access, security roles, authentication, auditing, and access-related troubleshooting. The Security Analyst works with clinical, operational, information technology, privacy, compliance, and application support teams to ensure users have appropriate access to EHR applications based on their job responsibilities and organizational policies.

The EHR Security Support Analyst provides technical and functional security support for the Cerner Electronic Health Record environment. This role is responsible for maintaining appropriate user access, supporting security configuration, monitoring access-related activities, troubleshooting security issues, and assisting with the implementation and sustainment of EHR security controls.

The EHR  security Support Analyst is responsible for managing and help define user access policies, security policies and role-based permissions within the EHR. This role will work closely with the EHR Application team, ISO Team and HIPAA compliance officer among others to ensure that the application is compliance with HIPAA standards, organizational security policies and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

• Map and maintaining EHR positions definitions, which includes, Millenium Positions, Preferences and OHPAC Security groups with VDH Positions.
• Reviews and processes EHR access requests in accordance with established policies, procedures, organizational standards, and role-based access requirements.
• Creates, modifies, and terminates user access based on approved requests and established processes.
• Monitor and enforce appropriate use of EHR Access Control Positions and Policies, ensuring that users have the correct level of access based on their roles and their job functions.
• Work with EHR Security Officer, IT Technical team, Support Team and EHR Core team to help define and automate user provisioning and offboarding procedures.
• Monitor and conduct internal security audits of the EHR application to identify and mitigate risks and/or vulnerabilities detected.
• Work with EHR Security Officer to develop and maintain security policies, procedure and guidelines related to the Application.
• Work with EHR Security Officer and ISO Office and EHR Core team to define and complete security documentation and downtime procedures according with VDH Security guidelines.
• Work with EHR Security Officer to respond and investigate security incidents related to EHR Application ensuring timely resolution and proper reporting to stakeholders.
• Collaborate with the EHR implementation and optimization teams to ensure that security measures are integrated into the deployment of new features, updates, and third-party applications.
• Stay informed about emerging security threats, technologies, and best practices related to EHR systems.
• Recommend improvements and optimizations to the EHR security environment based on industry trends and emerging threats.
• Monitor user behavior by using tools like P2Sentinel to determine trends and possible incidents.
• Work with EHR Security Officer and EHR Core team to assist on internal and external audits.
• Participate in Cerner/OHPAC upgrades, security patches and system maintenance to ensure ongoing security.
• Participate in the Domain Strategy for EHR Application.
• Stay up to date with security updates, best practices and regulatory changes.

Required Experience

• Three plus years of IT experience.
• Three plus years of healthcare IT experience
• Strong understanding knowing of Millenium and OHPAC security positions required
• Strong Understanding of EHR Systems
• Understanding of HIPAA, HITECH, meaningful user and other healthcare security regulations.
• Experience with Active Directory (AD), single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication(MFA), and identity management solutions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills related to Cerner/OHPAC security and access issues.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with IT teams, compliance officers, and end users.
• Familiarity with healthcare IT infrastructure, including networking, firewalls, and database security.
• Knowledge of Discern and ccl.

title: Project Manager
description:
Sr. Project Manager provides operational coordination, leadership, and technical understanding for project management functions of the Client; ensures the project schedule and budget set by the Board and  Executive Director are implemented; and aligns stakeholder and user requirements with the direction of the Program Manager and Executive Director. The role collaborates with all criminal justice agency stakeholders to analyze, document, and disseminate requirements, and requires experience in both project management and software application development.

Specific Services Required

• Oversee coordination and delivery of all project management activities and deliverables
• Assist the delivery team with System Development Methodology (SDM) compliance
• Create, execute, and revise project work plans; identify resources and assign responsibilities
• Ensure deliverables are complete and accurate before release to the user community
• Oversee system and user test plans and coordinate user acceptance testing
• Keep project documents complete, current, and stored appropriately; enforce project standards
• Develop risk mitigation strategies; report on project health, budget, schedule, and team performance
• Maintain the project notebook/website and present project status to the Executive Director or Program Manager
• Provide input to the biennial budget and the quadrennial  Strategic Business and Technology Plan
• Develop and maintain a Project Communication Plan; motivate the team and remove obstacles
• Design technical workflows from business requirements; resolve design ambiguities; coordinate design reviews
• Work with  stakeholders and vendors to document technical requirements; document Information Exchange XML schemas
• Document SOPs for the Client, Racial Profiling, dashboards, and operational documents; establish relationships between organizations
• Perform other duties as assigned by the Executive Director or Program Manager
Additional Services Required

• Training: project manager for agency role training under Security Policies
• Onboarding: commence onboarding for the Metropolitan Transportation Authority and Department of Energy and Environmental Protection
• PMO Support: project charters, use-case templates, implementation plans, RACI, onboarding/approval workflows, SOPs, audit/reconciliation procedures, resource estimates, risk/issue escalations, and cross-agency decision records
• Clean Slate: additional Senior PM for the Clean Slate initiative, including readiness for individual police departments
• Division of Public Defender Services: Senior PM for the Public Defender Workflow Integration initiative (2026 project initiation)
• Router Management: PM support for router and network-equipment activities supporting onboarding connectivity
• Grant writing for project funding
Technical Knowledge

• All facets of System Development Methodology (SDM)
• Design specifications, replication scripts, and source system data element documentation using UML, ERD, and UI reverse-engineering documents
• Database designs and layouts; strong understanding of coding practices and methodologies
• Comprehensive knowledge of Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) fundamentals and frameworks
Required Skills/Experience

• At least 3 years managing multi-million dollar, multi-year projects
• Bachelor of Science in Computer Technology or Business Administration
• Good public speaking skills
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Project
• At least 1 year preparing budgets with management, creating financial reports, and procurements
• Solid business and technical analysis skills; ability to foster cooperation among partners
Desirable Skills

• PMP certification
• Problem solving and analytical skills, especially for technical issues
• Excellent understanding of business requirements and IT strategies
• Strong verbal and written communication with all levels of the business
• Strong leadership; experience managing large, complex multi-year projects
• Schedule and budget management within Governing Board guidelines and policies
• Strong knowledge of IBM Rational Jazz
• Public sector experience, including Criminal Justice and Law Enforcement
• At least 1 year of experience with Monday.com
