title: Sr level Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
• The Client is looking for an Expert Cybersecurity Engineer (12+ yrs) who can develop cyber defense solutions, perform network security analysis and preliminary incident response, and support IAM, vulnerability, patch, and monitoring operations and strategic initiatives.

• The Cybersecurity Engineer will work as a senior member of  Information Security Operations team, splitting time between day-to-day security operations and longer-term security improvement work.

• A typical day starts with reviewing security alerts and events from overnight in the SIEM and endpoint security tools. The engineer triages anything that needs attention, investigates suspicious activity, and conducts preliminary incident response when needed, including gathering evidence, recommending containment, and escalating according to established procedures. They review threat intelligence and security advisories to find new threats relevant to the agency’s environment.

• Through the rest of the day, the engineer works on reducing the team’s operational backlog. This includes analyzing vulnerability scan results, prioritizing findings by risk and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, and verifying that fixes are complete. They support patch and configuration management by reviewing compliance, helping resolve failed deployments, and working through exceptions for systems that can’t be patched right away. On the identity side, they review access and privileged account activity and support access governance tasks.

• The engineer also contributes to strategic security initiatives. This includes designing and implementing security controls and improvements, tuning and building detection rules, improving log coverage, and helping mature security processes. They perform in-depth network and system security analysis to find weaknesses and recommend fixes.

• All work follows the agency’s change management process. The engineer writes and maintains technical documentation, including procedures, runbooks, and configuration standards, and works with IT infrastructure, endpoint, and application teams to put security changes in place. They work independently, manage several priorities at once, provide guidance to team members, and report progress to the Assistant Director of Information Security Operations.

Position Summary

• The Client is seeking an expert-level Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen the agency's cyber defense posture. The engineer will design, implement, and support security solutions across the enterprise, perform in-depth security analysis, and help the team carry out operational security work and strategic initiatives. The position calls for a highly skilled professional who can work independently in a complex, highly secure government environment and contribute across multiple security disciplines.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain advanced cyber defense solutions and security changes across the enterprise infrastructure, making sure systems are built to specification and deployed successfully.

• Safeguard the enterprise infrastructure against unauthorized intrusion and data exfiltration.

• Design, maintain, and operate security controls within highly complex, highly secure network and communications environments.

• Perform in-depth network and system security analysis to find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and threats to the organization's security posture.

• Monitor, review, and analyze security events and alerts, and conduct preliminary incident response, event analysis, and threat intelligence activities.

• Support vulnerability management activities, including assessment, risk prioritization, remediation coordination, and validation.

• Support patch and configuration management processes to keep enterprise endpoints and servers secure and compliant.

• Support identity and access management security controls, including access governance, privileged access, and authentication practices.

• Help improve security monitoring, detection capabilities, logging, and alerting.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, including procedures, runbooks, and security configurations, in line with change management and audit requirements.

• Work with cross-functional IT teams and stakeholders to put security improvements in place and reduce operational risk.

Required Qualifications

• 12+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or a closely related field

• Demonstrated experience designing and operating security controls in complex, high-security enterprise network environments

• Strong knowledge of network security, threat analysis, incident response, and vulnerability management principles

• Experience analyzing security events and producing actionable findings

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience producing clear technical documentation in a change-controlled environment

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment (Entra ID, Intune, Configuration Manager, Microsoft 365)

• Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning, SIEM, and endpoint security platforms

• Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, or CIS Controls

• Experience supporting state or local government agencies

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GSEC), CySA+, or Security+

title: Programmer Analyst 4
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced Software Programmer 4, Senior Java Developer, to support the continued development, maintenance, and modernization of the application. The Client is a public-facing application used by Virginia residents to apply for, renew, and report changes for public-benefit programs.
• This position requires a highly skilled senior developer who can work independently, analyze complex business and technical requirements, and develop secure, scalable, and maintainable Java-based solutions. The selected candidate will participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit testing, defect resolution, implementation, and post-release support.
• The Senior Java Developer will collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, database administrators, quality assurance analysts, security professionals, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other developers. The position will also assist with troubleshooting complex production issues, evaluating technical risks, estimating development effort, and recommending solutions that align with agency standards and existing architecture.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain complex enterprise Java applications.
• Review business requirements, functional designs, and screen mockups to identify technical impacts, dependencies, gaps, and risks.
• Translate approved business requirements into detailed technical designs and reliable software solutions.
• Develop and maintain web applications, application programming interfaces, batch processes, and system integrations.
• Integrate with internal and external systems using secure and supportable integration methods.
• Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code that complies with established development and security standards.
• Create and execute unit tests and support system, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, and user-acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve complex application defects, data issues, integration failures, and production incidents.
• Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance to other development team members.
• Participate in release planning, effort estimation, design reviews, defect triage, and implementation activities.
• Identify technical risks early and communicate their potential effect on scope, schedule, quality, and system stability.
• Support multiple development efforts while meeting established project milestones and release deadlines.
• Maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, data mappings, interface documentation, deployment instructions, and support procedures.
• Follow agency standards for source control, change management, secure development, testing, and production implementation.
• Provide knowledge transfer to state employees and other members of the development and support teams.
• Perform other technical duties necessary to support the client and related agency initiatives.

Required Qualifications

• Extensive professional experience designing and developing enterprise-level Java applications.
• Advanced experience with Java and object-oriented programming concepts.
• Experience developing Java-based web applications and service-oriented integrations.
• Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, design patterns, and software engineering principles.
• Experience working with relational databases, SQL, stored procedures, and data-access technologies.
• Experience developing and consuming RESTful or SOAP web services and APIs.
• Experience with source-control systems, automated build processes, continuous integration, and deployment practices.
• Experience performing unit testing, debugging, defect resolution, and production support.
• Knowledge of secure coding practices, application security, authentication, authorization, and protection of sensitive information.
• Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into technical designs and development tasks.
• Ability to estimate work, manage competing priorities, and deliver assignments within established deadlines.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting large-scale public-facing or high-availability web applications.
• Experience working with eligibility, enrollment, health and human services, or other government systems.
• Experience with applications that exchange information with multiple downstream systems.
• Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or hybrid software development environments.
• Experience with automated testing, application monitoring, logging, and performance analysis.
• Experience reviewing technical designs and mentoring or providing technical direction to other developers.
• Familiarity with accessibility requirements for public-facing government applications.
• Experience working within formal release-management and change-control processes.
• Experience supporting applications containing confidential, personally identifiable, or protected information.

  • This position requires a highly skilled senior developer who can work independently, analyze complex business and technical requirements, and develop secure, scalable, and maintainable Java-based solutions. The selected candidate will participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit testing, defect resolution, implementation, and post-release support.
  • The Senior Java Developer will collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, database administrators, quality assurance analysts, security professionals, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other developers. The position will also assist with troubleshooting complex production issues, evaluating technical risks, estimating development effort, and recommending solutions that align with agency standards and existing architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain complex enterprise Java applications.
  • Review business requirements, functional designs, and screen mockups to identify technical impacts, dependencies, gaps, and risks.
  • Translate approved business requirements into detailed technical designs and reliable software solutions.
  • Develop and maintain web applications, application programming interfaces, batch processes, and system integrations.
  • Integrate with internal and external systems using secure and supportable integration methods.
  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code that complies with established development and security standards.
  • Create and execute unit tests and support system, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, and user-acceptance testing.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex application defects, data issues, integration failures, and production incidents.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance to other development team members.
  • Participate in release planning, effort estimation, design reviews, defect triage, and implementation activities.
  • Identify technical risks early and communicate their potential effect on scope, schedule, quality, and system stability.
  • Support multiple development efforts while meeting established project milestones and release deadlines.
  • Maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, data mappings, interface documentation, deployment instructions, and support procedures.
  • Follow agency standards for source control, change management, secure development, testing, and production implementation.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to state employees and other members of the development and support teams.
  • Perform other technical duties necessary to support the client and related agency initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive professional experience designing and developing enterprise-level Java applications.
  • Advanced experience with Java and object-oriented programming concepts.
  • Experience developing Java-based web applications and service-oriented integrations.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, design patterns, and software engineering principles.
  • Experience working with relational databases, SQL, stored procedures, and data-access technologies.
  • Experience developing and consuming RESTful or SOAP web services and APIs.
  • Experience with source-control systems, automated build processes, continuous integration, and deployment practices.
  • Experience performing unit testing, debugging, defect resolution, and production support.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices, application security, authentication, authorization, and protection of sensitive information.
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into technical designs and development tasks.
  • Ability to estimate work, manage competing priorities, and deliver assignments within established deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale public-facing or high-availability web applications.
  • Experience working with eligibility, enrollment, health and human services, or other government systems.
  • Experience with applications that exchange information with multiple downstream systems.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or hybrid software development environments.
  • Experience with automated testing, application monitoring, logging, and performance analysis.
  • Experience reviewing technical designs and mentoring or providing technical direction to other developers.
  • Familiarity with accessibility requirements for public-facing government applications.
  • Experience working within formal release-management and change-control processes.
  • Experience supporting applications containing confidential, personally identifiable, or protected information.

title: System Analyst 3
description:
• Senior Systems Analyst with 20 years of experience who will serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business, operational, regulatory, data, and integration requirements into system requirements.

• Lead business and systems analysis for complex enterprise applications and modernization initiatives.
• Conduct stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and process analysis.
• Develop and manage Business Requirements, Functional Requirements, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, and Business Rules.
• Analyze current-state and design future-state business processes and workflows.
• Develop BPMN, process flows, use cases, data flows, and system models.
• Translate business and regulatory requirements into functional and non-functional system requirements.
• Analyze application functionality, system impacts, dependencies, and integration requirements.
• Define data requirements, data mappings, business definitions, and data quality requirements.
• Develop and review interface/API requirements and system integration specifications.
• Support data migration, conversion, and legacy-system modernization activities.
• Develop test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria and support SIT/UAT.
• Maintain requirements traceability from business objectives through implementation and testing.
• Collaborate with Business Architects, Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Data Architects, Developers, QA teams, Product Owners, and Project Managers.
• Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Facilitate resolution of complex business and technical issues.
• Support governance, design reviews, implementation planning, and production readiness activities.
Required Qualifications

•  15–20 years of experience in Systems Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, Application Development, IT Consulting, or related technology roles.
•  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or related field.
•  Strong experience with requirements engineering and enterprise application implementation.
•  Demonstrated experience working with both business and technical stakeholders.
•  Strong experience with SDLC, Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.
•  Experience with application modernization, system integration, or legacy-system replacement.
•  Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.
Technical Skills

• Strong experience with several of the following:
•  Business and Systems Analysis
•  Requirements Engineering
•  BPMN / UML
•  SQL and relational databases
•  Data modeling and data mapping
•  Data migration and conversion
•  REST APIs and system integration
•  JSON/XML
•  Enterprise applications
•  Application architecture concepts
•  System Integration Testing (SIT)
•  User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
•  Agile/Scrum
•  Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
•  Microsoft Visio, Lucid chart, Draw.io, or similar modeling tools
Preferred Qualifications

•  Experience with state government or public-sector systems.
•  Healthcare IT or Medicaid experience.
•  Behavioral health or human services technology experience.
•  Experience with regulatory or compliance systems.
•  Experience with enterprise data governance.
•  Experience with cloud-based applications and APIs.
•  CBAP, PMI-PBA, PMP, or similar certification.
•  Experience with large-scale system modernization programs.
Key Deliverables

• The successful candidate should be able to independently produce and manage:
•  Business Requirements Documents
•  Functional Requirements Specifications
•  User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
•  Use Cases
•  Business Rules
•  BPMN Process Models
• Data Requirements and Data Dictionaries
•  Interface Specifications
•  Data Mapping Specifications
•  Requirements Traceability Matrix
•  Gap and Impact Assessments
•  Test Scenarios and Test Cases
•  UAT Requirements
•  System and Process Documentation
Ideal Candidate

• The ideal candidate is a senior-level systems thinker who can move comfortably between business operations and technology. This person should be able to understand complex organizational processes, challenge legacy requirements, identify opportunities for modernization, and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
• Experience working on large, complex, regulated enterprise systems is highly valued.
• Keywords: Senior Systems Analyst, Lead Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Requirements Analyst, Systems Analysis, Business Analysis, Enterprise Applications, Application Modernization, Healthcare IT, Behavioral Health, Medicaid, DBHDS, Incident Management, BPMN, Requirements Engineering, Data Analysis, System Integration, API, SQL, Agile, UAT, SIT.

title: IT Asset Management - Technical Support Analyst 4
description:
• The Client is seeking a local candidate for an on-site technical support position. 
• The ideal candidate will have experience supporting Windows desktop users in an enterprise environment.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Issues new workstations to incoming employees, coordinates issuance during employee orientations, internal refreshes, etc.
• Issue and troubleshoot peripheral devices provided alongside workstations (Monitors, docking stations, input/output devices, etc.)
• Manages and monitors customer IT issues using helpdesk tools – ServiceNow, Ivanti, and SharePoint. Support over the phone, in person, and using remote control
• Works directly with customers to assist in managing and fixing software and application issues on desktops, laptops, tablets, and printers
• Troubleshoot software and hardware problems and enhances the level of direct services to field staff
• Install, maintain, and assist in testing and upgrading of new and existing hardware and software
• Provides advanced problem management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis and escalations to resolve customer problems
• Creates job aids for internal staff to enhance the use of infrastructure such as SharePoint, OneDrive, and Office products

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• Strong customer service skills with a Customer First attitude
• Extensive skills and experience in desktop products including but not limited to Windows 11, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and MS O365
• Ability to utilize troubleshooting tools and skills in managing and administering desktops, laptops, and tablets
• Excellent research and investigative skills
• Knowledge and experience in Active Directory, cmd line tools, remote support tools, basic networking
• Experience in working with help request tracking and reporting tools
• Knowledge of IT concepts and trends and new technologies
• Ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and communicate solutions to customers both in the Central Office and in the field
• Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with individuals and groups
• Basic understanding and knowledge of software packaging and deployment (preferably using Ivanti End Point Manager, previously LANDESK Management Suite)
• Customer service professional with a great attitude	Required	3	Years

• Hands on experience in a variety of ticketing/tracking/CMDB tools related to IT support	Required	3	Years

• Ability to accurately maintain asset inventory records and follow best practices for asset management	Desired	3	Years

• Experience assisting end users with a variety of technical issues including peripherals, mobile devices, printers, single sign on, VPN, etc.	Required	3	Years

title: Jr. AI Engineer
description:
Role Responsibilities:

Development & Enforcement

•  Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered applications, services, and intelligent automation solutions under the guidance of senior engineers.
•  Contribute to the development of reusable APIs, frameworks, libraries, and tooling that support AI adoption across engineering teams.
•  Implement security controls and automated checks within development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-enabled engineering environments.
•  Participate in secure code reviews and support remediation efforts for applications developed in Python, JavaScript, Go, Java, and related technologies.
•  Follow secure coding standards, responsible AI guidelines, and software development best practices.
•  Support DevSecOps initiatives by helping integrate security controls throughout the software development lifecycle.

Collaboration & Expertise

•  Collaborate with engineering, architecture, product, security, and operations teams to develop secure AI-enabled solutions.
•  Assist in designing and implementing AI applications and cloud-native services.
•  Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, sprint planning sessions, and technical workshops.
•  Work with software engineers to incorporate security and responsible AI practices into development workflows.
•  Support enterprise AI adoption efforts by contributing technical insights and implementation support.

Analysis & Configuration

• Assist with application security assessments, vulnerability analysis, and remediation planning.
• Evaluate AI-powered applications and workflows for risks such as prompt injection, unauthorized access, data exposure, and misuse.
• Participate in threat modeling activities for applications, APIs, and cloud-native environments.
• Help configure security controls across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises platforms.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, standards, and operational procedures.

Operational Support

•  Support production AI systems, applications, and development platforms to maintain reliability and security.
•  Troubleshoot application issues, security findings, and operational incidents.
•  Assist with responding to application security events, AI misuse concerns, and data protection issues.
•  Monitor application performance, operational health, and security metrics.
•  Contribute to platform maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
•  Participate in scheduled deployment activities, production support rotations, after-hours maintenance windows, and on-call support as required.

Mentorship & Training

•  Actively learn from senior engineers and security professionals while sharing knowledge with peers.
•  Participate in peer reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
•  Support onboarding activities and documentation efforts for new team members.
•  Contribute to team training initiatives focused on AI technologies, secure software engineering, and emerging tools.
•  Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Innovation and Research

•  Research emerging AI, cybersecurity, and software engineering technologies and best practices.
•  Prototype new AI capabilities, automation solutions, and developer productivity tools.
•  Assist in evaluating agentic AI systems and intelligent automation opportunities.
•  Explore secure implementation patterns for LLM-powered applications and RAG-based architectures.
•  Learn about AI-specific risks and contribute to the development of mitigation approaches and engineering controls.
•  Continuously evaluate new technologies, platforms, frameworks, and development tools to support innovation and business objectives.

Strategic Planning

•  Support AI engineering and application security initiatives by contributing technical insights and recommendations.
•  Assist with the development and adoption of AI governance practices, security standards, and engineering policies.
•  Contribute to AI platform modernization and security automation projects.
•  Identify opportunities to enhance developer productivity through automation and AI-assisted tooling.
•  Recommend scalable and maintainable technical solutions aligned with team and business objectives.

Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

•  3–5 years of professional software engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting enterprise or cloud-based applications.
•  1–2 years of hands-on AI experience, including LLMs, generative AI applications, RAG architectures, AI agents, or intelligent automation solutions.
•  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
•  Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, Go, Java, or similar modern languages.
•  Familiarity with APIs, cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based development workflows.
•  Basic understanding of secure coding principles, application security concepts, and common software vulnerabilities.
•  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
•  Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.

title: Purchasing Administrator
description:
• The Client provides cost-effective, secure, consistent, reliable enterprise-technology services to our partner agencies so that they can better serve our mutual customer,the Hoosier taxpayer.
Role Overview:
• The Purchasing Administrator is a subject-matter expert in the procurement of various commodities and services in a cost-effective manner and on a timely basis. You will handle sensitive issues when dealing with agency personnel and vendors, supporting the decisions of upper management. You will coordinate and execute State procurement functions in accordance with Indiana Code.
• To be a certified buyer for the State, you must take the Indiana Delegation of Purchasing Authority Program (DPAP) classes and pass the DPAP test within four weeks of the date of hire. 
A Day in the Life:
• The essential functions of this role are as follows:
• Provide administrative oversight of both automation-related and traditional contract services.
• Purchase on behalf of the agency within a pre-determined delegation authority and consistent with agency purchasing and procurement laws, rules, regulations, and procedures.
• Maintain a substantial file system covering all services or items contracted for by the Agency.
• Perform vendor bid/quote evaluations to determine most responsible and responsive vendor for purchase process.
• Analyze vendor performance issues regarding contract administration Apply State-described vendor percentage preferences to purchases.
• Negotiate, execute, and administer contracts, QPA Agreements and amendments
• Communicate with staff and outside vendors as necessary to solve problems, address complaints, and facilitate the timely processing of purchases.
• Document fully and accurately all purchase processes for auditing purposes. Ensure that all procurement-related documents are completed fully and accurately.
• Act as a resource to provide guidance and assistance for agency procurement agents concerning procedures, policies, and regulations governing all purchasing and contract activities.
• Troubleshoot agency functional issues in PeopleSoft eProcurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, and Supplier Contract Management.
• Establish and maintain assessment criteria according to current procurement rules and statutes.
• The job profile is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.
What You'll Need for Success:
• You must meet the following requirements to be considered for employment:
• Bachelor of Science degree in Accounting, Finance, Purchasing or Business Management or 5 to 8 years of full-time professional experience.
• Broad knowledge in contracting, requisitions and purchasing/procurement, accounting, business administration, fiscal management, or related experience.
• Effective communication skills.
• Broad knowledge and advanced proficiency with E-Procurement management system and ability to use the Microsoft Suite software.
• Expertise with general project management including financial management, and conflict management. Ability to negotiate contracts and bids.
• Inter-personal relationship skills are a must, and strong communicators with positive attitudes will be most successful in the established work environment.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality.
• Eligible to be bonded and able to accurately handle financial documents.
• Professional experience in purchasing administration, procurement operations, or a closely related function.	Required	5	Years
• Demonstrated experience in procurement, contract administration, requisition processing, financial mgmt, accounting, or related business operations	Required	5	Years
• Knowledge of applicable state and federal procurement laws, regulations, policies, and procedures, including compliance requirements and documentation	Required	5	Years
• Demonstrated experience managing procurement contracts, overseeing vendor performance, evaluating bids, and supporting contract negotiations	Required	5	Years
• Experience with general project management including financial and conflict management	Required	3	Years
• Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to establish effective working relationships	Required		
• Proficiency in Microsoft applications, including Excel, Word, Outlooks, and PowerPoint, to support procurement activities	Required		
• Advanced proficiency with electronic procurement (eProcurement) systems	Highly desired		
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Purchasing or Business Management	Highly desired		
• Experience supporting procurement operations within a government or public-sector environment, preferably within Indiana state government	Desired		
• Professional procurement certification (e.g., CPPB, CPPO, CPSM, or prior DPAP)	Desired		
• Experience procuring IT goods and services including software, hardware, and telecom	Desired		
• Experience coordinating with agency personnel and vendors to facilitate procurement activities	Desired

title: Full-Stack .NET w/OpenText
description:
•   The Client is seeking a Senior .NET Developer who will assist in end-to-end system enhancement and new development.   The specialized full-stack developer will work on multiple projects. This role focuses on development using C#, Bootstrap, CSS3, HTML5, TypeScript, JavaScript, Knockout, ASP.NET Webforms, .NET Core, MVC, and Entity Framework, as well as SQL Server, including creating stored procedures, functions, tables, and maintaining SSIS packages and SSRS reports.

•   This position will assist in enhancements of new and existing systems and entire end-to-end system development using .NET technologies.  These systems support our business lines such as Child Welfare, SNAP, TANF Medicaid, and Child Care Assistance.  As a full stack developer, skills are needed in both front-end and back-end development.  C#, Angular, Bootstrap, CSS3, HTML5, TypeScript, JavaScript, Knockout, ASP.NET Webforms, .NET Core, Entity Framework and SQL 2016+

Duties include

•   Gather business requirements, analyze, and create functional and technical specifications

•   Analyze and design SQL databases and database objects

•   Perform end-to-end development and testing and support business users with user testing

•   Resolve system issues and problem reports reported by end users though the Help Desk. 

 Projects for onboarding include:

Provider Directory – Residential Settings Assessment; Provider Self-Assessment; HOME; Google SIP; and MEPD ClickPay Specialized Duties

Successful candidates will possess:

• The ability to analyze new development, or current applications and assist with coding tasks; able to react quickly to changing requirements in an agile environment

•  Self-starter work ethic, adept at providing exceptional results with limited supervision

•  Excellent troubleshooting skills to identify and fix issues reported in existing systems

Required Skills:  

•  Experience in developing ASP.NET

•  Experience with ASP.NET Webforms

•  Experience with RESTFUL development for web services and APIs

•  Experience using C#, VB.NET or ASP.NET Core

•  Proficiency with using Visual Studio 2019 and previous versions

•  Experience in working with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, Knockout, and Angular

•  Experience using LINQ and Entity Framework

•  Team Foundation Server/Azure Dev Ops (or other version control tools)

•   SQL Server 2016+

•   Experience in creating batch packages using SSIS

•   Experience in creating reports using SSRS

•   Database modeling & Design

Desired Skills:

•  Experience in using Power BI 

•  Experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud services

•  Experience designing CI/CD pipelines into Azure App Services

Preference will be given to candidates who can demonstrate knowledgeable experience in any or all the following products:

•   OpenText Content Server

•   Adobe Experience Manager – specifically using Designer, Workbench, and Workflow

title: Business Analyst
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking experienced Business Analysts with strong skills in translating business requirements into data, reporting, automation, and cloud-based modernization solutions. The ideal candidates will have experience gathering and validating business requirements, analyzing existing application workflows, documenting business rules, supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and collaborating with business users and technical teams to deliver effective system modernization solutions.

These analysts will play a critical role in the migration of the legacy Offender Management System to a new cloud-based platform. Responsibilities will include reviewing existing business rules, policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), reports, user stories, requirements verification documents, and Oracle SQL/PL/SQL code to ensure that existing functionality and business logic are accurately represented in the new system.

The role requires a thorough understanding of legacy application functionality, the ability to translate complex business processes into clear functional requirements, and close collaboration with internal stakeholders and a third-party vendor. They will support the redesign of core application functionality, including modules such as records, classification and sentence computation, to ensure accurate operation within the updated system.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and document existing application architecture, data models, workflows, and stored procedures.

• Analyze legacy application functionality and identify the underlying business rules and dependencies

• Review Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and views to understand existing application logic and support migration to the cloud environment.

• Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and potential improvements in existing business processes and application functionality.

• Review existing Crystal Reports and document report logic, calculations, data sources, and business rules to support migration to a modern reporting platform compatible with AWS.

• Analyze and document core logic modules such as sentence computation, offender records, offender programs, alerts, movement, classification, offender disciplinary, offender grievances, Community Corrections accounting and supervision.

• Work with technical teams to validate source-to-target data mappings and ensure data accuracy and completeness

• Translate existing system functionality into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.

• Ensure that critical business rules and functionality from the legacy system are accurately represented in the redesigned application

• Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Validate migrated functionality against the legacy system and assist in identifying and documenting defects.

• Participate in requirements walkthroughs, design reviews, and modernization discussions.

Required Technical Skills

• Experience in performing detailed analysis and preparing documentation that translates and supports business rules from the legacy system to the new cloud-based system.

• Experience reviewing technical documentation, business rules, workflows, reports, and SQL code.

• Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to read and understand queries, joins, data relationships, and stored procedure logic.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, Pivot Charts, data analysis, and data validation

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AWS database and reporting services.

• Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Microsoft Power BI or AWS QuickSight.

• Knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL (procedures, functions, triggers, packages, views).

• Experience with Offender Management or enterprise justice systems.

• Familiarity with legacy web technologies, including DHTML-based applications.

• Experience working with external vendor teams on modernization projects

title: Software Tester/QA Analyst 3
description:
The Client is seeking a detail-oriented Software Tester to join QA team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining test cases to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. The candidate will identify, document, and track defects, collaborate closely with developers and stakeholders to resolve issues, and contribute to improving testing processes and standards. Experience with manual and/or automated testing, strong analytical skills, and the ability to communicate findings clearly are essential for success in this position.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and execute test cases based on functional and technical requirements
• Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution
• Collaborate with developers, QA leads, and stakeholders to ensure quality standards are met
• Maintain and update test documentation and coverage reports
• Support regression testing efforts and contribute to automation initiatives
Qualifications:

• Experience in manual and/or automated software testing
• Familiarity with test case management tools (e.g., Xray, Jira)
• Strong attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills
• Effective written and verbal communication skills

title: Portfolio Data Analyst
description:
• The Client need a (Portfolio) Data Analyst with experience with multiple data sources and creating visualizations of that data analysis
• The Portfolio Data Analyst is a role within the PMCOE, created to elevate the IT portfolio intelligence from compliance reporting to strategic decision support. This position sits at the intersection of business analysis, data analytics, and enterprise portfolio management, translating investment data, agency strategic plans, and Planview portfolio records into actionable insights for leadership and agency executives.
• This role operates as part of the Customer Experience FUSE function: it receives information already gathered and consolidated through Demand function, primarily agency Strategic Partner engagement and ITSP intake, and synthesizes that information, together with Planview, governance, and financial data, into portfolio-level knowledge. The Portfolio Business Analyst does not independently conduct agency-level demand sensing; that work belongs to the Demand function under the Director of Customer Relationships. The value this role adds is downstream: pattern recognition, cross-agency synthesis, and decision-ready analysis built on top of information the Demand function has already collected.
• The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and requirements-gathering skills, hands-on Power BI experience, and a curiosity about how data can drive better public-sector investment decisions. Experience applying AI-assisted analysis tools to accelerate insight generation is a strong differentiator for this role. This isa high-visibility position with direct impact on how Virginia's $1B+ annual IT investment portfolio is understood, governed, and optimized.
Business Requirements and Acceptance Criteria

• Engage stakeholders across and agencies to elicit, document, and validate business requirements for PMCOE analytical initiatives, Planview enhancements, and reporting solutions.
• Facilitate requirements workshops and working sessions, synthesizing input from diverse stakeholders, including agency IT directors, portfolio managers, budget analysts, and executive sponsors, into actionable specifications.
• Maintain a requirements traceability matrix to ensure that analytical deliverables remain aligned to PMCOE strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations.
Portfolio Synthesis and Trend Intelligence

• Synthesize information produced by the Demand function, Planview records, and legislative budget data to identify patterns, trends, redundancies, and optimization opportunities across 67 agencies.
• Produce cross-agency demand analyses that surface common technology needs, shared service opportunities, software consolidation candidates, and reuse potential, drawing on Demand function information as the primary input rather than independent agency outreach.
• Monitor and analyze project performance data (schedule variance, cost variance, risk exposure, and milestone trends) to identify systemic issues, recurring risk patterns, and predictive indicators of project distress.
• Build a forward-looking view of technology demand, investment gaps, and emerging priorities by fusing Demand function information with financial and portfolio performance data.
• Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that make IT portfolio data accessible, interpretable, and actionable for audiences ranging from project managers to agency heads and executive leadership using data visualization
• Connect and integrate data from multiple data sources to create unified portfolio views.
• Automate recurring reports and data refreshes
• Iterate on dashboard design based on structured stakeholder feedback, usage patterns, and evolving PMCOE reporting priorities.
Planview Analytics Partnership

• Partner with the Planview Product Owner and platform administrators to support the transformation of Planview from a project tracking tool into a strategic, data-driven portfolio intelligence platform.
• Analyze Planview data quality, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and stale records across agency submissions, and recommend remediation approaches for platform administrators to evaluate.
• Recommend data model, taxonomy, and field-level standards that would enable consistent cross-agency comparison, filtering, and aggregation, for review and implementation by the Planview Product Owner.
• Build Planview-native reports and views that complement Power BI dashboards, ensuring portfolio data is accessible within the platform as well as through external reporting tools.
Financial and Portfolio Analysis

• Analyze agency IT budget submissions, biennium appropriations, and spending actuals to identify financial trends, funding gaps, unfunded mandates, and cost anomalies across portfolio.
• Cross-reference financial data with Planview investment records to validate cost disclosures, identify discrepancies, and produce reconciled portfolio financials for executive reporting.
• Identify cross-agency demand patterns, such as common modernization initiatives, shared infrastructure needs, or recurring security investments, which represent opportunities for led shared services or enterprise procurement.
Risk and Issue Intelligence

• Apply data analysis techniques to identify risk patterns, recurring issues, and systemic vulnerabilities across the IT portfolio, including expired contracts, unfunded mandates, stalled projects, and IV&V compliance gaps.
• Develop and maintain risk indicator dashboards that provide PMCOE leadership with early warning signals of portfolio-level distress.
• Contribute to PMCOE risk reporting frameworks by translating data-driven findings into structured risk narratives, prioritized action items, and governance recommendations.
AI-Assisted Analysis and Innovation

• Apply AI and machine learning tools, including large language model assistants, automated classification, and predictive analytics, to accelerate portfolio analysis, pattern recognition, and insight generation.
• Identify and pilot opportunities to integrate AI-assisted capabilities into PMCOE analytical workflows, including document review, ITSP assessment, anomaly detection, and narrative generation.
• Stay current on emerging AI tools and data analytics best practices relevant to public sector portfolio management, contributing recommendations to PMCOE capability development.
Required Qualifications

• 5 or more years of progressive experience in business analysis, data analysis, or a closely related role, with demonstrated experience supporting enterprise IT portfolio or program management.
• Demonstrated proficiency with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, report design, dashboard development, and meeting WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
• Knowledge of business analysis frameworks and best practices, including requirement solicitation, user story writing, acceptance criteria definition, and stakeholder facilitation.
• Knowledge of IT portfolio management concepts, including project lifecycle, investment categorization, financial management, and risk governance.
• Knowledge of data analysis methods and tools, including the ability to work with structured datasets, identify patterns and anomalies, and produce clear analytical narratives.
• Skill in translating complex data findings into clear, executive-ready insights, reports, and presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Skill in designing data visualizations that are accurate, accessible, and aligned to audience decision-making needs.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent analytical workstreams with competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced government environment.
• Ability to work independently and proactively, identifying opportunities for analytical value without waiting for direction.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document requirements and present data-driven findings clearly and concisely.

  • Skill in designing data visualizations that are accurate, accessible, and aligned to audience decision-making needs.

title: Sr. Azure Infrastructure Engineer
description:
• The Client is seeking a Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer to implement, configure, manage, and provide guidance on cloud infrastructure in Azure environment.
• The Client is seeking a highly-experienced Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer to lead the implementation, configuration, governance, and ongoing management of our enterprise Azure environment. This role is ideal for someone passionate about building and maintaining secure, resilient, and scalable cloud platforms - and who is ready to set the standard for cloud excellence across the organization.
• The Client is looking for a senior level engineer with deep expertise in Azure’s ecosystem, proven enterprise grade operational experience, and the ability to provide technical leadership across teams and to management.

What You’ll Bring:

• Extensive, hands on experience with Azure services, Terraform IaC, cloud infrastructure design, security best practices, governance, and operational management
• A strong sense of ownership – someone who embraces complex challenges and sees them through from design to delivery
• The ability to guide, mentor, and cross-train other engineers, fostering a strong engineering culture
• Confidence in communicating technical recommendations, risks, and strategies to management and executive leadership.

Core Responsibilities & Required Experience:

Cloud Architecture & Engineering

• Design and implement secure Azure environments, including air-gapped and highly restricted tenancies.
• Build and maintain hub-and-spoke network topologies with Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, private endpoints, DNS, and routing.
• Demonstrate strong working knowledge of networking, including OSI model concepts, core network protocols, and network level troubleshooting.
• Deliver infrastructure through Infrastructure-As-Code (e.g., Terraform & PowerShell) and CI/CD pipelines.
• Produce architecture designs, contribute to standards, and document decision records for review and approval.

Security, Identity & Zero Trust

• Apply Zero Trust and least-privileged access management, and conditional access controls.
• Define and enforce guardrails with Azure Policy, firewall rules, and NSGs.
• Utilize Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms (e.g., Tenable & Microsoft) to manage vulnerability remediation and improve security posture.
• Partner with Security Operations to implement security baselines and remediate audit and assessment findings.
• Support compliance with organizational and regulatory security requirements.

Logging, Monitoring & Observability

• Design and implement meaningful observability solutions while ensuring compliance with enterprise logging and monitoring standards
• Design, tailor, and tune Azure Monitor data collection rules and Log Analytics workspaces.
• Integrate log pipelines with enterprise SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk via Event Hub).
• Ensure alerting, diagnostics and incident response capabilities are achieved while balancing verbosity, retention, and cost.

Migration & Transformation

• Plan and lead re-architecture and workload migrations within and across Azure tenancies, including moving workloads from on premises to Azure.
• Design landing zones, map dependencies, and coordinate cutover, validation, and rollback.
• Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and resilience requirements are met to minimize downtime and protect critical data.

Operations, Governance & Collaboration

• Provide expert guidance on the design, implementation, configuration, and governance of Azure resources, networking, and security policies
• Create SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge transfer so solutions can be supported by the team.
• Implement, maintain, and monitor mission critical cloud resources in a large enterprise environment.
• Participate in a service operations team responsible change, incident, and problem management, service request fulfillment, support for escalated issues.
• Provide operational support and troubleshooting for production applications and infrastructure.
• Manage and optimize enterprise backup and disaster recovery operations, ensuring reliability and continuity.
• Contribute to cost optimization, capacity planning, and cloud governance.
• In-depth experience working with other areas of IT such as architecture, security, development, and governance.
• Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and coordinate with vendors and partner teams.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):

• Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or similar
• Networking certifications such as Network+, CCNA, or equivalent
Skills Required:

• Experience implementing, maintaining, monitoring, and providing guidance on Microsoft Azure infrastructure and resources.	Required	7	Years

• Experience with Terraform (highly preferred) or other IaC tools such as ARM or Bicep.	Required	5	Years

• Experience planning and leading re-architecture efforts and migrations from on-prem to Azure, as well as within and across Azure tenancies.	Required	7	Years

• Experience working in mission critical enterprise environments with strong backup, disaster recovery, and resilience practices.	Required	5	Years

• Experience contributing to cloud governance, cost optimization, and operational readiness through SOPs, runbooks, and design documentation.	Required	5	Years

• Experience integrating Azure logging with enterprise SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk via Event Hub).	Required	7	Years

• Experience designing and implementing secure Azure environments, including networking architectures, and enforcing security policies.	Required	7	Years

• Experience using Azure Monitor for alerting, observability, and dashboards.	Required	7	Years

• Experience with vulnerability remediation, cloud security posture management, and collaboration on security initiatives.	Required	7	Years

title: GIS Analyst 2
description:
• Seeking a detail-oriented professional to locate, verify, and document transportation structures while supporting the development and maintenance of geospatial data and tools to ensure accurate, accessible information for planning and asset management.

• The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately locating, verifying, and documenting bridges, culverts, and other transportation structures to support precise mapping and reliable infrastructure data. This position plays a key role in developing, maintaining, and enhancing geospatial datasets and mapping products, with a focus on linear referencing systems (LRS), ArcGIS Online solutions, and enterprise data integration. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure transportation-related spatial data is accurate, accessible, and compliant with organizational standards. This role is essential to supporting data-driven planning, operations, and asset management across the agency.

Key Responsibilities
Geospatial Data Management and Quality Assurance
•  Identify and locate structures within RNS using GIS tools, roadway datasets, and structure inventory records.

•  Verify structure attributes such as route, mile point, feature crossed, and structure number against official documentation.

•  Update and maintain structure location data in alignment with standards and revision protocols.

•  Investigate and resolve discrepancies between field data and system records.

•  Perform QA/QC on spatial datasets and participate in audits and quality assurance reviews of RNS structure data.

•  Maintain documentation for datasets, workflows, and data maintenance procedures.

Spatial Analysis and Technical GIS Operations
•  Develop, maintain, and analyze datasets using linear referencing systems for transportation networks.

•  Execute enterprise GIS workflows, including geoprocessing, spatial analysis, data modeling, and automation.

•  Troubleshoot spatial data issues and ensure data quality, consistency, and metadata compliance.

•  Integrate spatial and non-spatial datasets from multiple sources.

GIS Application Development and Platform Management
•  Create and manage feature services, web maps, dashboards, and applications within ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise.

•  Support the development and enhancement of GIS tools, automated processes, and geospatial applications.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Support
•  Collaborate with Systems & Data Management teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across RNS and related databases.

•  Support engineers and maintenance teams by providing accurate structure location data for inspections, planning, and operations.

•  Work with internal stakeholders to gather requirements, design GIS solutions, and deliver geospatial products.

Reporting, Communication, and Training
•  Prepare reports and documentation for newly located, updated, or modified structures.

•  Provide technical support, training, and guidance on geospatial tools, best practices, and data standards.

Skills Required:
• Proficiency with Esri tools including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Enterprise. 	Required

• Experience working with linear referencing systems, route networks, and event editing. 	Required

• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.	Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Environmental Science, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 	Required

• Experience in transportation data systems or workflows. 	Highly desired

• Familiarity with SQL, Python, or Model Builder for automation and advanced analysis. 	Highly desired

• Knowledge of roadway inventory, asset management systems, or event-based data models. 	Highly desired

• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff. 	Highly desired

• Experience with REST services, API-driven data workflows, or cloud-based GIS integrations. 	Highly desired

• Strong skills in data integration, ETL processes, and managing enterprise geospatial datasets. 	Desired

title: Senior IT Procurement Analyst
description:
• Work with business partners, and suppliers while gaining broad exposure to technology procurement, contracts, financial operations, and services.
• The Client is seeking an experienced Senior IT Procurement Analyst to support the Business Management Office. This position plays a key role in managing the procurement of technology goods and services and supporting the financial and operational activities.
• The ideal candidate will have experience with public-sector procurement and a strong understanding of the procurement lifecycle, contract purchasing, supplier management, purchase orders, invoice reconciliation, and procurement compliance. Experience with  procurement processes, including eVA, contracts, and contracts, is highly desirable.
• Reporting to the ITS Business Manager, the Senior IT Procurement Analyst will serve as a key procurement resource for Information Technology Services, partnering with ITS leadership, technical teams, vendors, Procurement, Finance, and other university stakeholders. The position is responsible for facilitating timely and accurate technology purchases while ensuring compliance with university policies,  procurement requirements, and applicable procurement procedures.
• This position offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, procurement, and financial operations while supporting technology initiatives across the University. The Senior IT Procurement Analyst will collaborate with technical leaders, business partners, suppliers, and university stakeholders and will have direct visibility into a broad portfolio of technology purchases, contracts, and services.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform and coordinate complex procurement activities for a broad range of information technology goods and services, including hardware, software, licensing and subscriptions, cloud/SaaS services, maintenance and support agreements, telecommunications and networking products, professional services, and technology renewals.
• Evaluate purchasing requirements and identify appropriate procurement methods and available contract vehicles, including contracts, when applicable.
• Process and maintain electronic procurement transactions, purchase orders, invoices, and supporting documentation using eVA and other university financial and procurement systems.
• Support the full procurement lifecycle, from initial business requirements and sourcing through purchase order issuance, receiving, and invoice processing.
• Review procurement documentation for completeness, accuracy, appropriate approvals, funding information, and compliance with applicable policies and procedures.
• Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to investigate and resolve purchase order, invoice, payment, pricing, receiving, and other procurement-related discrepancies.
• Monitor technology contracts, renewals, purchase orders, and other procurement milestones to help prevent service interruptions and ensure timely processing.
• Maintain accurate procurement and contract records, reports, tracking tools, and supporting documentation for audit and management purposes.
• Routinely maintain annual purchase order and procurement records within the ServiceNow Contracts module.
• Monitor, prioritize, track, and resolve ITS Business Management Office requests submitted through ServiceNow.
• Coordinate receiving and invoice processing activities for IT purchases, including verifying receipt of goods and services, reviewing invoices for accuracy, reconciling invoices against purchase orders and receiving documentation, resolving discrepancies with suppliers and internal stakeholders, and supporting timely payment processing.
• Assist with IT supply and equipment inventory activities as required.
• Develop and maintain procurement and tracking tools to support planning, forecasting, compliance, renewals, and management decision-making.
• Serve as a knowledgeable resource to ITS stakeholders regarding procurement processes, documentation requirements, purchasing options, and transaction status.
• Provide responsive, professional customer service to university departments, suppliers, and other internal and external stakeholders.
• Perform other procurement, fiscal, and business management duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience in procurement, purchasing, contract administration, financial operations, or a closely related field.
• Considerable knowledge of procurement principles, practices, and the purchasing lifecycle.
• Experience processing purchase orders, invoices, contracts, and related procurement or financial records.
• Experience using automated procurement, financial, contract management, or enterprise business systems.
• Demonstrated ability to independently coordinate and prioritize multiple procurement activities, deadlines, contract renewals, and stakeholder requests while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion.
• Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and records-management skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, suppliers, management, and administrative partners.
• Demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service, including the ability to respond to inquiries and resolve concerns in a professional, courteous, and timely manner.
• Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.	Required	10	Years
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.	Required	10	Years

• Procurement	Required	7	Years

• Commonwealth of Virginia Procurement	Highly desired	7	Years

• Purchase Order Management	Required	7	Years

• Invoice Processing	Required	7	Years

• Supplier Management	Required	5	Years

• Contract Renewals	Required	7	Years

• Procurement Records Management	Required	7	Years

• IT Procurement	Desired	5	Years

• Receiving	Required	7	Years

• ServiceNow	Desired	5	Years

• eVA	Required	7	Years

• Procurement Analysis	Required	7	Years

• Problem Solving	Required	7	Years

• Stakeholder Management	Required	7	Years

• Customer Service	Required	10	Years

• Organization and Prioritization	Required	10	Years

• ERP/Business Systems Proficiency	Required	10	Years

Preferred Qualifications

• Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in procurement, purchasing, contract administration, fiscal management, or a related field.
• Experience procuring information technology goods and services, including hardware, software, licensing, SaaS/cloud services, maintenance agreements, and professional services.
• Experience with public procurement.
• Knowledge of the Agency Procurement and Surplus Property Manual (APSPM), the Virginia Public Procurement Act (VPPA) and applicable policies and procedures.
• Experience with the eVA procurement system.
• Experience utilizing contracts and other contract vehicles.
• Experience with ServiceNow, particularly contract, request, or ticket management functionality.
• Experience with public-sector or higher-education procurement.
• Experience supporting supplier evaluations, contract administration, or technology renewals.

title: Sr. Contract Administrator
description:
• This temporary entry-level position provides administrative and compliance support to the Business Development Administrator in monitoring and maintaining procurement and contractual compliance activities for Small Business Utilization. The employee assists with contract documentation, data tracking, compliance reporting in the B2GNOW compliance system, and coordination of administrative tasks related to professional services.
• Work is performed under direct supervision and follows established procedures and guidelines to support contract monitoring and compliance functions in accordance with Federal, State, and County regulations.

CANDIDATE RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Coordinates and participates in pre-proposal/ kick-off conferences to inform bidders about the County’s SBE requirements, oral presentations, selection meetings, workshops, and evaluation processes; interacts with consultants, vendors, providers, and using divisions on procurement documents, procedures, and selection criteria.
• Assist divisions with award criteria development, professional service contract negotiations, and resolution of contractor, subcontractor, vendor, or provider conflicts.
• Monitors consultant, vendor, and provider performance through compliance reviews, inspections, site monitoring, utilization reporting, and verification of contractual obligations and payments.
• Participates in committees, meetings, community events, and expos as assigned.
• Develops and maintains procedures, databases, and tracking systems for contract administration.
• Evaluate Request for Proposals to determine SBE participation and good faith effort participation.
• Reviews SBE Subconsultant agreements for contract compliance.
• Sends out SBE congratulatory package via e-mail, which includes SBE required reporting forms and instruction guide to awarded Prime consultant.
• Creates and maintains contract files by updating all activity logs.
• Reviews Prime consultant SBE Utilization and monitors contracts for SBE compliance using compliance software.
• Completes Contract Closure process and conducts a site visit prior to project being closed.
• Maintains different databases.
• Compiles Professional Statistics for Monthly Certification and Compliance Report.

Skills Required:

• Ability to speak and understand English and ability to communicate effectively with internal staff and external vendors	Required		

• Must have an associates degree or currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field	Required		

• Experience with giving oral presentations and interacting with various outside organizations	Required	1	Years

• Experience using Microsoft Office, Word	Required	1	Years

• Experience with professional service contract negotiations, resolutions and conflicts	Required	1	Years

• Experience tracking compliance reviews, inspections, site monitoring and reporting	Required	1	Years

• Experience evaluating RFPs to determine SBE and good faith effort participation	Required	1	Years

• Strong organizational and record keeping skills	Required		

• Experience with government procurement or contract administration	Highly desired		

• Experience using B2Gnow Compliance	Highly desired

title: Attorney
description:
Job Overview:

Client is seeking an attorney to serve as a Contractor Associate General Counsel to assist its effort to strengthen Tennessee’s rural healthcare infrastructure by supporting the effective regulation of healthcare professionals serving residents throughout the state’s 89 rural counties. This position reports to a Deputy General Counsel. The primary role of this position is the handling of disciplinary cases against healthcare licensees practicing in rural Tennessee counties, which includes working with client's investigators and licensing board consultants during the investigative and review process, negotiating resolution with licensees who have violated their respective practice acts, and trying cases before licensing boards.  As assigned, job responsibilities may also include advising on special projects and conducting bill analysis related to the delivery of rural healthcare in Tennessee. Position requires weekly in-office time. This is a contract position not eligible for state employee benefits, and the successful candidate should obtain their own professional liability insurance.

Key Responsibilities:

 -- Represent the department in administrative law cases before various health-related boards.

 -- Review complaints and investigations involving healthcare licensees practicing in any of Tennessee’s 89 rural counties.

 -- Provide legal support for department investigators and licensing board consultants.

 -- For those cases for which formal discipine is warranted, handle all aspects of litigation, including discovery, motion practice, and trials.

 -- Ability to competently manage a robust case load at various phases of litigation.

 -- Assist with legislative projects as assigned, including bill analysis.

 Minimum Qualifications:

The ideal candidate should have litigation experience that includes trials, the ability to manage and prioritize a large volume of work, excellent verbal and written communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to collaborate and work in a team environment.

Education:

JD, admitted to TN Bar with a license in good standing required. At least 1 year of relevant legal experience preferred.

Items to include with application:

Please include with application a writing sample of not more than 10 pages along with the applicant’s TN Bar license number.

title: Administrative Services Assistant
description:
• The Administrative Services Assistant will perform a variety of general staff administrative duties to support program operations. 
• Will prepare, review, and maintain records and reports to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to standards. 
• Will serve as liaison between the agency and the public, persons in other state departments and divisions, officials, and entities outside the organization in order to explain matters of procedure and regulation.  
• Interpret and enforce existing policies and methods. 
• Prepare and review operating budgets to determine agency needs. 
• Conduct grant administration and monitoring to ensure compliance with grant requirements. 
• Conduct research in one or more of the following areas to obtain relevant information: fiscal, economic, non-technical legal, legislative, and publications.

• Substitution of Experience for Education: Qualifying full-time increasingly responsible sub-professional, paraprofessional, or professional experience may be substituted for the required education, on a year-for-year basis, to a maximum of four years.

title: Business Analyst – Jr Level
description:
• The Client is seeking qualified contractors to support the Education Freedom Scholarship Program during the application review period. 
• Contractors will be responsible for the intake, review, and evaluation of scholarship applications to determine family eligibility in accordance with established program guidelines. 
• This role is focused on the administrative processing and evaluation of parent-submitted applications. There is no direct interaction with parents, students, or the public.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree required.
Required Skills and Qualifications
• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when reviewing complex data and documentation.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and strong overall computer literacy.
• Ability to follow detailed instructions and consistently apply established review criteria and processes.
• Ability to meet strict deadlines while maintaining productivity and quality standards.
• Experience with data tracking, data review, or analytical processes requiring a high degree of accuracy.
• Ability to work collaboratively within a review team and participate in calibration and quality assurance activities.
• Strong sense of accountability and commitment to fair, consistent, and objective application evaluations.
• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities.
• Self-motivated with demonstrated ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and complete assignments with minimal supervision.

title: Public Health Office Assistant
description:
• The Client is seeking a Public Health Office Assistant.  The Client provides public health, primary care, and dental services. 
• The Public Health Office Assistant performs clerical tasks. These tasks include patient registration, scheduling, patient check-in and check-out, patient reminder and follow-up calls, referral coordination and other duties as assigned.  
• Applicants should be customer focused, self-motivated, team oriented, and willing to travel as needed, throughout the region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

•  Schedule and manage patient appointments
•  Inform patients of any visit requirements
•  Collect and update client demographic information for registration purposes
•  Review documentation to determine eligibility for federal and state programs
•  Input data into the health department management information systems
•  Interact with multiple computer software systems to input/receive information
•  Process the cash drawer and balance to ensure fiscal responsibility
•  Inform clients of their rights and responsibilities for participation in programs
•  Obtain prior authorization per guidance, before releasing medical information
•  Assist in obtaining prior authorization from insurers through the gathering and submission of documentation before services are rendered, as applicable
•  Compile appropriate forms for services requested to ensure efficient clinic flow
•  Scanning and Indexing records into the electronic dental record
•  Maintain a positive, constructive, and cooperative work environment

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

• High School Diploma or equivalent and experience equivalent to two years of full-time customer service delivery and/or clerical/office work. This position requires a current driver’s license and Tennessee Bureau of Investigation background check.
• Substitution of Education for Experience: Course work credit received from an accredited college or university may substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis to a maximum of two years (e.g., 45 quarter hours may substitute for one year of the required experience).
