title: L2 Technical Lead ZTNA support
description:
L2 Technical Lead - ZTNA Support

Position Details

Job Title: L2 Technical Lead - ZTNA Support

Work Environment: 24x7 Enterprise Security Operations & Technical
Support

Position Summary

The L2 Technical Lead serves as the primary technical
escalation point for complex ZTNA incidents, implementation issues,
integrations, and operational support activities. This role requires strong
troubleshooting expertise, mentoring capability, and hands-on experience across
network security technologies.

The role combines advanced support responsibilities with
technical leadership of L1 engineers during shift operations.

Experience

Graduate Engineer in Computer Science/IT/MCA

Minimum 5 years of experience in:

o Security Product Support

o Endpoint Protection

o Antivirus Solutions

o ZTNA Platforms

o Threat Hunting Environments

Experience in implementation and operational support

Security Product Certifications preferred

Key Responsibilities

Resolve complex technical incidents escalated from L1.

Lead shift operations and technical troubleshooting.

Support integrations involving AD, LDAP, MFA, SIEM, and
endpoints.

Mentor L1 engineers.

Perform root cause identification and remediation planning.

Handle customer escalations and technical review calls.

Create knowledge base articles and operational runbooks.

Participate in upgrades, migrations, and maintenance
activities.

Collaborate with OEM and product engineering teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills

· Linux Administration

· Networking Fundamentals

· TCP/IP

· DNS & Routing Concepts

· ZTNA Administration

· VPN Technologies

· Firewall Troubleshooting

· Port Connectivity Analysis

· AD/LDAP Integration

· MFA Troubleshooting

· Endpoint Security Platforms

· Log Analysis

· Incident Management

· Escalation Management

· Troubleshooting Methodologies

Good-to-Have Skills

· Load Balancers

· SSL Certificate Management

· SIEM Integration

· Basic Scripting (PowerShell/Bash/Python)

· HA/DR Operations

· Endpoint Compliance Policies

· Threat Hunting

· SASE/SSE Technologies

· Organisation HySecure Administration

Customer-Facing Responsibilities

· Participate in customer technical discussions.

· Conduct troubleshooting workshops.

· Provide RCA updates and remediation plans.

· Manage critical and priority incidents.

Incident & Escalation Responsibilities

· Own P1/P2 incidents until closure.

· Coordinate cross-functional troubleshooting.

· Manage major incident bridges.

· Ensure RCA delivery within defined timelines.

· Escalate product defects to OEM/L3 teams.

Behavioural Competencies

· Technical leadership

· Analytical thinking

· Stakeholder communication

· Mentoring and coaching

· Customer handling

· Crisis management

· Decision making

KPIs

· Critical Incident Resolution Rate

· SLA Adherence > 98%

· MTTR Improvement

· Escalation Reduction

· RCA Completion Timeliness

· Knowledge Article Creation

· L1 Capability Development

· CSAT Achievement

Experience in:

· Enterprise ZTNA Platforms

· Secure Access Solutions

· Identity and Access Management

· Network Security Products

· Enterprise Authentication Solutions

· Endpoint Security Platforms

· Organisation HySecure

· Zscaler

· Netskope

· Palo Alto

· Fortinet

title: L1 Technical Support Engineer - ZTNA Support
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking skilled L1 Technical Support Engineers to provide first-line support for a large enterprise Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) environment. The role involves troubleshooting access issues, endpoint connectivity problems, authentication failures, and user onboarding requests while ensuring SLA compliance and excellent customer experience.
This is a specialized cybersecurity support position and not a generic helpdesk or desktop support role. Candidates must have exposure to network security, remote access technologies, endpoint protection, or ZTNA solutions.                                                                                                                                                                    

Experience

Graduate Engineer in Computer Science, Information Technology, or MCA  

Minimum 2 years of experience supporting:  

ZTNA solutions  

Endpoint Security Platforms  

VPN/Secure Remote Access Solutions  

Enterprise Security Products  

Certification in Endpoint Security or ZTNA solutions preferred  

Key Responsibilities

Provide first-level support for ZTNA users and administrators.

Troubleshoot user authentication and access-related issues.

Support remote workforce connectivity incidents.

Perform ticket triage and categorization.

Collect logs and diagnostic information.

Escalate complex issues to L2 support teams.

Ensure timely incident updates and customer communication.

Support endpoint client installation and troubleshooting.

Follow incident management and change management processes.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Windows OS troubleshooting

Basic Linux Command Line

TCP/IP Fundamentals

DNS Fundamentals

VPN/ZTNA Client Installation & Troubleshooting

User Authentication Troubleshooting

Endpoint Security Basics

Ticket Management

Basic Log Collection & Analysis

Remote User Support

Basic Networking Diagnostics

Good-to-Have Skills

Active Directory

MFA Troubleshooting

Antivirus/EDR Platforms

ITSM Tools

SASE/SSE Concepts

Accops HySecure Exposure

Secure Access Gateway Technologies

Customer-Facing Responsibilities

Act as the first point of contact for users.

Provide timely and professional issue updates.

Guide users through troubleshooting procedures.

Ensure positive customer experience during incidents.

Incident & Escalation Responsibilities

Acknowledge incidents within defined SLA.

Perform initial diagnosis.

Escalate unresolved issues to L2 teams with complete logs and findings.

Maintain ticket ownership until closure or handoff.

Behavioural Competencies

Customer-centric mindset

Strong communication skills

Problem-solving approach

Accountability and ownership

Team collaboration

Documentation discipline.

Ability to work in rotational shifts

SLA Compliance ? 98%

Ticket Backlog Management

Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

title: Project Manager (SPOC)
description:
Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced Project Manager (SPOC) with a strong background in information security management and cybersecurity operations. The selected candidate will act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between the Purchaser and Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring smooth coordination, effective communication, and timely resolution of user queries and operational issues.

Key Responsibilities• Manage information security operations for large organizations or departments.

• Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Purchaser and MSP.

• Coordinate with stakeholders to resolve user queries, concerns, and operational issues.

• Oversee cybersecurity operations and ensure effective project execution.

• Manage project-related activities, communication, and stakeholder coordination.

• Ensure smooth information security service delivery.

Required Qualifications & Skills• Minimum 10 years of experience managing information security for large organizations/departments.

• Graduate or Master's degree from a recognized university.

• PMP certification is mandatory.

• Additional security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH will be an added advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations.

• Strong project management and coordination experience.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to act as an effective SPOC between the Purchaser, MSP, and end users.

title: Gen. AI Developer (Python+AI)
description:
About the RoleAs Gen. AI Developer, you will work in a collaborative, learning-focused environment and gain hands-on experience in building AI powered applications using Python, APIs, Large Language Models, RAG, AI agents and modern AI frameworks.

Key Responsibilities• Develop and test AI-powered applications using Python.

• Build and integrate REST APIs, databases, AI models and external services.

• Assist in developing LLM, RAG and AI-agent-based solutions.

• Process structured and unstructured data.

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

• Debug applications and improve performance and reliability.

• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project work.

Eligibility• B.E., B.Tech., MCA, M.Sc. or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, IT, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline.

• Available to work on-site.

• Strong interest in software development and Artificial Intelligence.

Must-Have Skills• Python programming and Object-Oriented Programming.

• Data Structures, Algorithms, and problem-solving fundamentals.

• SQL and relational database basics.

• Source Code Management tools (Git/GitHub/Bitbucket) basics.

• REST API, knowledge of NumPy and Pandas.

• Machine Learning fundamentals including classification, regression, training and validation, overfitting and evaluation metrics.

• Understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models.

• Good communication, teamwork and learning ability.

Good-to-Have Skills• FastAPI, Flask, Django or similar frameworks.

• Prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, A2A, MCP.

• LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel or similar frameworks.

• Vector databases such as FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, or Qdrant.

• Hugging Face models or OpenAI-compatible APIs.

• Embeddings, transformers, and semantic search.

• scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

• Docker, Linux, cloud fundamentals.

• Academic, personal, internship or open-source AI projects.

title: Administrative Services Assistant
description:
Job Overview: 

Join our dynamic team as an Administrative Assistant for Training and provide comprehensive administrative and operational support for the Tennessee Corrections Institute’s training operations and East Tennessee Training Facility located in Clinton, Tennessee. This individual serves as a primary administrative point of contact for staff, students, training participants, instructors, and visitors while coordinating a wide range of training, records, technology, facility, and customer-service functions.

Responsibilities:

• Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support for TCI’s training programs, personnel, and facilities to ensure efficient daily operations.
• Serve as a primary point of contact for students, instructors, agency personnel, vendors, and visitors by managing telephone calls, inquiries, facility check-ins, and customer service needs.
• Manage student enrollment, registration, course creation, class scheduling, and training records within ACADIS, including system administration, data entry, and user account assistance.
• Coordinate training schedules, class rosters, attendance documentation, completion records, and other administrative requirements associated with training delivery.
• Provide administrative and logistical support for training courses, including classroom preparation, instructional materials, technology setup, instructor assistance, and student accommodation.
• Prepare, distribute, and maintain correspondence, memorandums, training announcements, certificates, reports, spreadsheets, purchase orders, and other administrative documents.
• Maintain accurate electronic records, databases, and filing systems utilizing ACADIS, Microsoft Office applications, SharePoint, Adobe, and organizational network drives.
• Provide technical assistance and troubleshooting for training systems, classroom technology, audiovisual equipment, office equipment, and other electronic platforms.
• Coordinate facility and resource management activities, including supply inventories, purchasing requests, equipment readiness, building maintenance requests, and general facility operations.
• Manage competing administrative priorities, maintain confidentiality and accurate records, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.
Qualifications:

• Proven experience in customer service and administrative support.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
• Excellent organizational and time management skills to meet strict deadlines.
• Superior communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
• Previous experience working in an adminisitrative services role in a training environment is highly advantageous.
Required Skills

• Administative Assistant - 4-6 Years	 	
• Correspondence - Email	- 4-6 Years	 
• Correspondence - General- 4-6 Years	 
• Customer Service- 4-6 Years	 
• Customer Service Skills- 4-6 Years	 
• Data Entry- 4-6 Years	 
• Emailing- 4-6 Years	 
• Filing- 4-6 Years	 
• Inventory- 4-6 Years	 
• Microsoft Excel- 4-6 Years	 
• Microsoft PowerPoint- 4-6 Years	 
• Microsoft Word- 4-6 Years	 
• Printing and Copying - 4-6 Years	 
• Proofreading/Editing - 4-6 Years	 
• Scheduling - 4-6 Years	 
• Typing - 4-6 Years	 
• Verbal Communication - 4-6 Years

title: Purchasing Administrator
description:
• The Client provides cost-effective, secure, consistent, reliable enterprise-technology services to our partner agencies so that they can better serve our mutual customer,the Hoosier taxpayer.

Role Overview:
• The Purchasing Administrator is a subject-matter expert in the procurement of various commodities and services in a cost-effective manner and on a timely basis. You will handle sensitive issues when dealing with agency personnel and vendors, supporting the decisions of upper management. You will coordinate and execute client procurement functions in accordance with Indiana Code.
To be a certified buyer for the client, you must take the Indiana Delegation of Purchasing Authority Program (DPAP) classes and pass the DPAP test within four weeks of the date of hire. The training is conducted by the client.

A Day in the Life:
The essential functions of this role are as follows:
• Provide administrative oversight of both automation-related and traditional contract services.
• Purchase on behalf of the agency within a pre-determined delegation authority and consistent with agency purchasing and procurement laws, rules, regulations, and procedures.
• Maintain a substantial file system covering all services or items contracted for by the Agency.
• Perform vendor bid/quote evaluations to determine most responsible and responsive vendor for purchase process.
• Analyze vendor performance issues regarding contract administration Apply State-described vendor percentage preferences to purchases.
• Negotiate, execute, and administer contracts, QPA Agreements and amendments
• Communicate with staff and outside vendors as necessary to solve problems, address complaints, and facilitate the timely processing of purchases.
• Document fully and accurately all purchase processes for auditing purposes. Ensure that all procurement-related documents are completed fully and accurately.
• Act as a resource to provide guidance and assistance for agency procurement agents concerning procedures, policies, and regulations governing all purchasing and contract activities.
• Troubleshoot agency functional issues in PeopleSoft eProcurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, and Supplier Contract Management.
• Establish and maintain assessment criteria according to current procurement rules and statutes.
• The job profile is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

What You'll Need for Success:
• You must meet the following requirements to be considered for employment:
• Bachelor of Science degree in Accounting, Finance, Purchasing or Business Management or 5 to 8 years of full-time professional experience.
• Broad knowledge in contracting, requisitions and purchasing/procurement, accounting, business administration, fiscal management, or related experience.
• Broad knowledge of client and federal procurement laws, rules, procedures, practices, and forms. Extensive knowledge specific to overseeing and managing contracts.

Effective communication skills.
• Broad knowledge and advanced proficiency with E-Procurement management system and ability to use the Microsoft Suite software.
• Expertise with general project management including financial management, and conflict management. Ability to negotiate contracts and bids.
• Inter-personal relationship skills are a must, and strong communicators with positive attitudes will be most successful in the established work environment.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality.
• Eligible to be bonded and able to accurately handle financial documents.
• You must satisfy the following requirements to continue employment:
• Required to take initial Administration Purchasing and Procurement training and to attend any further required training.

Required Skills:
• Professional experience in purchasing administration, procurement operations, or a closely related function.	Required	5	Years
• Demonstrated experience in procurement, contract administration, requisition processing, financial mgmt, accounting, or related business operations	Required	5	Years
• Knowledge of applicable state and federal procurement laws, regulations, policies, and procedures, including compliance requirements and documentation	Required	5	Years
• Demonstrated experience managing procurement contracts, overseeing vendor performance, evaluating bids, and supporting contract negotiations	Required	5	Years
• Experience with general project management including financial and conflict management	Required	3	Years
• Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to establish effective working relationships	Required	 	 
• Proficiency in Microsoft applications, including Excel, Word, Outlooks, and PowerPoint, to support procurement activities	Required	 	 
• Advanced proficiency with electronic procurement (eProcurement) systems	Highly desired	 	 
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Purchasing or Business Management	Highly desired	 	 
• Experience supporting procurement operations within a government or public-sector environment, preferably within state government	Desired	 	 
• Professional procurement certification (e.g., CPPB, CPPO, CPSM, or prior DPAP)	Desired	 	 
• Experience procuring IT goods and services including software, hardware, and telecom	Desired	 	 
• Experience coordinating with agency personnel and vendors to facilitate procurement activities	Desired

title: FTE-UI/UX Design
description:
About Team:

We are a design-driven, product-focused team focused on creating meaningful digital experiences through UX, UI, Graphic, and Motion Design.

Our philosophy is simple: Great design is not just how it looks, but how it works. We believe in user-centric thinking, problem-solving, simplicity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

We are a learning-first team where freshers are mentored, challenged, and encouraged to grow through real-world design projects, feedback sessions, and hands-on experience.

We value curiosity, ownership, consistency, and a willingness to learn more than existing skill level. If you're passionate about design and eager to improve, you'll fit right in.

Role Overview:

We are looking for high-potential UX/UI Design Interns, who are passionate about solving user problems and eager to learn structured design thinking. This role focuses on training and developing candidates into job-ready UX designers through hands-on projects and mentorship.

Key Responsibilities:

• Assist in designing user-centered digital experiences for web and mobile platforms.

• Work on user flows, wireframes, and basic prototypes.

• Translate problem statements into structured design solutions.

• Support in UI design of screens with attention to usability and clarity.

• Participate in brainstorming, feedback sessions, and design reviews.

• Convert ideas and requirements into structured layouts using Figma.

• Maintain consistency in design systems, layouts, and components.

• Revise designs based on feedback and iterative improvements.

• Present design thinking and explain rationale behind decisions.

Required (Must-Have Skills & Tools)

Core Skills

• Basic understanding of: UX vs UI, and User-centered design approach

• Awareness of: User flows, Wireframes

Tools

• Familiarity with Figma (mandatory)

• Familiarity with Photoshop (Mandatory)

• Ability to create basic layouts and screens

Portfolio

• At least 1–2 design projects (academic/self-initiated)

• Portfolio should show: Process (not just final UI), Problem, and Solution thinking

Thinking & Communication Ability

• Ability to explain: “Why did you design this?”

• Basic problem-solving approach

• Can explain ideas clearly (verbal or written)

• Open to receiving and applying feedback

title: Senior Tableau Report Developer/ETL
description:
SCOPE OF WORK

The agency needs the service of a senior level Lead Full Stack Developer. The candidate will serve in the capacity of a Lead Developer participating in various SDLC processes including requirements verification, design and development, testing, maintenance, and support activities per the direction of agency management. The specific focus of this candidate will be the to be part of the team which supports existing .NET applications as well as to participates in the SDLC process of the new SACWIS system and work with the System Integrator to ensure the transfer of knowledge and on-going maintenance of the solution for a given module. Specifically, the candidate will be responsible for creating/maintaining SSRS reports and SSIS ETL packages ,supporting SOA integration initiatives and participating in the SDLC process which includes meetings with the SI, verification of deliverables such as requirements, design, testing, and environment configuration.  

Specific Services Required:

In the role of the Lead Developer, the following services are required:

Must be very organized, pro-active and self-directed.
Must be self-starter and driven.  Must Drive the work from requirements to implementation.
Must have very strong abstract thinking and problem-solving skills.
Must have very good verbal and written communication skills.
In this role, the following services are required:
1. Develops Tableau Reports.
2. Assist in the design and development of the database architecture including relational data structures, data marts, data dictionaries and logical and physical data models.
3. Develop strategies for data acquisitions, data quality and data discrepancy.
4. Assist in migration and integration of data and processes from legacy systems to new applications and new technologies.
5. Develop and maintain efficient, well documented custom SQL scripts, stored procedures, triggers using Microsoft T-SQL in accordance with defined business rules and requirements to support application development
7. Must have the ability to access data stored in a variety of database management systems such as DB2, SQL Server and other.
8. Design, develop and implement ETL/ ELT solutions for data ingestion, cleansing, business rules execution and Data Distribution.
9. Implementing Data Analytics best practices in designing data modeling, ETL Pipelines, Near time data solutions.
10. Coordinate with Business Analyst and users to validate requirements.
11. Implementing solutions to integrate external data with inhouse data.
12. Perform tests and validate data flows and prepare ETL processes according to business requirements.
13. Designing and implement a data conversion strategy from legacy to new platforms.
14. Perform design validation, reconciliation and error handling in data load processes.
15. Optimize SSIS Package execution and SQL execution to optimize data load performance.
16. Design SSIS packages using data exchange tasks such as File transfer and Secured File transfer. Ability to import and export files from FTP/SFTP.
17. Involvement in all stages like Requirements gathering, Data mapping, Data extraction, Data loading, Data testing, Troubleshooting, documentation, performance optimization and maintenance.
18. Development of different kind of reports using Tableau as per user requirement and deploying to report server/ integrated SharePoint report server.
19. Experience using dynamic grouping fields, dynamic group sorting, on-demand sub reports, drill down and summary reports, and creating cross tab reports highlighting key summary information.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
Refer to the State contracts for IT Professional Services Agreement (22PSX0163) for experience and skill requirements for the job classification Solution Architect to fill the role.  In addition, the agency requires:
A 10 or more years of prior experience demonstrating the following knowledge and skills:
1. More than 5 years of Experience with Tableau.
2. More than 5 years of experience writing complex SQL queries
3. More then 5 years Expertise with TSQL, SSRS, SSIS or Talend 
4. Experience with debug and improve query performance
5. Experience with deploying SSIS packages using git check-in, setting up environmental variables and creating respective jobs in SQL Agent.
7. Experience with Transact-SQL and stored procedures desired.
8. Experience with creating, deploying and maintaining of Tallend reports.
9. Experience with code control/version Team Foundation.
11. Strong problem solving, cross-functional analysis and forward-thinking abilities
12. Flexibility to adapt to changing situations, handle multiple tasks, and meet tight deadlines

Additional Preferred Qualifications:
1. Experience with Salesforce 
2. MuleSoft.
4. ADMINISTRATIVE CONSIDERATIONS

title: System Administrator 4
description:
• Required experience as a Systems Administrator, creativity and multi-tasking to independently and collaboratively achieve department service and support objectives for the Client.
• The System Administrator is responsible for effective provisioning, installation/configuration, operation, and maintenance of computer hardware and software and related infrastructure. 
• This individual ensures that system hardware, operating systems, software systems, and related procedures adhere to policies, standards, and guidelines. 
Responsibilities include 
• systems administration engineering and provisioning, operations and support, maintenance and research and development to ensure continual innovation. Install new / rebuild existing servers and configure hardware, peripherals, services, settings, directories, storage, etc. in accordance with standards and project/operational requirements. 
• Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all hardware, server resources, systems and key processes, reviewing system and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs such as backups. 
• Perform regular security monitoring to identify any possible intrusions. Perform daily backup operations and regular file archival and purge as necessary. 
• Create, change, and delete user accounts per request. 
• Provide Tier III/other support per request from various constituencies. Investigate and troubleshoot issues. Diagnose and recover from hardware or software failures. 
• Coordinate and communicate with impacted constituencies. 
• Apply OS patches and upgrades on a regular basis, and upgrade administrative tools and utilities. Configure / add new services as necessary. 
• Upgrade and configure system software that supports GIS infrastructure applications or Asset Management applications per project or operational needs. 
• Maintain operational, configuration, or other procedures. 
• Perform periodic performance reporting to support capacity planning. 
• Perform ongoing performance tuning, hardware upgrades, and resource optimization as required.

3-5 years of experience required.

• Responds to all levels of support requests from Tier 1 - 3.
• Provides exceptional customer service.
• Communicates effectively with teammates and customers of varying levels of technical expertise.
• Responds to all break/fix requests associated with end user resources.
• Configures and deploys new/replacement desktop/laptop computer equipment and peripherals.
• Maintains up-to-date project and architecture documentation.
• Maintains up-to-date inventory and maintenance records.
• Monitors system resources for server/service anomalies.
• Resolves connection issues between users and resources.
• Maintains detailed change history of changes.
• Supports team efforts to improve cybersecurity controls and defenses.
• Supports team efforts for threat hunting and mitigation.
• Manages time and resource constraints.
Skills Required:

• Configures and deploys new/replacement Linux(REDHAT) and Windows Operating Systems Servers Required 5 Years
• Desktop/Laptop/Server Hardware Required 5 Years
• Experience with Active Directory Administration Required 5 Years
• Virtualization/VMWare Required 5 Years
• Backup and Recovery Required 5 Years
• Help Desk Support Required 5 Years
• Customer Service Required 5 Years
• Cybersecurity Highly desired 2 Years
• Hands-On w/Network Equip Desired 3 Years
• Experience with Video Management Systems Desired 2 Years
• Microsoft Certification/ Related certifications Nice to have 
• Audio-Video Support Nice to have

title: Senior Firmware Design Engineer – Fire & Safety Domain
description:
About Job Role

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Firmware Design Engineer with 7-10 years of experience to develop, enhance, migrate, sustain, and release embedded firmware for fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product extensions, platform modernization, value engineering, component obsolescence, compliance, and field or production support. The engineer will own assigned firmware work packages, define maintainable architectures, develop reusable platform software and product features, and ensure deterministic behaviour on target hardware. Assignments may include microcontroller or toolchain migration, protocol development, diagnostics, hardware integration, verification, and issue resolution across multiple product families.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Architecture and Product Development

•  Own firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.
• Analyses system and software requirements, hardware interfaces, existing code, field behaviour, regulatory constraints, and manufacturing needs before defining the implementation approach.
• Define and implement modular architectures covering startup, BSP, HAL, drivers, protocols, application logic, diagnostics, configuration, and production-test support.
• Develop production embedded software in C for bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, with appropriate use of interrupts, timers, state machines, memory, and communication peripherals.
• Plan and execute microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when required, including build, linker, startup, timing, peripheral, and compatibility changes. 
• Create reusable software components and controlled product configurations that reduce duplication and simplify maintenance across product families.
Real Time Control Interfaces and Diagnostics

• Implement deterministic control, supervision, communication, indication, relay, power-state, and fault-handling behaviour appropriate to the product.
• Design safe responses for reset, brownout, watchdog, communication loss, open or short circuits, power transitions, and invalid configuration conditions.
• Develop or maintain wired and proprietary communication protocols, diagnostics, logging, calibration, and service functions while preserving required compatibility.
•  Manage flash, RAM, stack, CPU loading, timing, and recovery margins and document relevant design limits.
Software Quality Verification and Compliance

• Convert system, hardware, regulatory, and product requirements into software requirements, design descriptions, test cases, and traceability.
• Develop unit, integration, hardware-in-the-loop, fault-injection, protocol, timing, and regression tests, including reusable test utilities and automation where practical.
• Apply coding standards, peer review, static analysis, version control, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, and controlled change practices; apply MISRA C principles where appropriate.
• Perform board bring-up and signal-level debugging with hardware engineers using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial tools, and protocol analysers.
• Support UL, FM, FCC, and other required compliance or certification testing with controlled test firmware, issue reproduction, corrective action, documented evidence, and retest closure.
Product Lifecycle Release and Technical Leadership

• Assess firmware impact from value-engineering changes, alternate components, hardware revisions, and component obsolescence; update drivers, calibration, timing, and configuration as required.
• Release reproducible firmware packages containing source, project files, configuration, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, test evidence, and traceability.
• Support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, phase-in, sustaining issues, and structured investigation of field problems.
• Review junior engineers' work, identify dependencies and risks early, and communicate design decisions and verification status in technical reviews.
   Qualifications

•   7-10 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including responsibility for implementation, integration, debugging, verification, and production release. 
•   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline. 
•     Strong Embedded C skills and practical experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, interrupts, timers, state machines, memory constraints, and deterministic real-time behaviour.
•    Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining modular BSP, HAL, driver, protocol, application, diagnostic, or boot and update layers for production embedded products.
•    Experience migrating firmware between microcontroller families, compilers, IDEs, or hardware revisions and resolving architecture, linker, startup, timing, and peripheral differences.
•    Hands-on debugging with embedded toolchains, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial tools, and protocol analysers. 
•    Working knowledge of version control, code review, static analysis, defect tracking, configuration management, unit testing, integration testing, and regression testing.
   Preferred Experience

•    Prior firmware-development experience in fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated product industry is strongly preferred. 
•    Hands-on participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; experience supporting UL 864 or FM Approvals is valuable.
•     Experience with Renesas or comparable microcontrollers, IAR or similar toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernization is preferred.
•   Experience with fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary networks, supervised field circuits, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.
Core Competencies

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Architecture | Product Development | Real-Time Systems | Protocol Engineering | Hardware Debugging | Software Quality | Compliance | Technical Guidance

title: Hardware Design Engineer – Fire & Safety Domain
description:
About Job Role

We are seeking a hands-on Hardware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to
develop, modify, verify, and support electronic products used in organisation’s
fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development,
product enhancements, value engineering, component lifecycle, compliance, and
production needs. Working with the Hardware Engineering Manager and experienced
engineers, the candidate will own defined circuit or board-level assignments,
contribute to schematic and PCB development, bring up prototypes, execute
laboratory testing, and maintain clear engineering records. Assignments may
involve new designs, controlled redesigns, alternate components, platform
migrations, or corrective actions based on quality and field feedback.

Key Responsibilities

Hardware
Design and Engineering

•     Develop hardware work
packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and
value-engineering initiatives.

•     Review requirements,
schematics, PCB files, BOMs, datasheets, product documentation, test
procedures, and field or manufacturing issues for assigned work.

•     Prepare I/O lists,
interface tables, component comparisons, design calculations, and technical
notes under guidance from the engineering lead.

•     Design or modify
microcontroller, power, clock, reset, debug, memory, communication, sensing,
protection, relay, indicator, and supervised I/O circuits as assigned.

•     Select components, create
or verify symbols and footprints, check derating and lifecycle status, add test
points, and support PCB placement and routing reviews.

•     Maintain accurate
schematics, BOMs, calculations, interface documents, design notes, and
engineering-change records.

Value
Engineering and Product Lifecycle

•     Analyse BOM items and
circuit function to identify lower-cost alternatives, component commonization,
part-count reduction, and supply-chain risk reduction.

•     Compare and bench-test
alternate components for electrical fit, functional equivalence, thermal
margin, reliability, availability, and compliance impact.

•     Work with component
engineering and sourcing to document lifecycle status, approved manufacturers,
lead-time risks, and qualification evidence.

Bring Up,
Verification and Compliance

•     Support prototype assembly,
inspection, rework, power-on checks, current-limited bring-up, firmware
loading, and systematic fault isolation.

•     Execute approved
functional, power, I/O, communication, fault, thermal, transient, ESD, EFT,
surge, EMC pre-compliance, and system-integration tests as applicable.

•     Use oscilloscopes, logic
analysers, DMMs, programmable supplies, electronic loads, and protocol tools to
capture repeatable measurements and troubleshoot failures.

•     Document test results,
failures, root cause, corrective actions, and regression evidence in accordance
with the development process.

•     Support sample preparation,
test modes, setup records, and evidence for UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable
compliance or certification testing.

Integration
and Production Support

•     Work with firmware

title: Firmware Design Engineer – Fire & Safety Domain
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to implement, integrate, verify, and support embedded firmware for Client's fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product enhancements, platform updates, value engineering, component changes, compliance, and production support. Working with the Firmware Engineering Manager and experienced engineers, the candidate will own defined modules or features, develop drivers and product logic, support hardware bring-up, investigate defects, execute tests, and maintain controlled technical records. Assignments may include new implementations, legacy-code improvements, hardware or toolchain migrations, and changes driven by quality, cost, availability, or field performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Firmware Development and Implementation 

• Implement firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives. 

• Review software requirements, hardware interfaces, schematics, datasheets, existing source code, product documentation, and test procedures for assigned work. 

• Develop or update startup, BSP, HAL, and driver modules for GPIO, timers, interrupts, ADC, PWM, serial interfaces, flash, non-volatile memory, watchdogs, and debug functions. 

• Implement application logic for control, communication, indication, relays, supervised I/O, configuration, diagnostics, trouble reporting, and power-state behaviour as required. 

• Maintain clear separation between reusable platform software and product configuration to reduce duplication and simplify regression. 

• Support microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when included in an assigned project. 

Integration Debugging and Verification 

• Support board bring-up, peripheral validation, signal-level debugging, and hardware-firmware fault isolation with hardware engineers. 

• Create and execute unit, module, integration, protocol, timing, fault-injection, regression, and system-integration tests for assigned features. 

• Reproduce defects, collect logs and measurements, identify root cause, implement corrections, and verify that changes do not disturb existing behaviour. 

• Use embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial terminals, and protocol tools during implementation and debugging. 

• Maintain requirements traceability, design notes, code-review records, test results, defect status, and release documentation for completed work. 

Product Lifecycle Compliance and Release Support 

• Implement firmware changes required by alternate components, hardware revisions, calibration updates, performance improvements, and cost-down initiatives. 

• Support controlled test firmware and operating modes for transient, EMC, UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable compliance or certification testing. 

• Prepare reproducible builds, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, and configuration records and support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, and phase-in. 

• Assist with production and field issue investigation and document corrective actions and regression evidence. 

Team Collaboration 

• Work with firmware, hardware, validation, compliance, manufacturing, product, and Client's US stakeholders to complete assigned work. 

• Participate in design and code reviews, raise unclear requirements and technical risks early, and close assigned actions with objective evidence. 

• Contribute reusable drivers, diagnostic utilities, test tools, documentation, and lessons learned for future development work. 

Qualifications 

• 3-7 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including coding, hardware integration, debugging, testing, and controlled release support. 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline. 

• Strong Embedded C fundamentals and practical experience with microcontrollers, interrupts, timers, GPIO, ADC, serial communications, watchdogs, and non-volatile memory. 

• Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based embedded systems, modular drivers, state machines, error handling, and resource-constrained products. 

• Ability to read schematics, datasheets, interface specifications, existing source code, system requirements, and test procedures and convert them into working firmware. 

• Hands-on experience with embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD, common laboratory tools, version control, and defect tracking. 

• A disciplined approach to coding, peer review, test evidence, root-cause analysis, regression testing, configuration management, and documentation. 

Preferred Experience 

• Prior experience with fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated embedded product is strongly preferred. 

• Participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; exposure to UL 864 or FM Approvals is an advantage. 

• Experience with Renesas or similar microcontrollers, IAR or comparable toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred. 

• Exposure to fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary protocols, supervised I/O, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous. 

Core Competencies 

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Implementation | MCU Peripherals | Hardware Debugging | Test Discipline | Product Lifecycle | Root-Cause Analysis | Documentation | Collaboration

title: Technical Lead (VDI)
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead with strong knowledge of Linux, Windows, and VDI environments. The candidate should have team leadership experience, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to handle technical escalations and stakeholder coordination. Willingness to work in day/night shifts is required.

Key Responsibilities• Lead and support technical operations across Linux, Windows, and VDI environments.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to operating systems, virtual desktops, and infrastructure.
• Handle technical escalations and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Provide technical guidance and support to team members.
• Monitor infrastructure performance, system availability, and service quality.
• Coordinate with internal teams and stakeholders to resolve technical issues.
• Ensure adherence to SLAs, operational procedures, and IT service management processes.
• Identify recurring issues and implement effective root-cause solutions.
• Prepare technical reports, maintain documentation, and share operational updates with stakeholders.
• Work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced support environment.
• Be flexible to work in day or night shifts, as required.
Required Skills and Qualifications• Strong hands-on knowledge of Linux operating systems.
• Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems and administration.
• Hands-on experience with VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure) environments.
• Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or Senior Technical Support Engineer with leadership responsibilities.
• Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Experience handling technical escalations and critical incidents.
• Good communication, team coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical issues.
• Willingness to work in rotational day/night shifts, as applicable.
Preferred Candidate Profile• Candidates with practical experience in Linux, Windows, and VDI environments.
• Professionals with experience managing technical teams or leading infrastructure support operations.
• Candidates with strong incident management, troubleshooting, and escalation-handling experience.
• Individuals with a customer-focused approach and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
Brief Description of Job Duties: 

• Coordinates and manages IT, administrative, program or operations related agency projects from initiation to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required standards to translate strategic goals into actionable plans.

Specified Duties: 

Project Approval and Prioritization 

•	Consult with agency staff regarding the development of new projects.

•	Support the agency’s Project Management Portfolio process through analysis, presentations, and reports for the agency’s leadership.

•	Complete the Planned Project Template for reportable projects.

Project Planning

Develop or assist in the development of project plans (including schedules, Communication Plans, Quality Plans, Deliverable Definition Documents, etc.), budget requests, and management procedures.

•	Initiate project specific tools (such as MS Project and SharePoint) and practices within the State of Kansas guidelines which will be used to facilitate project tracking, reporting, and collaboration.

•	Coordinate and develop High Level and Detailed planning documents for reportable projects.

•	Coordinate and develop Federal Planning and Implementation Advanced Planning Documents (APD). 

•	Evaluate project plans for compliance with architecture, standards, policies, and guidelines.

•	Provide IT project oversight to agency stakeholders and leadership for compliance with information technology planning guidelines, standards, policies and methodologies.

Project Execution

•	Manage IT project plans and coordinate the work of project members, internal and contracted, working on the project.

•	Track project progress against established timeline, budget, and deliverable definitions.

•	Maintain project specific tools and practices to ensure effective project tracking, reporting, and collaboration.

•	Identify, report, and facilitate the resolution of project deficiencies in the form of issues and risks.

•	Consult with agency stakeholders and leadership on progress of projects.

•	Provide project related presentations/briefings as required.

•	Coordinate and provide reporting on reportable projects

•	Conduct lessons learned sessions and develop close out documentation.

General Duties

•	Provide support for the Project Management Office’s overall responsibilities, such as, agency project portfolio management, liaison and reporting requirements, and maintenance of agency project management tools.

•	Assist Project Analysts and other Project Managers as required. 

•	Other duties as assigned.

Education Required: 

•	High school diploma or GED

Preferred Qualifications:

•	Four years of experience with IT-related project management

•	Must possess a certification or a traditional IT Project Management Methodology, such as the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)

title: Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer to architect, engineer, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions that transform business operations, improve decision-making, and drive measurable business outcomes.

This role requires a combination of advanced AI engineering expertise, solution architecture, software development, and direct business engagement. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to identify complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, secure, and production-ready AI applications.

The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience building and deploying Large Language Model (LLM)-powered applications, AI agents, intelligent automation workflows, and enterprise integrations. This individual will own technical delivery from solution discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and continuous optimization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the architecture, design, development, and deployment of complex, production-grade AI solutions across enterprise business functions.
• Build end-to-end AI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Azure OpenAI, and other enterprise AI platforms.
• Develop advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and intelligent automation solutions.
• Design and implement sophisticated prompt engineering strategies, context management, tool calling, and orchestration frameworks.
• Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, APIs, databases, business workflows, and existing technology ecosystems.
• Lead technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders to identify high-impact AI use cases and translate business requirements into engineering solutions.
• Independently own the complete AI solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing enhancements.
• Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and AI-powered application components using Python and modern software engineering practices.
• Implement enterprise-grade AI security, access controls, data privacy, responsible AI practices, and governance standards.
• Establish evaluation frameworks to measure AI accuracy, response quality, hallucination rates, performance, latency, and business impact.
• Optimize AI applications for scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, and production performance.
• Collaborate with cloud, data engineering, application development, and infrastructure teams to operationalize AI solutions.
• Drive rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept development, converting successful prototypes into maintainable production systems.
• Provide technical leadership, conduct code reviews, establish engineering standards, and mentor other engineers.
• Identify opportunities for AI-driven process transformation and recommend practical solutions that deliver measurable business value.
Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of overall experience in software engineering, solution development, AI engineering, or related technical disciplines.
• 4+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML or intelligent automation solutions, including substantial recent experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
• Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise AI solutions into production environments.
• Strong hands-on expertise with LLM platforms such as OpenAI GPT, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent enterprise LLM services.
• Advanced proficiency in Python, including development of backend services, APIs, AI applications, and automation frameworks.
• Strong experience with AI application architecture, prompt engineering, function calling, tool integration, and LLM orchestration.
• Hands-on experience building RAG-based applications, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimization, and response generation.
• Experience developing AI agents and workflow orchestration solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
• Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, enterprise application integration, and distributed application architecture.
• Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems, databases, business applications, and cloud-based platforms.
• Strong knowledge of AI application testing, evaluation, observability, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
• Experience managing technical delivery independently, from solution design through deployment and operational support.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with senior business stakeholders and translate complex requirements into technical solutions.
Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and related cloud-native services.
• Experience with AWS or other enterprise cloud platforms for deploying AI workloads.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and enterprise workflow automation.
• Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar platforms.
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and production deployment practices.
• Knowledge of agentic AI architectures, multi-agent collaboration, memory management, and autonomous workflow execution.
• Experience implementing LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement pipelines.
• Familiarity with enterprise data security, regulatory requirements, access governance, and responsible AI principles.
• Experience delivering AI solutions within financial services, insurance, investment management, or other regulated enterprise environments.
Core Technical Skills

• Programming: Python, REST APIs, Backend Engineering
• Generative AI: GPT, Azure OpenAI, Claude, LLM Applications
• AI Engineering: RAG, AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling
• Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel
• Cloud: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, AWS
• Integration: Microservices, Enterprise APIs, Databases, Workflow Automation
• Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Cloud Deployment
• Production Readiness: LLM Evaluation, Observability, Security, Scalability, Performance Optimization

title: Solution Architect AWS Integration
description:
Solution Architect – AWS & Integration

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with
strong AWS and Enterprise Integration expertise to design and modernize
large-scale integration solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on
architecture experience across APIs, A2A, B2B/EDI, event-driven, batch,
file-based, and cloud-native integrations.

Key Responsibilities

 • Design
     end-to-end enterprise integration and solution architectures across
     AWS, on-premise, and hybrid environments.

 • Assess
     legacy integration platforms and define modernization and migration
     strategies.

 • Design
     integration patterns for APIs, A2A, B2B/EDI, events, messaging, batch,
     SFTP/AS2, and data integration.

 • Develop
     Current-State, Target-State and North Star Architecture.

 • Define
     API, messaging, transformation, orchestration, routing, error-handling,
     retry and monitoring patterns.

 • Design
     scalable and secure solutions using AWS cloud-native integration
     services.

 • Define
     architecture for trading partner onboarding, EDI processing, mapping,
     acknowledgements, certificate management and transaction monitoring.

 • Evaluate
     integration platforms and recommend appropriate technologies based on
     business and technical requirements.

 • Define
     security, scalability, availability, resiliency and observability
     requirements.

 • Lead
     architecture workshops and provide technical direction to engineering
     teams.

 • Collaborate
     with Enterprise Architecture, Application, Data, Security, Infrastructure
     and DevOps teams.

 • Create
     architecture diagrams, High-Level Designs, technical standards and
     Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Required Skills

 • 10+
     years of overall IT experience with 5+ years in
     Solution/Integration Architecture.

 • Strong
     experience with AWS architecture and cloud-native services.

 • Strong
     knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns.

 • Experience
     with REST/SOAP APIs, microservices and API management.

 • Strong
     understanding of event-driven architecture, Kafka, messaging and
     Pub/Sub.

 • Experience
     with B2B/EDI – X12, EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP and trading partner integration.

 • Experience
     with batch, file-based and data integration.

 • Strong
     understanding of OAuth, OIDC, TLS/mTLS, IAM, certificates, encryption
     and secrets management.

 • Experience
     with integration modernization and migration programs.

AWS Skills

Experience with several of the following:

API Gateway | Lambda | EventBridge | SQS | SNS | Step
Functions | S3 | Transfer Family | AWS B2B Data Interchange | EKS/ECS | AWS
Batch | MWAA/Airflow | RDS | DynamoDB | CloudWatch | IAM | KMS | Secrets
Manager

Integration Platform Experience

Experience with one or more of:

MuleSoft | Informatica | IBM ACE/IIB | DataStage | Cleo |
OpenText | Axway | Boomi | Kafka | AWS Native Integration Services

Preferred Qualifications

 • AWS
     Certified Solutions Architect or equivalent certification.

 • Experience
     migrating legacy middleware/integration platforms to AWS.

 • Strong
     B2B/EDI and Trading Partner Management experience.

 • Experience
     defining North Star integration architecture and modernization roadmaps.

 • Experience
     with DevOps, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a Solution Architect who understands
integration end-to-end, rather than an architect focused only on
infrastructure. The candidate should be able to assess an existing integration
landscape, identify the appropriate modernization pattern, select suitable AWS
or integration-platform capabilities, and define a scalable target architecture
covering A2A, APIs, B2B/EDI, events, batch and data integration.

title: AWS DevOps Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Architect to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Define enterprise AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures.
• Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments.
• Architect CI/CD pipelines for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure.
• Establish Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation.
• Design containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR.
• Define deployment strategies including Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback.
• Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments.
• Implement DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement.
• Design AWS networking patterns involving VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
• Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
• Implement observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana.
• Design IAM and security models following least-privilege and Zero Trust principles.
• Implement secrets and encryption management using AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS.
• Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity.
• Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators.
• Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS.
• Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging.
• Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams.
• Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership.

Required Experience

• 10+ years of overall IT experience with 5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience.
• 3+ years in a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer role.
• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including:• EC2, S3, IAM, VPC
• Lambda
• ECS/EKS
• ECR
• API Gateway
• Route 53
• ALB/NLB
• CloudWatch and CloudTrail
• Secrets Manager and KMS
• EventBridge, SNS and SQS
• Step Functions

• Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
• Experience with AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation.
• Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
• Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild.
• Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.
• Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.
• Experience implementing enterprise DevSecOps and security automation.
• Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions.
• Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion. 

Integration Modernization Experience – Preferred

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:

• Amazon API Gateway for API management and exposure.
• AWS Lambda for serverless processing and integration.
• Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS for event-driven integration.
• AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration.
• AWS Transfer Family for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration.
• AWS B2B Data Interchange for EDI transformation and processing.
• Amazon S3 for enterprise file and message storage.
• AWS Batch for large-scale batch processing.
• Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
• Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems.
DevSecOps Responsibilities

The architect should establish automated controls for:

• SAST/DAST and dependency scanning
• Container image scanning
• Infrastructure vulnerability scanning
• Terraform/IaC security validation
• Secrets detection
• IAM and policy validation
• Automated compliance checks
• Artifact and container security
• Audit logging and traceability
Role Expectations

The AWS DevOps Architect will own the end-to-end DevOps and cloud automation architecture, ensuring that AWS workloads can be provisioned, built, tested, secured, deployed, monitored, scaled, recovered, and operated through standardized and highly automated processes.

This is an architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role, not simply a CI/CD administration position.

    • ECR

    • Route 53

  • Amazon API Gateway for API management and exposure.

  • Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS for event-driven integration.

This is an architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role, not simply a CI/CD administration position.

This role manages the full testing lifecycle, including designing the overall test strategy, planning, execution, reporting, detailed test data preparation, and overseeing End?to?End (E2E) testing. 

The SA/QA Manager will coordinate testing efforts with business teams to obtain user scenarios and test cases, organize meetings, support UAT, ensure proper test coverage and traceability, and perform test readiness reviews. title: Application Developer
description:
• The Client aims to predict, prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats faster and more efficiently than ever before. Under this initiative, The Client is committed to achieving this vision by developing and deploying approaches that move the public health community from siloed and brittle public health data systems to connected, resilient, adaptable, and sustainable ‘response-ready’ systems capable of meeting today and tomorrow’s health challenges.  

(Data Modernization Initiative (DMI) Program Overview  

• Various sections and programs currently track and manage critical information through disparate Excel files and Word documents. This manual, unstructured approach creates compliance risks, missed deadlines, and limited data visibility. Transitioning from a paper-based workflow to an automated Microsoft Power BI ecosystem through a Data Submissions and CGMS Portal has been a comprehensive, modernized, and successful strategy.  The core program goals focus on eliminating manual data entry, enforcing data governance, and providing stakeholders with real-time decision-support capabilities and data analytics.

Workstream Overview 

• (CGMS) Contracts, Grants, Management SystemThe (CGMS) Contracting process manages the full lifecycle of contract development and execution, progressing through the following key stages.  The current environment combines manual and system-assisted processes that support the full lifecycle of grants, contracting, financial reporting, and payment/refund activities. The process begins with the Contractor Information Intake process and moves through the below steps/phases, ending with the routing, approval, and execution phase.

Contractor Information Intake: 

• Program initiates the process by providing contractor details and required supporting documentation.
• Electronic Department Agreement Request (EDAR) Checklist Preparation: Program compiles and validates all required documentation, approvals, and data elements necessary for contract routing.
• Electronic Department Agreement Request (EDAR) Submission: The formal contract request is submitted through the EDAR system, including fiscal data, contract type, and supporting materials for CMS review.
• Legal Review & Contract Language: Contract language is reviewed and revised collaboratively by Legal, Program, and CMS.
• Contract Development & Initiation: CMS prepares the appropriate contract template and ensures readiness for execution.
• Routing, Approval & Execution: The Contract Specialist manages approvals, signatures, and final contract execution and distribution.

About the Role

• The Client is seeking (1) skilled Power BI Analyst.  The Power BI Analyst will work with the Information Technology (IT) development team, in collaboration with Business Analysts, Quality Assurance Testers, Trainers, and the Production Support Information Technology team. 
• The Power BI Analyst will design, build, and manage data models, interactive dashboards, and reports in Power BI to turn raw data into clear business insights and analyses that support leadership in evaluating key performance metrics, modeling behaviors, and data. 

Core Responsibilities:

• Data Preparation: Clean, transform, and shape raw datasets using Power Query and SQL.
• Data Modeling: Build stable relational data models and write custom DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) formulas for metrics, reporting, and analysis.
• Visualization: Create dynamic, multi-page dashboards and scorecards for stakeholders.
• Collaboration: Translate business needs into key performance indicators (KPIs) and technical report specs.
• Deliver enterprise-grade solutions leveraging Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Pages), aligning technology capabilities with business strategy and operational priorities.

Core Technical Skills

• Power BI proficiency: Ability to use Power BI Desktop and Service to clean, transform, and model data.
• DAX (Data Analysis Expressions): Master this formula language to build custom calculated columns, measures, totals, and complex filters.
• Power Query & ETL: Use Power Query to extract, transform, and clean raw data from multiple sources before loading it into your model.  
• Data Modeling: Design relational schemas, connect data sources, and configure star schemas with proper fact and dimension tables.  
• SQL & Excel: Write database queries in SQL and leverage Excel for preliminary data manipulation and fast ad hoc analysis.

title: Event Set up Crew
rawDescription:
• The equipment crew member is responsible for performing tasks as scheduled or directed to assure that the 33 conference rooms and the Statehouse have the required furniture and equipment arranged and set up as requested. 

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Knowledge and leading the set-up of specialized sound, audio, visual, live streaming equipment, including sound mixers, monitors, DVD players, multi box and podium equipment.
  • Troubleshooting issues with sound and audio equipment provided by the State, along with the customers required equipment and make necessary repairs for full functionality;
  • Ability to use creative thinking when issues arise and ability to quickly react and solve problems with limited resources.
  • Review worksheets, organize a timeline and plan the set up for rooms and Statehouse activities.
  • Assessing conference rooms and Statehouse event locations for needed equipment,gathering the necessary equipment and preparation of the space;
  • Ensure doors are unlocked, lights are on, and blinds are open at full length;
  • Transport all unnecessary equipment and furniture to the storeroom;
  • Set up all essential equipment and furniture as requested;
  • Ensure conference room or meeting area is presentable by cleaning, vacuuming, dusting, and removing trash as necessary;
  • Statehouse events must be handled efficiently and with an awareness of your location;
  • Ensure all Statehouse event space is presentable by removing customer’s trash and clean-up of catering debris;
  • Reset Statehouse event space as required within the required timeframe, especially during Legislative Session;
  • Work is carried out with specific written and verbal instructions and follows standardized/established practices in performing duties;
  • Assume role of leading other staff in the absence of supervision;
  • Clean carpets as scheduled / as needed using a commercial grade floor scrubber

Job Requirements:

  • Practical knowledge of all audio, video and sound equipment, along with commercial grade cleaning equipment used for Statehouse & Conference Center events and upkeep;
  • Ability to complete manual tasks which involve constant standing, walking, lifting, bending, twisting, and stooping;
  • Must be able to follow specific instructions, orally and in writing, and work independently with minimal supervision;
  • Must possess outstanding customer service skills as the incumbent may receive requests from visitors of the conference center and statehouse;
  • Knowledge of the equipment and furniture used in the conference center and Statehouse for the purpose of setting up, breaking down and changing over for events;
  • The ability to understand and interpret the reservation forms used for the Conference Center and the Statehouse events and the language used when describing how a room/area is to be set up for an event/meeting;
  • Must be able to trouble shoot equipment failures at a moment’s notice;
  • Assist Supervisor in maintaining inventory of supplies, performing a physical count and tracking of items on a daily basis;
  • Understanding of sound equipment, mixers, microphone, speakers and cabling, with the proficiency to set up monitors and tie into sound systems;
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with co-workers, other state agencies, and the public as required for set up and equipment needs;
  • Must be able to work weekends, with minimal notice, schedule is event based;
  • Sole point of contact during weekend events.

Supervisory Responsibilities/Direct Reports:

  • This position does not directly supervise State employees but is responsible for supervising and assisting Project Search interns on assigned projects. This position also serves as a group leader and facilitates training efforts for new staff members.

Difficulty of Work:

  • Duties will be varied and complex at times related to the setup of the events. Duties can be repetitive at times. Must be able to prioritize and organize the schedule and equipment for each day. Tasks and deadlines can be changed multiple times with limited warning which requires constant flexibility and the ability to quickly adapt to changes.

Physical Effort:

  • Effort involves constant lifting and walking throughout the Statehouse and conference center. Constant lifting of furniture and equipment that is moderate in weight. Continual pushing and pulling of furniture and equipment on flatbed carts. All work is performed in a non-sitting position and manual dexterity is at a moderate level.

title: Vision ETL Lead
description:
• The VISION – CWIS FACS Conversion Initiative requires the extraction of data from the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) BigQuery environment and the delivery of that data into enterprise SQL data warehouses. This effort is critical to ensuring continuity and modernization for all applications that currently depend on FACS.
• A dedicated ETL development team is being formed from the existing resource pool, and we are seeking a highly skilled Lead ETL Developer to provide leadership, training, architecture guidance, and technical oversight throughout this conversion effort.
Position Summary
• The Lead ETL Developer will design, build, test, and deploy data ingestion and migration pipelines that source historical and real-time data from a variety of disparate systems, including flat files and relational databases. The developer will transform and standardize incoming data into enterprise data models and ensure efficient, accurate loading into data warehouses, data lakes, and analytical databases.
• This role is responsible for ensuring that transactional and analytical data models include required data elements and meet quality, reliability, and performance expectations. The Lead ETL Developer will mentor and guide a team of ETL developers, establishing best practices and consistent development patterns throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities

• Lead development of ETL and data ingestion processes supporting the migration from GCP BigQuery to SQL-based data warehouse environments.
• Architect and implement pipelines using modern ETL tools and cloud-native data processing frameworks.
• Train and mentor a team of 4+ ETL developers on best practices, coding standards, and data model design.
• Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to validate data requirements and ensure alignment with reporting and analytical needs.
• Develop robust testing strategies to ensure data integrity, completeness, and accuracy throughout the migration process.
• Optimize pipelines for scalability, performance, and maintainability.
• Validate transactional and analytical data models to ensure they contain the necessary elements for downstream applications and BI solutions.
• Prepare and deliver clear communication, presentations, and technical documentation suitable for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum 7 years of hands-on ETL development experience.
• Expertise with modern ETL and reporting/BI tools.
• Strong understanding of enterprise data models and best practices in ETL pipeline design.
• Proven experience as a Technical Lead guiding teams of 4 or more developers.
• Demonstrated experience with:
• Google Cloud Dataform
• BigQuery
• Medallion Architecture
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging diverse audiences.
